schinese.name: 三连杀
schinese.description: 使用任意狙击步枪用一颗子弹击杀 3 名敌人。解锁所有狙击步枪的斜角瞄具。

spanish.name: Baja triple
spanish.description: Mata a 3 enemigos con una sola bala con cualquier fusil de francotirador. Desbloquea la "Mira angular" para todos los fusiles de francotirador.

dutch.name: Maximum Penetration
dutch.description: Kill 10 Shields by shooting through their shields using only the R93 sniper rifle. Unlocks the Short Barrel for the R93 sniper rifle.

english.name: Maximum Penetration
english.description: Kill 10 Shields by shooting through their shields using only the R93 sniper rifle. Unlocks the Short Barrel for the R93 sniper rifle.

french.name: Pénétration maximale
french.description: Tuez 10 Shields en tirant à travers leur bouclier en utilisant seulement le fusil de précision R93. Débloque le canon court pour le R93.

german.name: Stoppschild
german.description: Töte 10 Schild-Gegner durch ihre Schilde ausschließlich mit dem R93 Scharfschützengewehr. Schaltet den Kurzlauf für das R93 Scharfschützengewehr frei.

italian.name: Penetrazione massima
italian.description: Uccidi 10 forze speciali Shield sparando attraverso i loro scudi utilizzando solo il fucile da cecchino R93. Sbloccare questo obiettivo ti farà guadagnare la Canna corta per il fucile da cecchino R93.

russian.name: Максимальное пробивание
russian.description: Убейте 10 полицейских с щитом, прострелив их щиты с помощью снайперской винтовки R93. Выполнение достижения открывает укороченный ствол для снайперской винтовки R93.

schinese.name: 最大穿透
schinese.description: 仅使用 R93 狙击步枪射穿盾牌击杀 10 名盾兵。解锁 R93 狙击步枪的短枪管。

spanish.name: Penetración máxima
spanish.description: Mata a 10 Shields atravesando sus escudos con el Fusil de Francotirador R93. Desbloquea el "Cañón corto" para el Fusil de Francotirador R93.

dutch.name: Dodge This
dutch.description: Perform 10 headshot kills on Cloakers using only the Thanatos .50 cal sniper rifle. Unlocks the Suppressed Barrel for the Thanatos .50 cal sniper rifle.

english.name: Dodge This
english.description: Perform 10 headshot kills on Cloakers using only the Thanatos .50 cal sniper rifle. Unlocks the Suppressed Barrel for the Thanatos .50 cal sniper rifle.

french.name: Essaye d'éviter ça
french.description: Effectuez 10 tirs à la tête sur des Cloakers en utilisant uniquement le Thanatos .50. Débloque le canon silencieux pour le Thanatos.

german.name: Nur eine Maschine
german.description: Erziele 10 Kopfschüsse bei Cloakern ausschließlich mit dem Thanatos .50 cal Scharfschützengewehr. Schaltet den Schalldämpferlauf für das Thanatos .50 cal Scharfschützengewehr frei.

italian.name: Schiva questo
italian.description: Uccidi 10 Cloaker con un colpo alla testa utilizzando solo il fucile da cecchino Thanatos calibro .50. Sbloccare questo obiettivo ti farà guadagnare la Canna silenziata per il fucile da cecchino Thanatos calibro .50.

russian.name: Увернись-ка от этого
russian.description: Убейте 10 клокеров в голову с помощью винтовки Thanatos .50 cal. Выполнение достижения открывает приглушенный ствол для винтовки Thanatos .50 cal.

schinese.name: 闪避这个
schinese.description: 仅使用塔纳托斯 .50 狙击步枪爆头击杀 10 名潜伏者。解锁塔纳托斯 .50 狙击步枪的消音枪管。

spanish.name: Esquiva esto
spanish.description: Mata a 10 Cloakers con disparos a la cabeza con el Fusil Antimaterial Tánatos .50. Desbloquea el "Cañón con supresor" para el Fusil Antimaterial Tánatos .50.

dutch.name: Surprise Motherfucker
dutch.description: Kill 10 Bulldozers using only the Thanatos .50 cal sniper rifle. Unlocks the CQB Barrel for the Thanatos .50 cal sniper rifle.

english.name: Surprise Motherfucker
english.description: Kill 10 Bulldozers using only the Thanatos .50 cal sniper rifle. Unlocks the CQB Barrel for the Thanatos .50 cal sniper rifle.

french.name: Surprise connard !
french.description: Tuez 10 Bulldozers en utilisant uniquement le fusil de précision Thanatos .50. Débloque le canon combat rapproché pour le Thanatos .50.

german.name: Surprise Motherfucker
german.description: Töte 10 Bulldozer mit dem Thanatos .50 cal Scharfschützengewehr. Schaltet den CQB-Lauf für das Thanatos .50 cal Scharfschützengewehr frei.

italian.name: Sorpresa!
italian.description: Uccidi 10 Bulldozer utilizzando solo il fucile da cecchino Thanatos calibro .50. Sbloccare questo obiettivo ti farà guadagnare la Canna da combattimenti ravvicinati per il fucile da cecchino Thanatos calibro .50.

russian.name: Сюрприз, ублюдок
russian.description: Убейте 10 бульдозеров, используя только снайперскую винтовку Thanatos .50 cal. Выполнение достижения открывает ствол CQB для винтовки Thanatos .50 cal.

schinese.name: 惊喜吧，混蛋
schinese.description: 仅使用塔纳托斯 .50 狙击步枪击杀 10 名推土机。解锁塔纳托斯 .50 狙击步枪的 CQB 枪管。

spanish.name: ¡Sorpresa, hijo de puta!
spanish.description: Mata a 10 Bulldozers con el Fusil Antimaterial Tánatos .50. Desbloquea el "Cañón para CQB" para el Fusil Antimaterial Tánatos .50.

dutch.name: Didn’t See That Coming Did You?
dutch.description: Kill 10 enemies using any sniper rifle while zip lining. Unlocks the Theia Magnified Scope for sniper rifles.

english.name: Didn’t See That Coming Did You?
english.description: Kill 10 enemies using any sniper rifle while zip lining. Unlocks the Theia Magnified Scope for sniper rifles.

french.name: Tu l'as pas vu venir celle là, hein ?
french.description: Tuez 10 ennemis avec n'importe quel sniper tout en étant sur une tyrolienne. Débloque la lunette amplifiante Theia pour tous les snipers.

german.name: Das haste nicht kommen seh'n, oder?
german.description: Töte 10 Gegner mit Scharfschützengewehren während du die Seilrutsche benutzt. Schaltet das Theia Zielfernrohr für alle Scharfschützengewehre frei.

italian.name: Ti ho preso alla sprovvista?
italian.description: Uccidi 10 nemici utilizzando un qualsiasi fucile da cecchino mentre sei sulla teleferica. Sbloccare questo obiettivo ti farà guadagnare il Mirino modello Theia.

russian.name: Не ожидал?
russian.description: Убейте 10 противников любой снайперской винтовкой, передвигаясь по зиплайну. Выполнение достижения открывает оптический прицел Theia для всех снайперских винтовок.

schinese.name: 没想到吧？
schinese.description: 在滑索上使用任意狙击步枪击杀 10 名敌人。解锁狙击步枪的忒亚高倍瞄准镜。

spanish.name: Esa no te la esperabas, ¿eh?
spanish.description: Mientras usas una tirolina, mata a 10 enemigos con cualquier fusil de francotirador. Desbloquea la "Mira telescópica Theia" para todos los fusiles de francotirador.

dutch.name: A Taste of Their Own Medicine
dutch.description: Kill 25 Snipers using only the Rattlesnake sniper rifle. Unlocks the Tactical Aluminium Body for the Rattlesnake sniper rifle.

english.name: A Taste of Their Own Medicine
english.description: Kill 25 Snipers using only the Rattlesnake sniper rifle. Unlocks the Tactical Aluminium Body for the Rattlesnake sniper rifle.

french.name: L'arroseur arrosé
french.description: Tuez 25 Snipers en utilisant uniquement le fusil de précision Rattlesnake. Débloque le châssis tactique en aluminium pour le Rattlesnake.

german.name: Mit gleicher Münze heimzahlen
german.description: Töte 25 Scharfschützen ausschließlich mit dem Rattlesnake Scharfschützengewehr. Schaltet das Taktische Aluminiumgehäuße für das Rattlesnake Scharfschützengewehr frei.

italian.name: Un assaggio della loro stessa medicina
italian.description: Uccidi 25 cecchini utilizzando solo il fucile da cecchino Rattlesnake. Sbloccare questo obiettivo ti farà guadagnare il Corpo tattico di alluminio per il fucile da cecchino Rattlesnake.

russian.name: Вкус собственного лекарства
russian.description: Убейте 25 снайперов с помощью снайперской винтовки Rattlesnake. Выполнение достижения открывает форму из алюминия для винтовки Rattlesnake.

schinese.name: 以其人之道还治其人之身
schinese.description: 仅使用响尾蛇狙击步枪击杀 25 名狙击手。解锁响尾蛇狙击步枪的战术铝制枪身。

spanish.name: Una cucharada de su propia medicina
spanish.description: Mata a 25 Snipers con el Fusil de Francotirador Serpiente. Desbloquea el “Cuerpo táctico de aluminio” para el Fusil de Francotirador Serpiente.

dutch.name: You Can’t Hide
dutch.description: Kill 25 enemies shooting through walls or objects using only the R93 sniper rifle. Unlocks the Wooden Body for the R93 sniper rifle.

english.name: You Can’t Hide
english.description: Kill 25 enemies shooting through walls or objects using only the R93 sniper rifle. Unlocks the Wooden Body for the R93 sniper rifle.

french.name: Tu n'as nulle part où te cacher
french.description: Tuez 25 ennemis en tirant à travers des murs ou des objets en utilisant seulement le fusil de précision R93. Débloque le châssis en bois pour le R93.

german.name: Du kannst dich nicht verstecken
german.description: Töte 25 Gegner durch Wände oder Objekte ausschließlich mit dem R93 Scharfschützengewehr. Schaltet das Holzgehäuße für das R93 Scharfschützengewehr frei.

italian.name: Non puoi nasconderti
italian.description: Uccidi 25 nemici sparando attraverso pareti od oggetti utilizzando solo il fucile da cecchino R93. Sbloccare questo obiettivo ti farà guadagnare il Corpo di legno per il fucile da cecchino R93.

russian.name: Ты не спрячешься
russian.description: Убейте 25 противников через стены и другие предметы с помощью снайперской винтовки R93. Выполнение достижения открывает форму из дерева для винтовки R93.

schinese.name: 你无处可藏
schinese.description: 仅使用 R93 狙击步枪隔墙或隔物体射击击杀 25 名敌人。解锁 R93 狙击步枪的木制枪身。

spanish.name: No te puedes esconder
spanish.description: Mata a 25 enemigos disparando a través de paredes u objetos con el Fusil de Francotirador R93. Desbloquea el "Cuerpo de madera" para el Fusil de Francotirador R93.

dutch.name: Double Kill
dutch.description: Kill 2 enemies with one bullet 25 times using only the Rattlesnake sniper rifle. Unlocks the Sniper Suppressor for the Rattlesnake sniper rifle.

english.name: Double Kill
english.description: Kill 2 enemies with one bullet 25 times using only the Rattlesnake sniper rifle. Unlocks the Sniper Suppressor for the Rattlesnake sniper rifle.

french.name: D'une pierre 2 coups
french.description: Tuez deux ennemis d'un seul tir 25 fois en utilisant uniquement le fusil de précision Rattlesnake. Débloque le silencieux pour le Rattlesnake.

german.name: Double Kill
german.description: Töte 25 mal 2 Gegner mit einer Kugel mit dem Rattlesnake Scharfschützengewehr. Schaltet den Scharfschützen-Schalldämpfer für das Rattlesnake Scharfschützengewehr frei.

italian.name: Doppia uccisione
italian.description: Uccidi 2 nemici con un solo colpo per 25 volte utilizzando solo il fucile da cecchino Rattlesnake. Sbloccare questo obiettivo ti farà guadagnare il Soppressore da cecchino per il fucile da cecchino Rattlesnake.

russian.name: Двойное убийство
russian.description: Убейте двух противников одной пулей 25 раз, используя снайперскую винтовку Rattlesnake. Выполнение достижения открывает снайперский глушитель для винтовки Rattlesnake.

schinese.name: 双杀
schinese.description: 仅使用响尾蛇狙击步枪用一颗子弹击杀 2 名敌人，完成 25 次。解锁响尾蛇狙击步枪的狙击枪消音器。

spanish.name: Baja doble
spanish.description: Mata a 2 enemigos con una bala 25 veces con el Fusil de Francotirador Serpiente. Desbloquea el "Supresor de francotirador" para el Fusil de Francotirador Serpiente.

dutch.name: Public Enemy No. 1
dutch.description: Kill 250 enemies using only the Rattlesnake sniper rifle. Unlocks the Long Barrel for the Rattlesnake sniper rifle.

english.name: Public Enemy No. 1
english.description: Kill 250 enemies using only the Rattlesnake sniper rifle. Unlocks the Long Barrel for the Rattlesnake sniper rifle.

french.name: Ennemi public N°1
french.description: Tuez 250 ennemis en utilisant seulement le fusil de précision Rattlesnake. Débloque le canon long pour le Rattlesnake.

german.name: Staatsfeind Nr. 1
german.description: Töte 250 Gegner mit dem Rattlesnake Scharfschützengewehr. Schaltet den langen Lauf für das Rattlesnake Scharfschützengewehr frei.

italian.name: Nemico pubblico numero 1
italian.description: Uccidi 250 nemici utilizzando solo il fucile da cecchino Rattlesnake. Sbloccare questo obiettivo ti farà guadagnare la Canna lunga per il fucile da cecchino Rattlesnake.

russian.name: Нарушитель номер один
russian.description: Убейте 250 противников с помощью снайперской винтовки Rattlesnake. Выполнение достижения открывает удлинённый ствол для винтовки Rattlesnake.

schinese.name: 头号公敌
schinese.description: 仅使用响尾蛇狙击步枪击杀 250 名敌人。解锁响尾蛇狙击步枪的长枪管。

spanish.name: Enemigo Público N° 1
spanish.description: Mata a 250 enemigos con el Fusil de Francotirador Serpiente. Desbloquea el “Cañón largo” para el Fusil de Francotirador Serpiente.

dutch.name: I Will Fade to Dark
dutch.description: In the Shadow Raid job, secure 4 bags of loot.

english.name: I Will Fade to Dark
english.description: In the Shadow Raid job, secure 4 bags of loot.

french.name: Je me fondrai dans la pénombre
french.description: Dans Pillage nocturne, récupérez 4 sacs de butin.

german.name: Ich werde in die Schatten gleiten
german.description: Beim Auftrag "Diebe des Schattens", sichere 4 Beutetaschen.

italian.name: Sparirò nell'ombra
italian.description: Durante il contratto "OMBRE CINESI", metti al sicuro 4 borsoni di bottino.

russian.name: Я скроюсь во тьме
russian.description: Украдите 4 сумки, выполняя контракт "Теневой рейд".

schinese.name: 我将隐入黑暗
schinese.description: 在“暗影突袭”任务中回收 4 袋战利品。

spanish.name: Me desvaneceré en la oscuridad
spanish.description: En el trabajo Redada Sombra, asegura 4 objetos.

dutch.name: I Will Pass Through Walls
dutch.description: In the Shadow Raid job, secure at least 6 bags of loot and escape without killing anyone.

english.name: I Will Pass Through Walls
english.description: In the Shadow Raid job, secure at least 6 bags of loot and escape without killing anyone.

french.name: Je passerai à travers les murs
french.description: Dans Pillage nocturne, récupérez au moins 6 sacs de butin sans tuer personne.

german.name: Ich werde durch Wände gehen
german.description: Beim Auftrag "Diebe des Schattens", sichere mindestens 6 Beutetaschen ohne jemanden zu töten.

italian.name: Passerò attraverso i muri
italian.description: Durante il contratto "OMBRE CINESI", metti al sicuro almeno 6 borsoni di bottino senza uccidere nessuno.

russian.name: Я пройду сквозь стены
russian.description: Выполняя контракт "Теневой рейд", украдите 6 сумок, никого не убив.

schinese.name: 吾将穿墙而过
schinese.description: 在“影子突袭”任务中，转移至少6袋战利品并在未击杀任何人的情况下撤离。

spanish.name: Pasaré a través de los muros
spanish.description: En el trabajo Redada Sombra, asegura al menos 6 objetos y huye sin que nadie mate guardias o civiles.

dutch.name: I Will Take With Impunity
dutch.description: In the Shadow Raid job, secure a piece of every available type of loot, including money, gold, cocaine, artifact, painting, weapons and server.

english.name: I Will Take With Impunity
english.description: In the Shadow Raid job, secure a piece of every available type of loot, including money, gold, cocaine, artifact, painting, weapons and server.

french.name: Je volerai avec impunité
french.description: Dans Pillage nocturne, récupérez un sac de chaque type de butin disponible : argent, or, cocaïne, artefact, tableau, armes et serveur.

german.name: Ich werde ungestraft stehlen
german.description: Beim Auftrag "Diebe des Schattens", sichere von jeder möglichen Art von Beute ein Stück, einschließlich Geld, Gold, Kokain, Artefakt, Gemälde, Waffen und Server.

italian.name: Prenderò senza rimorso
italian.description: Durante il contratto "OMBRE CINESI", metti al sicuro un borsone di ogni tipo di bottino disponibile, tra cui denaro, oro, cocaina, artefatti, dipinti, armi e server.

russian.name: Я останусь безнаказанным
russian.description: "Выполня контракт "Теневой рейд" украдите хотя бы одну сумку с различными ценностями, включая деньги, золото, кокаин, артефакт, картину, оружие и сервер.

schinese.name: 吾将肆意夺取
schinese.description: 在“影子突袭”任务中，每种可获取的战利品都至少转移一件，包括现金、金条、可卡因、文物、画作、武器和服务器。

spanish.name: Lo haré con impunidad
spanish.description: En el trabajo Redada Sombra, asegura al menos un objeto de cada tipo, esto incluye dinero, oro, cocaína, artefacto, cuadro, servidor y fusiles de asalto.

dutch.name: I Will Walk Faceless Among Men
dutch.description: In the Shadow Raid job, secure all 4 pieces of the samurai armor. Unlocks the “Somen Mempo” mask.

english.name: I Will Walk Faceless Among Men
english.description: In the Shadow Raid job, secure all 4 pieces of the samurai armor. Unlocks the “Somen Mempo” mask.

french.name: Je me faufilerai au nez et à la barbe des hommes
french.description: Dans Pillage nocturne, récupérez les 4 morceaux de l'armure de samouraï. Débloque le masque "Somen Mempo".

german.name: Ich werde unter Euch sein - doch ohne Gesicht
german.description: Beim Auftrag "Diebe des Schattens", sichere alle 4 Teile der Samurai-Rüstung. Schaltet die Maske "Somen Mempo" frei.

italian.name: Camminerò inosservato tra gli uomini
italian.description: Durante il contratto "OMBRE CINESI", metti al sicuro tutti e 4 i pezzi dell'armatura samurai. Sbloccare questo obiettivo ti farà guadagnare la maschera "Somen Mempo".

russian.name: Моё лицо не узнают в толпе
russian.description: Выполняя контракт "Теневой рейд", украдите все 4 части самурайской брони. Выполнение достижения открывает маску "Сомэн Мэнгу".

schinese.name: 吾将无面行走于人间
schinese.description: 在“影子突袭”任务中，集齐全部4件武士盔甲。解锁“武者面甲”面具。

spanish.name: Caminaré sin rostro ante el hombre
spanish.description: En el trabajo Redada Sombra, asegura las 4 piezas de la armadura samurái. Desbloquea la máscara “Somen Mempo”.

dutch.name: I Am Ninja
dutch.description: In the Shadow Raid job, secure 16 bags of random loot including all 4 pieces of the samurai armor.

english.name: I Am Ninja
english.description: In the Shadow Raid job, secure 16 bags of random loot including all 4 pieces of the samurai armor.

french.name: Je suis Ninja
french.description: Dans Pillage nocturne, récupérez 16 sacs de butin et les 4 pièces de l'armure de samouraï.

german.name: Ich bin Ninja
german.description: Beim Auftrag "Diebe des Schattens", sichere 16 Taschen mit beliebiger Beute und alle 4 Teile der Samurai-Rüstung.

italian.name: Sono un ninja
italian.description: Durante il contratto "OMBRE CINESI", metti al sicuro 16 borsoni contenenti qualsiasi tipo di bottino, insieme a tutti e 4 i pezzi dell'armatura samurai.

russian.name: Я ниндзя
russian.description: Выполняя контракт "Теневой рейд", украдите 16 сумок с ценностями и 4 части самурайской брони.

schinese.name: 吾即忍者
schinese.description: 在“影子突袭”任务中，转移16袋随机战利品，其中包括全部4件武士盔甲。

spanish.name: Soy un ninja
spanish.description: En el trabajo Redada Sombra, asegura 16 objetos junto con las 4 piezas de armadura samurái.

dutch.name: I Will Die and Die, and Die Again
dutch.description: Complete the Shadow Raid job on the Death Wish difficulty or above.

english.name: I Will Die and Die, and Die Again
english.description: Complete the Shadow Raid job on the Death Wish difficulty or above.

french.name: Je mourrai encore et encore, et encore
french.description: Terminez le contrat Pillage nocturne en difficulté Suicidaire.

german.name: Ich werde sterben und sterben, und wieder sterben
german.description: Beende den Auftrag "Diebe des Schattens" auf der Schwierigkeit Todesmut.

italian.name: Morirò, morirò, e morirò ancora
italian.description: Completa il contratto "OMBRE CINESI" in difficoltà Apocalisse.

russian.name: Я умру, умру дважды и умру ещё раз
russian.description: Завершите контракт "Теневой рейд" на уровне сложности "Жажда смерти".

schinese.name: 吾将死了又死，再死一次
schinese.description: 在死亡之愿或更高难度下完成“影子突袭”任务。

spanish.name: Moriré, moriré y moriré de nuevo
spanish.description: Completa el trabajo Redada Sombra en la dificultad Death Wish.

dutch.name: It Takes Two to Tango
dutch.description: Hack the correct computer on the first try in The Big Bank job. Unlocks “The First American” mask, the "Parchment" material, the "Roman" pattern and the Tactical Grip for the Falcon rifle.

english.name: It Takes Two to Tango
english.description: Hack the correct computer on the first try in The Big Bank job. Unlocks “The First American” mask, the "Parchment" material, the "Roman" pattern and the Tactical Grip for the Falcon rifle.

french.name: Il faut être deux pour danser
french.description: Dans le contrat Benevolent Bank, piratez le bon ordinateur du premier coup. Débloque le masque "Le premier Américain", le matériau "Parchemin", le motif "Romain" et la poignée tactique pour le fusil Falcon.

german.name: Zu zweit ist man weniger allein
german.description: Beim Auftrag "Big Bank", hacke den richtigen Computer auf Anhieb. Schaltet die Maske "Erster Amerikaner" und den Taktischen Griff für das Falcon Gewehr frei.

italian.name: Servono due persone per ballare il tango
italian.description: Durante il contratto "LA GRANDE BANCA", manometti il computer corretto al primo tentativo. Sbloccare questo obiettivo ti farà guadagnare la maschera "Il primo americano" e l'Impugnatura tattica per il fucile Falcon.

russian.name: Для танго нужны двое
russian.description: Выполняя контракт "Большой банк", взломайте нужный компьютер с первого раза. Выполнение достижения открывает маску "Первый американец", материал "Пергамент", рисунок "Римский" и тактическую рукоять для винтовки Falcon.

schinese.name: 探戈需两人共舞
schinese.description: 在“大银行”任务中首次尝试就破解正确的电脑。解锁“第一位美国人”面具、“羊皮纸”材质、“罗马”图案和猎鹰步枪的战术握把。

spanish.name: Se necesitan dos para bailar Tango
spanish.description: En el trabajo El Gran Banco, hackea el ordenador correcto en el primer intento. Desbloquea la máscara “El Primer Estadounidense”, el material "Pergamino", el patrón "Romano" y la "Empuñadura táctica" para el Fusil Falco.

dutch.name: It Takes a Pig to Kill a Pig
dutch.description: Drop Floyd the pig on top of a law enforcer. Unlocks “The 1st” mask, the "Exhausted" material, the "Ruler" pattern and the Extended Magazine for the Falcon rifle.

english.name: It Takes a Pig to Kill a Pig
english.description: Drop Floyd the pig on top of a law enforcer. Unlocks “The 1st” mask, the "Exhausted" material, the "Ruler" pattern and the Extended Magazine for the Falcon rifle.

french.name: Brochette de porc et terrine de poulet
french.description: Dans le contrat Benevolent Bank, lâchez Floyd le cochon sur un ennemi. Débloque le masque "Le 1er", le matériau "Usagé", le motif "Imperator" et le chargeur à grande capacité pour le fusil Falcon.

german.name: Schwein gehabt, Bulle!
german.description: Beim Auftrag "Big Bank", lasse Floyd, das Schwein, auf einen Gegner fallen. Schaltet die Maske "Der 1." und das größere Magazin für das Falcon Gewehr frei.

italian.name: Serve un maiale per uccidere un maiale
italian.description: Durante il contratto "LA GRANDE BANCA", fai cadere il maialino Floyd sulla testa di un nemico. Sbloccare questo obiettivo ti farà guadagnare la maschera "Il primo" e il Caricatore esteso per il fucile Falcon.

russian.name: Чтобы убить свинью, нужна свинья
russian.description: Сбросьте свинью Флойда на полицейского. Выполнение достижения открывает маску "Первый", материал "Истощённый", рисунок "Лидер" и увеличенный магазин для винтовки Falcon.

schinese.name: 以猪杀猪
schinese.description: 把猪弗洛伊德砸到执法人员身上。解锁“第一”面具、“疲惫”材质、“直尺”图案和猎鹰步枪的加长弹匣。

spanish.name: Se necesita un cerdo para matar a un cerdo
spanish.description: En el trabajo El Gran Banco, suelta a Floyd el cerdo sobre un enemigo. Desbloquea la máscara “El Primero”, el material "Exhausto", el patrón "Gobernante" y el "Cargador ampliado" para el Fusil Falco.

dutch.name: Sweet Sixteen
dutch.description: Complete The Big Bank job with 16 secured bags. Unlocks “The 16th” mask, the "Clay" material, the "Spartan" pattern and the Marksman Foregrip for the Falcon rifle.

english.name: Sweet Sixteen
english.description: Complete The Big Bank job with 16 secured bags. Unlocks “The 16th” mask, the "Clay" material, the "Spartan" pattern and the Marksman Foregrip for the Falcon rifle.

french.name: C'est si bon d'en avoir 16
french.description: Terminez le contrat Benevolent Bank en ayant récupéré 16 sacs. Débloque le masque "Le 16ème", le matériau "Argile", le motif "Spartiate" et la poignée tireur d'élite pour le fusil Falcon.

german.name: Sweet Sixteen
german.description: Beim Auftrag "Big Bank", beende den Überfall mit 16 erbeuteten Taschen. Schaltet die Maske "16." und den Schützenhandgriff für das Falcon Gewehr frei.

italian.name: Sedici volte più ricchi
italian.description: Durante il contratto "LA GRANDE BANCA", completa il colpo mettendo al sicuro 16 borsoni. Sbloccare questo obiettivo ti farà guadagnare la maschera "Il sedicesimo" e l'Estensione da tiratore scelto per il fucile Falcon.

russian.name: Славные шестнадцать
russian.description: Завершите контракт "Большой банк", унеся с собой 16 сумок. Выполнение достижения открывает маску "Шестнадцатый", материал "Глина", рисунок "Спартанец", а также цевьё стрелка для винтовки Falcon.

schinese.name: 甜蜜十六
schinese.description: 在转移16袋战利品的情况下完成“大银行”任务。解锁“第十六”面具、“黏土”材质、“斯巴达”图案和猎鹰步枪的神射手前握把。

spanish.name: Dulces dieciséis
spanish.description: Completa el trabajo El Gran Banco, asegurando al menos 16 bolsas. Desbloquea la máscara “El #16”, el material "Arcilla", el patrón "Espartano" y el "Guardamanos y cañón de francotirador" para el Fusil Falco.

dutch.name: 12 Angry Minutes
dutch.description: In the Big Bank job, complete the heist in under 12 minutes on the Hard difficulty or above. Unlocks the Wooden Foregrip for the Falcon rifle.

english.name: 12 Angry Minutes
english.description: In the Big Bank job, complete the heist in under 12 minutes on the Hard difficulty or above. Unlocks the Wooden Foregrip for the Falcon rifle.

french.name: 12 minutes sous pression
french.description: Terminez le contrat Benevolent Bank en difficulté Difficile ou supérieure et en moins de 12 minutes. Débloque la poignée en bois pour le fusil Falcon.

german.name: Kurz vor zwölf
german.description: Beim Auftrag "Big Bank", beende den Raub in weniger als 12 Minuten auf der Schwierigkeit schwer oder höher. Schaltet den Holzhandgriff für das Falcon Gewehr frei.

italian.name: 12 minuti di pura adrenalina
italian.description: Durante il contratto "LA GRANDE BANCA", completa il colpo in meno di 12 minuti in difficoltà Difficile o superiore. Sbloccare questo obiettivo ti farà guadagnare l'Estensione in legno per il fucile Falcon.

russian.name: 12 злобных минут
russian.description: Завершите контракт "Большой банк" не более чем за 12 минут на сложности "Сложно" или выше. Выполнение достижения открывает деревянное цевьё для винтовки Falcon.

schinese.name: 愤怒的12分钟
schinese.description: 在“大银行”任务中，于困难或更高难度下在12分钟内完成劫案。解锁猎鹰步枪的木质前握把。

spanish.name: 12 minutos de furia
spanish.description: Completa el trabajo El Gran Banco en menos de 12 minutos en la dificultad Difícil o más alta. Desbloquea el "Guardamanos de madera" para el Fusil Falco.

dutch.name: Don't Bring the Heat
dutch.description: In the Big Bank job, complete the heist without triggering the alarm. Unlocks the CQB Stock for the Falcon rifle.

english.name: Don't Bring the Heat
english.description: In the Big Bank job, complete the heist without triggering the alarm. Unlocks the CQB Stock for the Falcon rifle.

french.name: Restez discrets
french.description: Terminez le contrat Benevolent Bank sans jamais déclencher l'alarme. Débloque la crosse combat rapproché pour le fusil Falcon.

german.name: Spiel' nicht mit dem Feuer
german.description: Beim Auftrag "Big Bank", beende den Raub, ohne den Alarm auszulösen. Schaltet den CQB-Schaft für das Falcon Gewehr frei.

italian.name: Lontano dai riflettori
italian.description: Durante il contratto "LA GRANDE BANCA", completa il colpo senza far scattare l'allarme. Sbloccare questo obiettivo ti farà guadagnare il Calcio da combattimenti ravvicinati per il fucile Falcon.

russian.name: Не привлекая внимания
russian.description: Завершите контракт "Большой банк", не поднимая тревоги. Выполнение достижения открывает приклад CQB для винтовки Falcon.

schinese.name: 别引来大批警力
schinese.description: 在“大银行”任务中，在不触发警报的情况下完成劫案。解锁猎鹰步枪的CQB枪托。

spanish.name: Sin llamar la atención
spanish.description: Completa el trabajo El Gran Banco sin que se active la alarma. Desbloquea la "Culata para CQB" para el Fusil Falco.

dutch.name: Backing Bobblehead Bob
dutch.description: Bring Bobblehead Bob to the vault. Unlocks “The 18th” mask, the "Gemstone" material, the "God of War" pattern and the Wooden Stock for the Falcon rifle.

english.name: Backing Bobblehead Bob
english.description: Bring Bobblehead Bob to the vault. Unlocks “The 18th” mask, the "Gemstone" material, the "God of War" pattern and the Wooden Stock for the Falcon rifle.

french.name: Faire rebondir Bob
french.description: Dans le contrat Benevolent Bank, amenez Bobblehead Bob jusqu'au coffre. Débloque le masque "Le 18ème", le matériau "Pierre précieuse", le motif "Dieu de la guerre" et la crosse en bois pour le fusil Falcon.

german.name: Schwärmen für Bobblehead Bob
german.description: Beim Auftrag "Big Bank", bringt Bobblehead Bob zum Tresorraum. Schaltet die Maske "18." und den Holzschaft für das Falcon Gewehr frei.

italian.name: Operazione Bobblehead Bob
italian.description: Durante il contratto "LA GRANDE BANCA", porta Bobblehead Bob al caveau. Sbloccare questo obiettivo ti farà guadagnare la maschera "Il diciottesimo" e il Calcio in legno per il fucile Falcon.

russian.name: Боб возвращается
russian.description: Приведите Баблхэд Боба в хранилище. Выполнение достижения открывает маску "Восемнадцатый", материал "Драгоценный камень", рисунок "Бог войны" и деревянный приклад для винтовки Falcon.

schinese.name: 力挺摇头娃娃鲍勃
schinese.description: 将摇头娃娃鲍勃带到金库。解锁“第18号”面具、“宝石”材质、“战神”图案以及猎鹰步枪的木制枪托。

spanish.name: Apoyando a Bobblehead Bob
spanish.description: En el trabajo El Gran Banco, escolta a Bobblehead Bob hasta la bóveda. Desbloquea la máscara “El #18”, el material "Gema", el patrón "Dios de la guerra" y la "Culata de madera" para el Fusil Falco.

dutch.name: Entrapment
dutch.description: In the Big Bank job, complete the heist with 12 bags in the default escape with all the lasers active. Unlocks the CQB Foregrip for the Falcon rifle.

english.name: Entrapment
english.description: In the Big Bank job, complete the heist with 12 bags in the default escape with all the lasers active. Unlocks the CQB Foregrip for the Falcon rifle.

french.name: Pris au piège
french.description: Terminez le contrat Benevolent Bank avec 12 sacs, le plan de fuite par défaut et tous les lasers activés. Débloque la poignée combat rapproché pour le fusil Falcon.

german.name: Verlockende Falle
german.description: Beim Auftrag "Big Bank", beende den Raub mit 12 Taschen mit der Standard-Flucht während alle Laser aktiv sind. Schaltet den CQB-Handgriff für das Falcon Gewehr frei.

italian.name: In trappola
italian.description: Durante il contratto "LA GRANDE BANCA", completa il colpo con 12 borsoni e con il piano di fuga predefinito, mantenendo i laser sempre attivi. Sbloccare questo obiettivo ti farà guadagnare l'Estensione da combattimenti ravvicinati per il fucile Falcon.

russian.name: В западне
russian.description: Завершите контракт "Большой банк", унеся с собой 12 сумок с добычей, не изменяя план побега и не отключая лазеры. Выполнение достижения открывает цевьё CQB для винтовки Falcon.

schinese.name: 诱捕
schinese.description: 在大银行任务中，在所有激光均处于激活状态的情况下，携带12袋战利品从默认撤离点完成劫案。解锁猎鹰步枪的CQB前握把。

spanish.name: Atrapamiento
spanish.description: Completa sigilosamente el trabajo El Gran Banco, asegurando 12 bolsas sin desactivar ningún láser, con el plan de huida predeterminado. Desbloquea el "Guardamanos y cañón para CQB" para el Fusil Falco.

dutch.name: You Owe Me One
dutch.description: In the Big Bank job, start the Big Bank job after having spent all 10 favors in Preplanning. Unlocks the Retro Foregrip for the Falcon rifle.

english.name: You Owe Me One
english.description: In the Big Bank job, start the Big Bank job after having spent all 10 favors in Preplanning. Unlocks the Retro Foregrip for the Falcon rifle.

french.name: Tu m'en dois une
french.description: Dans le contrat Benevolent Bank, dépensez vos 10 faveurs en Planification puis lancez le casse. Débloque la poignée rétro pour le fusil Falcon.

german.name: Du schuldest mir was
german.description: Beim Auftrag "Big Bank", beginne den Raub nachdem alle 10 Gefallen in der Vorausplanung verbraucht wurden. Schalett den Retro Handgriff für das Falcon Gewehr frei.

italian.name: Mi devi un favore
italian.description: Durante il contratto "LA GRANDE BANCA", inizia il colpo avendo speso tutti e 10 i favori nella prepianificazione. Sbloccare questo obiettivo ti farà guadagnare l'Estensione vecchio stile per il fucile Falcon.

russian.name: Будешь должен
russian.description: Начните контракт "Большой банк", потратив все 10 услуг в режиме планирования. Выполнение достижения открывает ретро цевьё для винтовки Falcon.

schinese.name: 你欠我一个人情
schinese.description: 在大银行任务中，在预先规划里花光全部10点人情点后开始大银行任务。解锁猎鹰步枪的复古前握把。

spanish.name: Me debes una
spanish.description: En el trabajo El Gran Banco, empieza el golpe habiendo usado 10 puntos de favor en la Planificación Previa. Desbloquea el "Guardamanos y cañón retro" para el Fusil Falco.

dutch.name: Don't Forget to Floss
dutch.description: Complete the Big Bank job on the Death Wish difficulty or above.

english.name: Don't Forget to Floss
english.description: Complete the Big Bank job on the Death Wish difficulty or above.

french.name: N'oubliez pas de bien vous brosser
french.description: Terminez le contrat Benevolent Bank en difficulté Suicidaire.

german.name: Don't Forget to Floss
german.description: Beende den Auftrag "Big Bank" auf der Schwierigkeit Todesmut.

italian.name: Ricordati di passare il filo interdentale
italian.description: Completa il contratto "LA GRANDE BANCA" in difficoltà Apocalisse.

russian.name: Не забудь почистить зубы
russian.description: Завершите контракт "Большой банк" на уровне сложности "Жажда смерти".

schinese.name: 别忘了用牙线
schinese.description: 在死亡愿望或更高难度下完成大银行任务。

spanish.name: No olvides usar hilo dental
spanish.description: Completa el trabajo El Gran Banco en la dificultad Death Wish.

dutch.name: Funding Father
dutch.description: Complete any heist while you and your four man crew are wearing one different "Big Bank" mask each. Unlocks the Marksman Stock for the Falcon rifle.

english.name: Funding Father
english.description: Complete any heist while you and your four man crew are wearing one different "Big Bank" mask each. Unlocks the Marksman Stock for the Falcon rifle.

french.name: Père fondateur
french.description: Terminez le contrat Benevolent Bank alors que chaque membre de votre équipe de 4 porte un masque "Benevolent" différent. Débloque la crosse tireur d'élite pour le fusil Falcon.

german.name: Dollarquartet
german.description: Beim Auftrag "Big Bank", beende den Überfall während du und deine Crew 4 verschiedene "Big Bank"-Masken tragt. Schaltet den Schützenschaft für das Falcon Gewehr frei.

italian.name: I padri fondatori
italian.description: Durante il contratto "LA GRANDE BANCA", completa il colpo mentre tutti i membri della squadra indossano una maschera diversa dei Padri Fondatori. Sbloccare questo obiettivo ti farà guadagnare il Calcio da tiratore scelto per il fucile Falcon.

russian.name: Отец-основатель
russian.description: Завершите контракт "Большой банк" вчетвером так, чтобы все члены команды носили 4 разные маски из комплекта дополнений "Big Bank". Выполнение достижения открывает приклад стрелка для винтовки Falcon.

schinese.name: 金主爸爸
schinese.description: 在你和你的四人小队每人佩戴一个不同“大银行”面具的情况下完成任意劫案。解锁猎鹰步枪的神射手枪托。

spanish.name: Padre Fundador
spanish.description: Completa el trabajo El Gran Banco mientras tú y tu equipo de cuatro usan una máscara diferente de “The Big Bank Heist”. Desbloquea la "Culata de francotirador" para el Fusil Falco.

dutch.name: Police Brutality
dutch.description: Beat a Shield to death using the Telescopic Baton.

english.name: Police Brutality
english.description: Beat a Shield to death using the Telescopic Baton.

french.name: Brutalité policière
french.description: Matraquez un Shield à mort avec le bâton télescopique.

german.name: Polizeigewalt
german.description: Schlage einen Schild mit dem Teleskop-Schlagstock tot.

italian.name: Brutalità poliziesca
italian.description: Uccidi uno Scudo utilizzando il manganello telescopico.

russian.name: Полицейская жестокость
russian.description: Забейте полицейского с щитом телескопической дубинкой.

schinese.name: 警察暴力
schinese.description: 用伸缩警棍将一名盾牌兵活活打死。

spanish.name: Brutalidad policial
spanish.description: Mata a un Shield usando la Porra Plegable.

dutch.name: Lock, Stock & Eight Smoking Barrels
dutch.description: Own the Locomotive, Street Sweeper, Reinfeld, Mosconi, Izhma, Raven and M1014 Shotguns. Unlocks the Flip-up Sight for the Raven shotgun.

english.name: Lock, Stock & Eight Smoking Barrels
english.description: Own the Locomotive, Street Sweeper, Reinfeld, Mosconi, Izhma, Raven and M1014 Shotguns. Unlocks the Flip-up Sight for the Raven shotgun.

french.name: Arnaques, Crimes et Pompes par huit
french.description: Achetez tous les fusils à pompe. Débloque la lunette repliable pour le Raven.

german.name: Bube, Dame, Räuber, Gras
german.description: Besitze alle Schrotflinten. Schaltet das Klappvisier für die Raven Schrotflinte frei.

italian.name: Pazzo scatenato
italian.description: Acquista tutti i fucili a pompa. Sblocca il Mirino a scomparsa per il fucile a pompa Raven.

russian.name: Карты, деньги, 8 дымящихся стволов
russian.description: Имейте все дробовики в инвентаре одновременно. Выполнение достижения открывает складной прицел для дробовика Raven.

schinese.name: 八杆大烟枪
schinese.description: 拥有火车头、清道夫、雷恩菲尔德、莫斯康尼、伊兹玛、渡鸦和M1014霰弹枪。解锁渡鸦霰弹枪的折叠式瞄具。

spanish.name: Juegos, trampas y ocho cañones humeantes
spanish.description: Ten en tu inventario la Escopeta Locomotora 12G, la Escopeta Barredora, la Escopeta Reinfeld 880, la Escopeta Mosconi 12G, la Escopeta IZHMA 12G, la Escopeta Cuervo, y la Escopeta M1014. Desbloquea la "Mira plegable" para la Escopeta Cuervo.

dutch.name: Swing Dancing
dutch.description: Complete any single day of a heist, killing at least 50 enemies using only your melee weapon.

english.name: Swing Dancing
english.description: Complete any single day of a heist, killing at least 50 enemies using only your melee weapon.

french.name: Ça swingue !
french.description: Terminez n'importe quel jour d'un contrat en tuant au moins 50 ennemis, uniquement avec votre arme de mêlée.

german.name: Tanz den Swing
german.description: Beende einen Tag eines beliebigen Raubes bei dem du ausschließlich mit Nahkampfwaffen mind. 50 Gegner getötet hast.

italian.name: Danza moderna
italian.description: Completa un giorno di un qualsiasi contratto avendo ucciso almeno 50 nemici con un'arma da mischia.

russian.name: Размахивай руками!
russian.description: Завершите любой день контракта, убив 50 противников, используя только оружие ближнего боя.

schinese.name: 摇摆舞
schinese.description: 完成任意劫案中的任意一天，仅使用近战武器击杀至少50名敌人。

spanish.name: Bailando Swing
spanish.description: Completa un día o trabajo solo con ataques cuerpo a cuerpo, matando al menos a 50 enemigos.

dutch.name: Seven Eleven
dutch.description: Get 7 enemy headshot kills within 11 seconds using any shotgun. Unlocks the Short Barrel for the M1014 shotgun, “John” mask, “Explosive” material and “Terror” pattern.

english.name: Seven Eleven
english.description: Get 7 enemy headshot kills within 11 seconds using any shotgun. Unlocks the Short Barrel for the M1014 shotgun, “John” mask, “Explosive” material and “Terror” pattern.

french.name: Sept à la onzaine
french.description: Effectuez 7 tirs à la tête en 11 secondes avec un fusil à pompe. Débloque le canon court pour le fusil à pompe M1014, le masque "John", le matériau "Explosif", et le motif "Terreur".

german.name: Das tapfere Räuberlein
german.description: Töte innerhalb von 11 Sekunden 7 Gegner durch Kopfschüsse mit Schrotflinten. Schaltet den kurzen Lauf für die M1014 Schrotflinte, die Maske "John", das Material "Sprengstoff" und das Muster "Terror" frei.

italian.name: 7-Eleven
italian.description: Uccidi 7 nemici con un colpo alla testa entro 11 secondi usando un qualsiasi fucile a pompa. Sblocca la Canna corta per il fucile a pompa M1014, la maschera "JOHN", il materiale "ESPLOSIVO" e il motivo "TERRORE".

russian.name: Seven Eleven
russian.description: Убейте 7 противников в голову в течение 11 секунд с помощью любого дробовика. Выполнение достижения открывает укороченный ствол для дробовика M1014, маску "Джон", материал "Взрывной" и рисунок "Ужас".

schinese.name: 七一一
schinese.description: 在11秒内使用任意霰弹枪爆头击杀7名敌人。解锁M1014霰弹枪的短枪管、“约翰”面具、“爆炸”材质和“恐怖”图案。

spanish.name: Seven Eleven
spanish.description: Mata a 7 enemigos con disparos a la cabeza en menos de 11 segundos con cualquier escopeta. Desbloquea el "Cañón corto" para la Escopeta M1014, la máscara “John”, el material “Explosivo” y el patrón “Terror”.

dutch.name: Shotguns 101
dutch.description: Complete any heist by killing at least 50 enemies and getting 101% accuracy or above using any shotgun. Unlocks the Long Barrel for the M1014 shotgun.

english.name: Shotguns 101
english.description: Complete any heist by killing at least 50 enemies and getting 101% accuracy or above using any shotgun. Unlocks the Long Barrel for the M1014 shotgun.

french.name: 101 raisons d'aimer les pompes
french.description: Tuez au moins 50 ennemis avec un fusil à pompe et cumulez 101% de précision minimum à la fin du casse. Débloque le canon long pour le fusil à pompe M1014.

german.name: 101% Schrot
german.description: Töte mind. 50 Gegner mit einer Genauigkeit von mind. 101% mit Schrotflinten. Schaltet den langen Lauf für die M1014 Schrotflinte frei.

italian.name: Shotgun 101
italian.description: Uccidi almeno 50 nemici con un qualsiasi fucile a pompa ottenendo un'accuratezza del 101% o superiore. Sblocca la Canna lunga per il fucile a pompa M1014.

russian.name: Дробовики 101
russian.description: Убейте не менее 50 противников и заработайте точность не менее 101%, используя любой дробовик. Выполнение достижения открывает удлинённый ствол для дробовика M1014.

schinese.name: 霰弹枪入门课
schinese.description: 使用任意霰弹枪击杀至少50名敌人且准确率达到101%或以上，完成任意劫案。解锁M1014霰弹枪的长枪管。

spanish.name: Escopeta 101: Cómo Usar una Escopeta
spanish.description: Completa un día o trabajo habiendo usado solo escopetas, habiendo matado al menos 50 enemigos y con una precisión igual o mayor a 101%. Desbloquea el "Cañón largo" para la Escopeta M1014.

dutch.name: Knock, Knock
dutch.description: Kill 50 Shields using any shotgun and slug ammo. Unlocks the Collapsed Stock for the M1014 shotgun.

english.name: Knock, Knock
english.description: Kill 50 Shields using any shotgun and slug ammo. Unlocks the Collapsed Stock for the M1014 shotgun.

french.name: Toc toc
french.description: Tuez 50 Shields avec un fusil à pompe aux munitions perce-armure. Débloque la crosse effacée pour le fusil à pompe M1014.

german.name: Klopf, Klopf
german.description: Töte 50 Schilde mit Schrotflinten und Slug-Munition. Schaltet den Insolvenzschaft für die M1014 Schrotflinte.

italian.name: Toc toc
italian.description: Uccidi 50 Scudi usando un qualsiasi fucile a pompa con munizioni Slug. Sblocca il Calcio ripiegabile per il fucile a pompa M1014.

russian.name: Тук-тук
russian.description: Убейте 50 полицейских с щитом, используя любой дробовик с бронебойными боеприпасами. Выполнение достижения открывает складной приклад для дробовика М1014.

schinese.name: 咚咚咚
schinese.description: 使用任意霰弹枪搭配独头弹击杀50名盾兵。解锁M1014霰弹枪的折叠枪托。

spanish.name: Toc, toc
spanish.description: Mata a 50 Shields atravesando sus escudos con escopetas con munición "Bala perforante". Desbloquea la "Culata ocultada" para la Escopeta M1014.

dutch.name: Every day I’m Shovelin'
dutch.description: On the Night Club heist, kill 25 law enforcers using your shovel. Unlocks the Short Barrel for the Raven shotgun.

english.name: Every day I’m Shovelin'
english.description: On the Night Club heist, kill 25 law enforcers using your shovel. Unlocks the Short Barrel for the Raven shotgun.

french.name: Pelle, pelle, pelle, comme le jour
french.description: Dans Boîte de nuit, tuez 25 flics avec la pelle. Débloque le canon court pour le fusil à pompe Raven.

german.name: Wahnsinn? DAS...IST...SPATEN!
german.description: Im Auftrag "Nachtclub", töte 25 Gesetzeshüter mit dem Spaten. Schaltet den kurzen Lauf für die Raven Schrotflinte frei.

italian.name: Lo spalatore
italian.description: Durante il contratto "NIGHT CLUB", uccidi 25 tutori della legge usando la tua pala. Sblocca la canna corta per il fucile a pompa Raven.

russian.name: Everyday I’m Shovelin’
russian.description: Выполняя контракт "Ночной клуб", убейте 25 полицейских лопатой. Выполнение достижения открывает укороченный ствол для дробовика Raven.

schinese.name: 天天铲不停
schinese.description: 在“夜店”劫案中，使用铁锹击杀25名执法人员。解锁渡鸦霰弹枪的短枪管。

spanish.name: Siempre llevo mi pala
spanish.description: En el trabajo Club Nocturno, mata a 25 enemigos con la Pala K.L.A.S. Desbloquea el "Cañón corto" para la Escopeta Cuervo.

dutch.name: Clay Pigeon Shooting
dutch.description: Kill 10 snipers using any shotgun and flechette ammo. Unlocks the Long Barrel for the Raven shotgun, "Clint" mask, "Leaf" material and "Monkey Skull" pattern.

english.name: Clay Pigeon Shooting
english.description: Kill 10 snipers using any shotgun and flechette ammo. Unlocks the Long Barrel for the Raven shotgun, "Clint" mask, "Leaf" material and "Monkey Skull" pattern.

french.name: Tir au pigeon d'argile
french.description: Tuez 10 Snipers avec un fusil à pompe aux munitions fléchette. Débloque le canon long pour le Raven, le masque "Clint", le matériau "Feuille", et le motif "Crâne de singe".

german.name: Tontaubenschießen
german.description: Töte 10 Scharfschützen mit Schrotflinten und Flechet-Munition. Schaltet den langen Lauf für die Raven Schrotflinte, die Maske "Clint", das Material "Blatt" und das Muster "Affenschädel".

italian.name: Tiro al piattello
italian.description: Uccidi 10 cecchini usando un qualsiasi fucile a pompa con munizioni Fléchette. Sblocca la Canna lunga per il fucile a pompa Raven, la maschera "CLINT", il materiale "FOGLIA" e il motivo "TESCHIO DI SCIMMIA".

russian.name: Стрельба по мишеням
russian.description: Убейте 10 снайперов с помощью любого дробовика, заряженного флешеттой. Выполнение достижения открывает удлинённый ствол для дробовика Raven, маску "Клинт", материал "Листва" и рисунок "Череп обезьяны".

schinese.name: 飞碟射击
schinese.description: 使用任意霰弹枪搭配箭形弹击杀10名狙击手。解锁渡鸦霰弹枪的长枪管、“克林特”面具、“落叶”材质和“猴骷髅”图案。

spanish.name: Tiro al plato
spanish.description: Mata a 10 Snipers con escopetas con munición "Flechette”. Desbloquea el "Cañón largo" para la Escopeta Cuervo, la máscara “Clint”, el material “Hoja” y el patrón “Cráneo de mono”.

dutch.name: Shock and Awe
dutch.description: Hit 4 enemies simultaneously using any shotgun and HE rounds. Unlocks the Solid Stock for the M1014 shotgun.

english.name: Shock and Awe
english.description: Hit 4 enemies simultaneously using any shotgun and HE rounds. Unlocks the Solid Stock for the M1014 shotgun.

french.name: Stupéfaction générale
french.description: Touchez simultanément 4 ennemis avec un fusil à pompe aux munitions HE. Débloque la crosse pleine pour le fusil à pompe M1014.

german.name: Shock and Awe
german.description: Treffe 4 Gegner gleichzeitig mit Schrotflinten und HE-Munition. Schaltet den festen Schaft für die M1014 Schrotflinte frei.

italian.name: Colpisci e stupisci
italian.description: Colpisci 4 nemici allo stesso tempo usando un qualsiasi fucile a pompa dotato di munizioni esplosive. Sblocca il Calcio solido per il fucile a pompa M1014.

russian.name: Шок и трепет
russian.description: Нанесите урон четырём противникам одновременно с помощью любого дробовика со взрывными боеприпасами. Выполнение достижения открывает удобный приклад для дробовика M1014.

schinese.name: 震慑与敬畏
schinese.description: 使用任意霰弹枪搭配高爆弹同时命中4名敌人。解锁M1014霰弹枪的实心枪托。

spanish.name: Shock y pavor
spanish.description: Impacta a 4 enemigos a la vez con una escopeta con munición "Cartucho HE". Desbloquea la "Culata sólida" para la Escopeta M1014.

dutch.name: Bang for the Buck
dutch.description: Kill 10 Bulldozers using any shotgun and 000 buckshot ammo. Unlocks the Long Barrel for the Street Sweeper shotgun, "Steven" mask, "Sparks" material and "Chief" pattern.

english.name: Bang for the Buck
english.description: Kill 10 Bulldozers using any shotgun and 000 buckshot ammo. Unlocks the Long Barrel for the Street Sweeper shotgun, "Steven" mask, "Sparks" material and "Chief" pattern.

french.name: Chasse au bison
french.description: Tuez 10 Bulldozers avec un fusil à pompe aux munitions Chevrotine 000. Débloque le canon long pour le Street Sweeper, le masque "Steven", le matériau "Etincelles" et le motif "Chef".

german.name: Schrotdozer
german.description: Töte 10 Bulldozer mit Schrotflinten und "000 Buckshot"-Munition. Schaltet den langen Lauf für die "Street Sweeper"-Schrotflinte, die Maske "Steven", das Material "Funken" und das Muster "Häuptling" frei.

italian.name: Fai valere ogni colpo
italian.description: Uccidi 10 Bulldozer usando un fucile a pompa con le munizioni 000 Buckshot. Sblocca la Canna lunga per il fucile a pompa Streetsweeper, la maschera "STEVEN", il materiale "SCINTILLE" e il motivo "COMANDANTE".

russian.name: Удачное вложение
russian.description: Убейте 10 бульдозеров с помощью любого дробовика, заряженного дробью 000. Выполнение достижения открывает удлинённый ствол для дробовика Street Sweeper, маску "Стивен", материал "Искры" и рисунок "Шеф".

schinese.name: 物超所值
schinese.description: 使用任意霰弹枪搭配000鹿弹击杀10名推土机。解锁街头清扫者霰弹枪的长枪管、“史蒂文”面具、“火花”材质和“酋长”图案。

spanish.name: Buck dice que merece la pena
spanish.description: Mata a 10 Bulldozers con escopetas con munición "Buckshot de 000”. Desbloquea el "Cañón largo" para la Escopeta Barredora, la máscara “Steven”, el material “Chispas” y el patrón “Jefe”.

dutch.name: No Heist for Old Men
dutch.description: Complete any day of a heist in stealth with a Locomotive 12G shotgun modified with the "Silent Killer Suppressor" equipped. Unlocks the Suppressed Barrel for the Street Sweeper shotgun, "Rutger" mask, "Banana Peel" material and "Banana" pattern.

english.name: No Heist for Old Men
english.description: Complete any day of a heist in stealth with a Locomotive 12G shotgun modified with the "Silent Killer Suppressor" equipped. Unlocks the Suppressed Barrel for the Street Sweeper shotgun, "Rutger" mask, "Banana Peel" material and "Banana" pattern.

french.name: Je suis trop vieux pour ces conneries
french.description: Terminez n'importe quel casse furtivement avec le Locomotive 12G équipé d'un silencieux. Débloque le canon silencieux pour le Street Sweeper, le masque "Rutger", le matériau "Peau de banane", et le motif "Banane".

german.name: No Heist for Old Men
german.description: Beende einen beliebigen Raub in Stealth mit einer schallgedämpften Locomotive 12G Schrotflinte. Schaltet den schallgedämpften Lauf für die "Street Sweeper"-Schrotflinte, die Maske "Rutger", das Material "Bananenschale" und das Muster "Banane" frei.

italian.name: Non è un colpo per vecchi
italian.description: Completa un qualsiasi contratto con il fucile a pompa Locomotive 12G modificato con il Silenziatore da assassino. Sblocca la Canna silenziata per il fucile a pompa Street Sweeper, la maschera "RUTGER", il materiale "BUCCIA DI BANANA" e il motivo "BANANA".

russian.name: Никаких ограблений для стариков
russian.description: Завершите любое ограбление, не поднимая тревоги, используя дробовик Locomotive 12G с установленным на него глушителем "Тихий убийца". Выполнение достижения открывает приглушенный ствол на дробовик Street Sweeper, маску "Рутгер", материал "Банановая кожура" и рисунок "Банан".

schinese.name: 老无所劫
schinese.description: 使用装配“无声杀手消音器”的机车12G霰弹枪，以潜行方式完成任意劫案的任意一天。解锁街头清扫者霰弹枪的消音枪管、“鲁特格”面具、“香蕉皮”材质和“香蕉”图案。

spanish.name: Sin golpes para los débiles
spanish.description: Completa un golpe en sigilo usando la Escopeta Locomotora 12G con el supresor “El Asesino Silencioso” equipado. Desbloquea el “Cañón silenciado” para la Escopeta Barredora, la máscara “Rutger”, el material “Cáscara de banana” y el patrón “Banana”.

dutch.name: Four Monkeys
dutch.description: In the Rats job, complete the heist while you and your four man crew are wearing one different "Shotgun Pack" mask each on OVERKILL difficulty or above.

english.name: Four Monkeys
english.description: In the Rats job, complete the heist while you and your four man crew are wearing one different "Shotgun Pack" mask each on OVERKILL difficulty or above.

french.name: Les quatre singes
french.description: Terminez le contrat Balances, en difficulté OVERKILL ou supérieure, alors que chaque membre de votre équipe de 4 porte un masque du Gage Shotgun Pack différent.

german.name: Four Monkeys
german.description: Beim Auftrag "Ratten", beende den Raub während du und diene 4-Mann-Crew vier verschiedene "Shotgun-Pack"-Masken tragt auf der Schwierigkeit OVERKILL oder höher.

italian.name: Le quattro famose scimmie
italian.description: Completa il contratto "SPIE" in difficoltà OVERKILL o superiore mentre tutti i membri della squadra indossano una maschera diversa del DLC Gage Shotgun Pack.

russian.name: Четыре обезьяны
russian.description: Завершите контракт "Крысы" вчетвером на уровне сложности "OVERKILL" или выше так, чтобы все члены команды носили 4 разные маски из комплекта дополнений "Shotgun Pack".

schinese.name: 四只猴子
schinese.description: 在“老鼠”任务中，于OVERKILL或更高难度下，你和四人小队的每名成员各自佩戴一个不同的“霰弹枪包”面具并完成劫案。

spanish.name: Cuatro monos
spanish.description: Completa el trabajo Ratas mientras tú y tu equipo de cuatro usan una máscara diferente del “Gage Shotgun Pack” en la dificultad OVERKILL o más alta.

dutch.name: Precision Aiming
dutch.description: Kill 25 Bulldozers using the Gewehr 3 Rifle. Unlocks the Sniper Barrel for the Clarion rifle, Sniper Stock, Sniper Grip and Sniper Foregrip for the Gecko 7.62 rifle, Precision Stock, Precision Foregrip, Precision Grip and the DMR Kit for the Gewehr 3 rifle as well as the “Black Death” mask.

english.name: Precision Aiming
english.description: Kill 25 Bulldozers using the Gewehr 3 Rifle. Unlocks the Sniper Barrel for the Clarion rifle, Sniper Stock, Sniper Grip and Sniper Foregrip for the Gecko 7.62 rifle, Precision Stock, Precision Foregrip, Precision Grip and the DMR Kit for the Gewehr 3 rifle as well as the “Black Death” mask.

french.name: Tir de précision
french.description: Tuez 25 Bulldozers avec le fusil Gewehr 3. Débloque le canon de sniper pour le fusil Clarion, la crosse de sniper, la poignée de sniper et la poignée avant de sniper pour le fusil Gecko 7.62, la crosse de précision, la poignée de précision et le kit DMR pour le fusil Gewehr 3 ainsi que le masque "Black Death".

german.name: Präzises Anvisieren
german.description: Töte 25 Bulldozer mit dem G3-Gewehr. Schaltet den Sniper-Lauf für das Clarion-Gewehr, Sniper-Schaft, Sniper-Griff und Sniper-Handgriff für das Gecko-7.62-Gewehr, Präzisionsschaft, Präzisionsgriff und den DMR-Rüstsatz für das G3-Gewehr sowie die Maske "Schwarzer Tod" frei.

italian.name: Mira infallibile
italian.description: Uccidi 25 Bulldozer usando il fucile Gewehr 3. Sblocca la Canna da cecchino per il fucile Clarion; il Calcio da cecchino, l'Impugnatura da cecchino e l'Impugnatura anteriore da cecchino per il fucile Gecko 7.62; il Calcio di precisione, l'Impugnatura di precisione e il Kit DMR per il fucile Gewehr 3 e la maschera "LA PESTE NERA".

russian.name: Меткая стрельба
russian.description: Убейте 25 бульдозеров с помощью винтовки Gewehr 3. Выполнение достижения открывает снайперский ствол для винтовки Clarion, снайперскую рукоять, цевьё и приклад для винтовки Gecko 7.62, набор DMR, приклад и цевьё меткого стрелка для винтовки Gewehr 3, а также маску "Чёрная смерть".

schinese.name: 精准瞄准
schinese.description: 使用Gewehr 3步枪击杀25名推土机。解锁克拉里恩步枪的狙击枪管，壁虎7.62步枪的狙击枪托、狙击握把和狙击前握把，Gewehr 3步枪的精准枪托、精准前握把、精准握把和DMR套件，以及“黑死病”面具。

spanish.name: Precisión al apuntar
spanish.description: Mata a 25 Bulldozers con el Gewehr 3. Desbloquea el "Cañón de francotirador" para el Fusil Clarion, la "Culata de francotirador", la "Empuñadura de francotirador" y el "Guardamanos y cañón de francotirador" para el Fusil Geco 7,62, la "Culata de precisión", la "Empuñadura de precisión" y el "Kit de DMR" para el Gewehr 3 y la máscara “Muerte Negra”.

dutch.name: Big Bada Boom
dutch.description: Kill at least four enemies with one GL40 grenade launcher shot. Unlocks the Sawed-off Stock for the GL40 grenade launcher and the “Crow Goblin” mask.

english.name: Big Bada Boom
english.description: Kill at least four enemies with one GL40 grenade launcher shot. Unlocks the Sawed-off Stock for the GL40 grenade launcher and the “Crow Goblin” mask.

french.name: Gros badaboum
french.description: Tuez au moins 4 ennemis avec un seul tir du lance-grenades GL40. Débloque la crosse sciée pour le GL40 et le masque "Corbelin".

german.name: Kawumm!
german.description: Töte mindestens vier Feinde mit einem Schuss aus dem GL40-Granatwerfer. Schaltet den abgesägten Schaft für den GL40-Granatwerfer und die Maske "Krähenkobold" frei.

italian.name: Esplosione atomica
italian.description: Uccidi almeno quattro nemici con un singolo colpo del lanciagranate GL40. Sblocca il Calcio tagliato per il lanciagranate GL40 e la maschera "IL GOBLIN CORVO".

russian.name: Большой бум
russian.description: Убейте не менее четырёх противников одним выстрелом из гранатомёта GL40. Выполнение достижения открывает спиленный приклад для GL40 и маску "Ворогоблин".

schinese.name: 轰天巨响
schinese.description: 用GL40榴弹发射器一发射击击杀至少4名敌人。解锁GL40榴弹发射器的锯短枪托和“鸦妖”面具。

spanish.name: ¡BADA BUM!
spanish.description: Mata al menos a 4 enemigos con una explosión del Lanzagranadas GL40. Desbloquea la “Culata recortada” para el Lanzagranadas GL40 y la máscara “Duende Cuervo”.

dutch.name: Army of One
dutch.description: Equip the GL40 grenade launcher, the Locomotive 12G shotgun, and the Improved Combined Tactical Vest. Unlocks the CQB Foregrip and Plastic Stock for the Gecko 7.62 rifle.

english.name: Army of One
english.description: Equip the GL40 grenade launcher, the Locomotive 12G shotgun, and the Improved Combined Tactical Vest. Unlocks the CQB Foregrip and Plastic Stock for the Gecko 7.62 rifle.

french.name: Une armée à lui seul
french.description: Équipez-vous du lance-grenades GL40, du fusil à pompe Locomotive 12G et du Gilet tactique polyvalent amélioré. Débloque la poignée avant combat rapproché et la crosse en plastique pour le fusil Gecko 7.62.

german.name: Ein-Mann-Armee
german.description: Rüste den GL40-Granatwerfer, die Locomotive-12G-Schrotflinte und die verbesserte taktische Panzerweste aus. Schaltet den CQB-Handgriff und den Plastikschaft für das Gecko-7.62-Gewehr frei.

italian.name: Un uomo, un esercito
italian.description: Equipaggia il lanciagranate GL40, il fucile a pompa Locomotive 12G e il giubbotto tattico combinato migliorato. Sblocca l'Impugnatura da combattimenti ravvicinati e il Calcio in plastica per il fucile Gecko 7.62.

russian.name: Один в поле - воин
russian.description: Выберите в инвентаре гранатомёт GL40, дробовик Locomotive 12G и улучшенный КТЖ. Выполнение достижения открывает цевьё CQB и пластиковый приклад для винтовки Gecko 7.62.

schinese.name: 一人成军
schinese.description: 装备GL40榴弹发射器、机车12G霰弹枪和改进型联合战术背心。解锁壁虎7.62步枪的CQB前握把和塑料枪托。

spanish.name: Ejército de uno
spanish.description: Equipa el Lanzagranadas GL40, la Escopeta Locomotora 12G y el Chaleco Táctico Combinado Mejorado al mismo tiempo. Desbloquea el “Guardamanos y cañón para CQB” y la “Culata plástica” para el Fusil Geco 7,62.

dutch.name: So Many Choices
dutch.description: Own one of every Gage Assault Pack weapon in the game. Unlocks the Short Barrel for the Clarion rifle, Light Stock for the Gecko 7.62 rifle, Plastic Foregrip and Assault Kit for the Gewehr 3 rifle, “Evil” material and “Vicious” pattern.

english.name: So Many Choices
english.description: Own one of every Gage Assault Pack weapon in the game. Unlocks the Short Barrel for the Clarion rifle, Light Stock for the Gecko 7.62 rifle, Plastic Foregrip and Assault Kit for the Gewehr 3 rifle, “Evil” material and “Vicious” pattern.

french.name: L'embarras du choix
french.description: Possédez un exemplaire de chaque arme du Gage Assault Pack en jeu. Débloque le canon court pour le fusil Clarion, la crosse légère pour le fusil Gecko 7.62, la poignée avant en plastique et le kit Assaut pour le fusil Gewehr 3, le matériau "Maléfique" et le motif "Vicieux".

german.name: Die Qual der Wahl
german.description: Besitze eine von jeder Waffe des Gage Assault Pack im Spiel. Schaltet den kurzen Lauf für das Clarion-Gewehr, den leichten Schaft für das Gecko-7.62-Gewehr, den Plastik-Handgriff und den Angriffsrüstsatz für das G3 -Gewehr, das Material "Böse" und das Muster "Bösartig" frei.

italian.name: Imbarazzo della scelta
italian.description: Acquista ogni singola arma del DLC Gage Assault Pack. Sblocca la canna corta per il fucile Clarion, il calcio leggero per il fucile Gecko 7.62, l'impugnatura anteriore in plastica e il kit d'assalto per il fucile Gewehr 3, il materiale "MALVAGIO" e il motivo "CRUDELE".

russian.name: Так много выбора
russian.description: Одновременно имейте в инвентаре всё оружие из комплекта дополнений Gage Assault Pack. Выполнение достижения открывает укороченный ствол для винтовки Clarion, лёгкий приклад для винтовки Gecko 7.62, пластиковое цевьё, штурмовой набор для винтовки Gewehr 3, а также материал "Злобный" и рисунок "Порочный".

schinese.name: 选择真多
schinese.description: 拥有游戏中每种盖奇突击包武器各一把。解锁克拉里恩步枪的短枪管、壁虎7.62步枪的轻型枪托、格韦尔3步枪的塑料前握把与突击套件，以及“邪恶”材质和“凶残”图案。

spanish.name: Demasiado a elegir
spanish.description: Compra todas las armas del “Gage Assault Pack”. Desbloquea el “Cañón corto” para el Fusil Clarion, la “Culata ligera” para el Fusil Geco 7,62, el “Guardamanos plástico” y el “Kit de asalto” para el Gewehr 3, el material “Maligno” y el patrón “Cruel”.

dutch.name: Artillery Barrage
dutch.description: Kill 25 enemies at 40 meters or more using only the GL40 grenade launcher. Unlocks the Wooden Stock for the Gecko 7.62 rifle, Pirate Barrel for the GL40 grenade launcher, “Bone” material and “Muerte” pattern.

english.name: Artillery Barrage
english.description: Kill 25 enemies at 40 meters or more using only the GL40 grenade launcher. Unlocks the Wooden Stock for the Gecko 7.62 rifle, Pirate Barrel for the GL40 grenade launcher, “Bone” material and “Muerte” pattern.

french.name: Tir de barrage
french.description: Tuez 25 ennemis situés à plus de 40 mètres uniquement à l'aide du lance-grenades GL40. Débloque la crosse en bois pour le fusil Gecko 7.62, le canon pirate pour le GL40, le matériau "Os" et le motif "Muerte".

german.name: Artilleriebeschuss
german.description: Töte nur mit dem GL40-Granatwerfer 25 Feinde aus 40 Meter Entfernung. Schaltet den Holzschaft für das Gecko-7.62-Gewehr, den Piratenlauf für den GL40-Granatwerfer, das Material "Knochen" und das Muster "Muerte" frei.

italian.name: Fuoco di sbarramento
italian.description: Uccidi 25 nemici da 40 metri di distanza usando soltanto il lanciagranate GL40. Sblocca il Calcio in legno per il fucile Gecko 7.62, la Canna da pirata per il lanciagrante GL40, il materiale "OSSO" e il motivo "MUERTE".

russian.name: Артиллерийский огонь
russian.description: Убейте 25 противников с дистанции не менее 40 метров с помощью гранатомёта GL40. Выполнение достижения открывает деревянный приклад для винтовки Gecko 7.62, пиратский ствол для GL40, материал "Костяной" и рисунок "Гибель".

schinese.name: 炮火覆盖
schinese.description: 仅使用GL40榴弹发射器在40米或更远距离击杀25名敌人。解锁壁虎7.62步枪的木制枪托、GL40榴弹发射器的海盗枪管，以及“骨头”材质和“穆尔特”图案。

spanish.name: Barrido de artillería
spanish.description: Mata a 25 enemigos desde 40 metros o más con el Lanzagranadas GL40. Desbloquea la “Culata de madera” para el Fusil Geco 7,62, el “Cañón pirata” para el lanzagranadas GL40, el material “Hueso” y el patrón “Muerte”.

dutch.name: Unusual Suspects
dutch.description: In the Watchdogs job, complete the heist while you and your four man crew are wearing one different Assault Pack mask each on OVERKILL difficulty or above. Unlocks the Light Foregrip for the Gecko 7.62 rifle, Tactical Foregrip for the Gewehr 3 rifle, Long Barrel for the Clarion rifle, “Void” material and “Death” pattern.

english.name: Unusual Suspects
english.description: In the Watchdogs job, complete the heist while you and your four man crew are wearing one different Assault Pack mask each on OVERKILL difficulty or above. Unlocks the Light Foregrip for the Gecko 7.62 rifle, Tactical Foregrip for the Gewehr 3 rifle, Long Barrel for the Clarion rifle, “Void” material and “Death” pattern.

french.name: Unusual Suspects
french.description: Terminez le contrat Chiens de garde, en difficulté OVERKILL ou supérieure, alors que chaque membre de votre équipe de 4 porte un masque du Gage Assault Pack différent. Débloque la poignée avant légère pour le fusil Gecko 7.62, la poignée avant tactique pour le fusil Gewehr 3, le canon long pour le fusil Clarion, le matériau "Néant" et le motif "La mort".

german.name: Die unüblichen Verdächtigen
german.description: Beende den Wachhunde-Überfall auf der Schwierigkeit OVERKILL oder höher, wobei jedes der 4 Crewmitglieder eine andere Assault-Pack-Maske trägt. Schaltet den leichten Handgriff für das Gecko-7.62-Gewehr, den taktischen Handgriff für das G3-Gewehr, den langen Lauf füg das Clarion-Gewehr, das Material "Leere" und das Muster "Tod" frei.

italian.name: Gli insoliti sospetti
italian.description: Completa il contratto "CANI DA GUARDIA" in difficoltà OVERKILL o superiore facendo in modo che tutti i membri della squadra indossino una maschera diversa del DLC Gage Assault Pack. Sblocca l'impugnatura anteriore leggera per il fucile Gecko 7.62, l'impugnatura anteriore tattica per il fucile Gewehr 3, la canna lunga per il fucile Clarion, il materiale "VUOTO" e il motivo "MORTE".

russian.name: Необычные подозреваемые
russian.description: Завершите контракт "Сторожевые псы" вчетвером на уровне сложности "OVERKILL" или выше так, чтобы все члены команды носили 4 разные маски из комплекта дополнений "Assault Pack". Выполнение достижения открывает лёгкое цевьё для винтовки Gecko 7.62, тактическое цевьё для винтовки Gewehr 3, удлинённый ствол для винтовки Clarion, а также материал "Вакуумный" и рисунок "Гибель".

schinese.name: 非同寻常的嫌犯
schinese.description: 在“看门狗”任务中，以OVERKILL或更高难度完成劫案，且你与四人小队的每名成员各自佩戴不同的突击包面具。解锁壁虎7.62步枪的轻型前握把、格韦尔3步枪的战术前握把、克拉里恩步枪的长枪管，以及“虚空”材质和“死亡”图案。

spanish.name: Sospechosos inusuales
spanish.description: Completa el trabajo Perros Guardianes mientras tú y tu equipo de cuatro usan una máscara diferente del “Gage Assault Pack” en la dificultad OVERKILL o más alta. Desbloquea el "Guardamanos y cañón ligeros" para el Fusil Geco 7,62, el "Guardamanos táctico" para el Gewehr 3, el "Cañón largo" para el Fusil Clarion, el material “Vacío” y el patrón “La Muerte”.

dutch.name: Not Today
dutch.description: Kill a jumping Cloaker using the GL40 grenade launcher. Unlocks the Wooden Stock, Retro Grip and Wooden Foregrip for the Gewehr 3 rifle.

english.name: Not Today
english.description: Kill a jumping Cloaker using the GL40 grenade launcher. Unlocks the Wooden Stock, Retro Grip and Wooden Foregrip for the Gewehr 3 rifle.

french.name: Pas cette fois
french.description: Tuez un Cloaker à l'aide du lance-grenades GL40 alors qu'il assène un coup de pied sauté. Débloque la crosse en bois, la poignée rétro et la poignée avant en bois pour le fusil Gewehr 3.

german.name: Heute nicht
german.description: Töte einen springenden Cloaker mit dem GL40-Granatwerfer. Schaltet den Holzschaft, Retro-Griff und Holzhandgriff für das G3-Gewehr frei.

italian.name: Non oggi
italian.description: Uccidi un Cloaker con il lanciagranate GL40 mentre esegue un calcio volante. Sblocca il Calcio in legno, l'Impugnatura vecchio stile e l'Impugnatura anteriore per il fucile Gewehr 3.

russian.name: Не сегодня
russian.description: Убейте прыгающего клокера с помощью гранатомёта GL40. Выполнение достижения открывает деревянный приклад, деревянное цевьё и рукоять "Ретро" для винтовки Gewehr 3.

schinese.name: 今天不行
schinese.description: 使用GL40榴弹发射器击杀一名跳跃中的伏兵。解锁格韦尔3步枪的木制枪托、复古握把和木制前握把。

spanish.name: ¡No esta vez!
spanish.description: Mata a un Cloaker con el Lanzagranadas GL40 mientras hace una patada voladora. Desbloquea la “Culata de madera”, la “Empuñadura retro” y el “Guardamanos de madera” para el Gewehr 3.

dutch.name: Hammertime
dutch.description: Kill 25 thugs using the Ding Dong breaching tool melee weapon. Unlocks the “Frost” material and “Emperor” pattern.

english.name: Hammertime
english.description: Kill 25 thugs using the Ding Dong breaching tool melee weapon. Unlocks the “Frost” material and “Emperor” pattern.

french.name: Si j'avais un marteau
french.description: Tuez 25 gangsters à l'aide de la masse Ding Dong. Débloque le matériau "Givre" et le motif "Empereur".

german.name: Palim-Palim
german.description: Töte 25 Schläger mit dem Palim-Palim-Vorschlaghammer. Schaltet das Material "Frost" und das Muster "Kaiser" frei.

italian.name: A martellate
italian.description: Uccidi 25 teppisti con l'arma da mischia "Martello ding dong". Sblocca il materiale "GELO" e il motivo "IMPERATORE".

russian.name: Hammertime
russian.description: Убейте 25 бандитов кувалдой "Тук-тук". Выполнение достижения открывает материал "Морозный" и рисунок "Император".

schinese.name: 锤子时间
schinese.description: 使用“叮咚”破门锤近战武器击杀25名暴徒。解锁“冰霜”材质和“皇帝”图案。

spanish.name: ¡Llegó el Martillo!
spanish.description: Mata a 25 matones usando el Martillo de Brecha Ding Dong. Desbloquea el material “Congelado” y el patrón “Emperador”.

dutch.name: Rabbit Hunting
dutch.description: Kill 10 Cloakers using the Gecko 7.62 rifle. Unlocks the Skeletal Stock, Fabulous Stock and Fabulous Foregrip for the Gecko 7.62 rifle as well as the “Volt” mask.

english.name: Rabbit Hunting
english.description: Kill 10 Cloakers using the Gecko 7.62 rifle. Unlocks the Skeletal Stock, Fabulous Stock and Fabulous Foregrip for the Gecko 7.62 rifle as well as the “Volt” mask.

french.name: Battue aux lièvres
french.description: Tuez 10 Cloakers à l'aide du fusil Gecko 7.62. Débloque la crosse squelettique, la crosse fabuleuse et la poignée avant fabuleuse pour le fusil Gecko 7.62, ainsi que le masque "Volt".

german.name: Hasenjagd
german.description: Töte 10 Cloaker mit dem Gecko-7.62-Gewehr. Schaltet den Skelettschaft, den großartigen Schaft und den großartigen Handgriff für das Gecko-7.62-Gewehr sowie die Maske "Volt" frei.

italian.name: Caccia al coniglio
italian.description: Uccidi 10 Cloaker usando il fucile Gecko 7.62. Sblocca la maschera "VOLT" e il Calcio modello Skeleton, il Calcio di ottima qualità e l'Impugnatura di ottima qualità per il fucile Gecko 7.62.

russian.name: Охота на кроликов
russian.description: Убейте 10 клокеров с помощью винтовки Gecko 7.62. Выполнение достижения открывает скелетный приклад, легендарный приклад, легендарное цевьё для винтовки Gecko 7.62, а также маску "Вольт".

schinese.name: 猎兔行动
schinese.description: 使用壁虎7.62步枪击杀10名伏兵。解锁壁虎7.62步枪的骨骼枪托、华丽枪托和华丽前握把，以及“伏特”面具。

spanish.name: Temporada de conejos
spanish.description: Mata a 10 Cloakers con el Fusil Geco 7,62. Desbloquea la “Culata esquelética”, la “Culata fabulosa”, el “Guardamanos y cañón fabulosos” para el Fusil Geco 7,62 y la máscara “Volt”.

dutch.name: Tour de Clarion
dutch.description: Kill 200 enemies using the Clarion rifle. Unlocks the Suppressed Barrel and G2 Grip for the Clarion rifle as well as the “Professor Wrath” mask.

english.name: Tour de Clarion
english.description: Kill 200 enemies using the Clarion rifle. Unlocks the Suppressed Barrel and G2 Grip for the Clarion rifle as well as the “Professor Wrath” mask.

french.name: Coup de Clarion
french.description: Tuez 200 ennemis à l'aide du fusil Clarion. Débloque le canon silencieux et la poignée G2 pour le fusil Clarion ainsi que le masque "Docteur Courroux".

german.name: Tour de Clarion
german.description: Töte 200 Feinde mit dem Clarion-Gewehr. Schaltet den schallgedämpften Lauf und den G2-Griff für das Clarion-Gewehr sowie die Maske "Professor Wrath" frei.

italian.name: Tour de Clarion
italian.description: Uccidi 200 nemici con il fucile Clarion. Sblocca la canna silenziata e l'impugnatura G2 per il fucile Clarion e la maschera "IL PROFESSOR VIOLENZA".

russian.name: Tour de Clarion
russian.description: Убейте 200 противников с помощью винтовки Clarion. Выполнение достижения открывает приглушенный ствол, рукоять G2 для винтовки Clarion, а также маску "Профессор Гнев".

schinese.name: 环克拉里恩
schinese.description: 使用克拉里恩步枪击杀200名敌人。解锁克拉里恩步枪的消音枪管和G2握把，以及“愤怒教授”面具。

spanish.name: Tour de Clarion
spanish.description: Mata a 200 enemigos con el Fusil Clarion. Desbloquea el “Cañón silenciado” y la “Empuñadura G2” para el Fusil Clarion y la máscara “Profesor Ira”.

dutch.name: Wrong Number
dutch.description: Complete the Hotline Miami job on the Death Wish difficulty or above.

english.name: Wrong Number
english.description: Complete the Hotline Miami job on the Death Wish difficulty or above.

french.name: Wrong Number
french.description: Terminez le contrat Hotline Miami en difficulté Suicidaire.

german.name: Wrong Number
german.description: Beende den Hotline-Miami-Überfall auf der Schwierigkeit Todesmut.

italian.name: Numero sbagliato
italian.description: Completa il contratto "HOTLINE MIAMI" in difficoltà Apocalisse.

russian.name: Wrong Number
russian.description: Завершите контракт "Hotline Miami" на уровне сложности "Жажда смерти".

schinese.name: 打错号码
schinese.description: 以死亡之愿或更高难度完成“迈阿密热线”任务。

spanish.name: Número equivocado
spanish.description: Completa el trabajo Hotline Miami en la dificultad Death Wish.

dutch.name: Walk Faster
dutch.description: In day two of the Hotline Miami job, reach the Commissar’s apartment in under 210 seconds on the OVERKILL difficulty or above. Unlocks the Rasmus mask, Tactical Foregrip and the Ergonomic Stock for the Uzi submachine gun, “Chromescape” material and "Palmtrees" pattern.

english.name: Walk Faster
english.description: In day two of the Hotline Miami job, reach the Commissar’s apartment in under 210 seconds on the OVERKILL difficulty or above. Unlocks the Rasmus mask, Tactical Foregrip and the Ergonomic Stock for the Uzi submachine gun, “Chromescape” material and "Palmtrees" pattern.

french.name: Allez, plus vite !
french.description: Au 2ème jour du contrat Hotline Miami, atteignez l'appartement du Kommissaire en moins de 210 secondes, en difficulté OVERKILL ou supérieure. Débloque le masque "Rasmus", la poignée avant tactique et la crosse ergonomique pour la mitraillette Uzi, le matériau "Paysage chromé" et le motif "Palmiers".

german.name: Geh schneller
german.description: Erreiche am zweiten Tage des Hotline-Miami-Überfalls auf der Schwierigkeit OVERKILL oder höher das Apartment des Kommissar in unter 210 Sekunden. Schaltet die Maske "Rasmus", den taktischen Handgriff und den Ergonomie-Schaft für die Uzi-Maschinenpistole, das Material "Chromescape" und das Muster "Palmen" frei.

italian.name: Più veloce della luce
italian.description: Durante il secondo giorno del contratto "HOTLINE MIAMI", raggiungi l'appartamento del Commissario in meno di 210 secondi in difficoltà OVERKILL o superiore. Sblocca la maschera "RASMUS", l'Impugnatura anteriore tattica e il Calcio ergonomico per la pistola mitragliatrice Uzi, il materiale "CROMO" e il motivo "PALME".

russian.name: Иди быстрее
russian.description: Выполняя второй день контракта "Hotline Miami" на уровне сложности "OVERKILL" или выше, доберитесь до убежища Комиссара не более чем за 210 секунд. Выполнение достижения открывает маску "Расмус", тактическое цевьё и эргономичный приклад для пистолета-пулемёта Uzi, а также материал "Хромированный" и рисунок "Пальмы".

schinese.name: 走快点
schinese.description: 在“迈阿密热线”任务第二天，以OVERKILL或更高难度在210秒内抵达政委的公寓。解锁拉斯穆斯面具、乌兹冲锋枪的战术前握把与人体工学枪托，以及“铬色景观”材质和“棕榈树”图案。

spanish.name: Camina más rápido
spanish.description: En el día 2 del trabajo Hotline Miami, llega al apartamento del Comisario en menos de 210 segundos en la dificultad OVERKILL o más alta. Desbloquea la máscara “Rasmus”, la "Empuñadura frontal táctica", la "Culata ergonómica" para la Metralleta Uzi, el material “Escape de cromo” y el patrón “Palmeras”.

dutch.name: Do You Like Hurting Other People?
dutch.description: In the Hotline Miami job, kill 30 thugs with the Baseball Bat. Unlocks the Dennis mask, Solid Stock for the Uzi submachine gun, Wooden Grip for the Cobra submachine gun, "Rubber" material and "Hip to Be Polygon" pattern.

english.name: Do You Like Hurting Other People?
english.description: In the Hotline Miami job, kill 30 thugs with the Baseball Bat. Unlocks the Dennis mask, Solid Stock for the Uzi submachine gun, Wooden Grip for the Cobra submachine gun, "Rubber" material and "Hip to Be Polygon" pattern.

french.name: Vous aimez faire du mal aux gens ?
french.description: Dans le contrat Hotline Miami, tuez 30 mafieux à l'aide de la batte de baseball. Débloque le masque "Dennis", la crosse pleine pour la mitraillette Uzi, la poignée en bois pour la mitraillette Cobra, le matériau "Caoutchouc" et le motif "Polygone à la mode".

german.name: Tust du gern anderen Menschen weh?
german.description: Töte beim Hotline-Miami-Überfall 30 Schläger mit dem Baseballschläger. Schaltet die Maske "Dennis", den festen Schaft für die Uzi-Maschinenpistole, den Holzgriff für die Cobra-Maschinenpistole, Das Material "Gummi" und das Muster "Hippe Polygone" frei.

italian.name: Ti piace far male alle altre persone?
italian.description: Durante il contratto "HOTLINE MIAMI", uccidi 30 mafiosi con la mazza da baseball. Sblocca il calcio compatto per la pistola mitragliatrice Uzi, l'impugnatura in legno per la pistola mitragliatrice Cobra, la maschera "DENNIS", il materiale "GOMMA" e il motivo "POLIGONO".

russian.name: Тебе нравится причинять людям боль?
russian.description: Выполняя контракт "Hotline Miami", убейте 30 бандитов бейсбольной битой. Выполнение достижения открывает маску "Деннис", прочный приклад для пистолета-пулемёта Uzi, деревянную рукоять для пистолета-пулемёта Cobra, а также материал "Резина" и рисунок "Многоугольник".

schinese.name: 你喜欢伤害他人吗？
schinese.description: 在“迈阿密热线”任务中，使用棒球棒击杀30名暴徒。解锁丹尼斯面具、乌兹冲锋枪的实心枪托、眼镜蛇冲锋枪的木制握把，以及“橡胶”材质和“多边形才够酷”图案。

spanish.name: ¿Te gusta herir a otras personas?
spanish.description: En el trabajo Hotline Miami, mata a 30 mafiosos rusos usando el Bate de Béisbol. Desbloquea la máscara “Dennis”, la “Culata sólida” para la Metralleta Uzi, la “Empuñadura de madera” para la Metralleta Cobra, el material “Goma” y el patrón “Hip to Be Polygon”.

dutch.name: Overdose
dutch.description: Cook and secure six bags of meth on day one of the Hotline Miami job. Unlocks the Graham mask, Ghetto Blaster, Extended Mag and Just Bend It for the Blaster 9mm submachine gun, "Error" material and "Be Somebody" pattern.

english.name: Overdose
english.description: Cook and secure six bags of meth on day one of the Hotline Miami job. Unlocks the Graham mask, Ghetto Blaster, Extended Mag and Just Bend It for the Blaster 9mm submachine gun, "Error" material and "Be Somebody" pattern.

french.name: Overdose
french.description: Préparez et récupérez 6 sacs de méthamphétamine lors du 1er jour du contrat Hotline Miami. Débloque le masque "Graham", le Ghetto Blaster, le chargeur à grande capacité et la "Y'a qu'à la plier" pour la mitraillette Blaster 9mm, le matériau "Erreur" et le motif "Sois quelqu'un".

german.name: Überdosis
