german.description: Koche und sichere am ersten Tag des Hotline-Miami-Überfalls sechs Methbeutel. Schaltet die Maske "Graham", den Ghetto-Blaster, das größere Magazin und den "Einfach zusammenklappen"-Schaft für die Blaster-9mm-Maschinenpistole, das Material "Fehler" und das Muster "Sei jemand" frei.

italian.name: Overdose
italian.description: Durante il contratto "HOTLINE MIAMI", cucina e metti al sicuro sei borsoni di metanfetamina. Sblocca la maschera "GRAHAM", l'Estensione da ghetto, il Caricatore maggiorato e il Calcio pieghevole per la pistola mitragliatrice Blaster 9mm, il materiale "ERRORE" e il motivo "SII QUALCUNO".

russian.name: Передозировка
russian.description: Выполняя первый день контракта "Hotline Miami", приготовьте и унесите с собой шесть сумок с метом. Выполнение достижения открывает маску "Грэхем", гетто Бластер, увеличенный магазин, приклад "Поставь меня" для пистолета-пулемёта Blaster 9mm, а также материал "Ошибка" и рисунок "Стань кем-нибудь".

schinese.name: 用药过量
schinese.description: 在《迈阿密热线》任务第一日烹制并回收六袋冰毒。解锁格雷厄姆面具、爆破者9毫米冲锋枪的贫民窟音响、加长弹匣和“弯就完了”配件，以及“错误”材质和“成为大人物”图案。

spanish.name: Sobredosis
spanish.description: En el día 1 del trabajo Hotline Miami, cocina y asegura 6 lotes de metanfetamina. Desbloquea la máscara “Graham”, el “Revientaguetos”, el “Cargador ampliado”, la culata “Solo Dóblala” para la Reventadora de 9 mm, el material “Error” y el patrón “Sé alguien”.

dutch.name: Sounds of Animals Fighting
dutch.description: In the Hotline Miami job, complete the heist while you and your four man crew are wearing one different Hotline Miami mask each on hard or above. Unlocks the Silent Death and Folded Stock for the Uzi submachine gun, Suppressor and No Stock for the Cobra submachine gun and Short Barrel for the Blaster 9mm submachine gun.

english.name: Sounds of Animals Fighting
english.description: In the Hotline Miami job, complete the heist while you and your four man crew are wearing one different Hotline Miami mask each on hard or above. Unlocks the Silent Death and Folded Stock for the Uzi submachine gun, Suppressor and No Stock for the Cobra submachine gun and Short Barrel for the Blaster 9mm submachine gun.

french.name: Sounds of Animals Fighting
french.description: Terminez le contrat Hotline Miami, en difficulté Difficile ou supérieure, alors que chaque membre de votre équipe de 4 porte un masque Hotline Miami différent. Débloque la "Mort silencieuse" et la crosse pliée pour la mitraillette Uzi, le silencieux et le "Pas de crosse" pour la mitraillette Cobra ainsi que le canon court pour la mitraillette Blaster 9mm.

german.name: Der Klang kämpfender Tiere
german.description: Beende den Hotline-Miami-Überfall auf der Schwierigkeit Schwer oder höher, wobei jedes der 4 Crewmitglieder eine andere Hotline-Miami-Maske trägt. Schaltet die "Leiser-Tod"-Lauf und den abgeklappten Schaft für die Uzi-Maschinenpistole, den Schalldämpfer und kein Schaft für die Cobra-Maschinenpistole und den kurzen Lauf für die Blaster-9mm-Maschinenpistole frei.

italian.name: Il richiamo della foresta
italian.description: Completa il contratto "HOTLINE MIAMI" in difficoltà Difficile o superiore mentre tutti i membri della squadra indossano una maschera diversa di Hotline Miami. Sblocca il Silenziatore e il Calcio ripiegato per la pistola mitragliatrice Uzi, il Silenziatore e il Calcio rimosso per la pistola mitragliatrice Cobra e la Canna corta per la pistola mitragliatrice Blaster 9mm.

russian.name: Звуки животной борьбы
russian.description: Завершите контракт "Hotline Miami" вчетвером на сложности "Сложно" или выше так, чтобы все члены команды носили 4 разных маски из комплекта дополнений "Hotline Miami". Выполнение достижения открывает глушитель "Бесшумная смерть", сложенный приклад для пистолета-пулемёта Uzi, глушитель и модификацию "Без приклада" для пистолета-пулемёта Cobra, а также укороченный ствол для пистолета-пулемёта Blaster 9mm.

schinese.name: 动物搏斗之声
schinese.description: 在《迈阿密热线》任务中，于困难或更高难度下，你和你的四人小队每人佩戴一个不同的《迈阿密热线》面具完成劫案。解锁乌兹冲锋枪的寂静死亡和折叠枪托、眼镜蛇冲锋枪的消音器和无枪托，以及爆破者9毫米冲锋枪的短枪管。

spanish.name: Sonidos de animales peleando
spanish.description: Completa el trabajo Hotline Miami mientras tú y tu equipo de cuatro usan una máscara diferente de Hotline Miami (Rasmus, Dennis, Graham y Aubrey) en la dificultad Difícil o más alta. Desbloquea el supresor "Muerte Silenciosa” y la “Culata plegada” para la Metralleta Uzi, el "Supresor" y la culata “Sin Culata” para la Metralleta Cobra y el “Cañón corto” para la Reventadora de 9 mm.

dutch.name: Phew!
dutch.description: On day two of the Hotline Miami job, save someone in need. Unlocks the Aubrey mask, Ergo Grip, Extended Mag and Unfolded Stock for the Cobra submachine gun, "Sunset" material and "Doodles" pattern.

english.name: Phew!
english.description: On day two of the Hotline Miami job, save someone in need. Unlocks the Aubrey mask, Ergo Grip, Extended Mag and Unfolded Stock for the Cobra submachine gun, "Sunset" material and "Doodles" pattern.

french.name: Ouf !
french.description: Au 2ème jour du contrat Hotline Miami, sauvez quelqu'un qui en a bien besoin. Débloque le masque "Aubrey", la poignée ergonomique, le chargeur à grande capacité et la crosse dépliée pour la mitraillette Cobra, le matériau "Coucher de soleil" et le motif "Gribouillis".

german.name: Puh!
german.description: Rette am zweiten Tag des Hotline-Miami-Profi-Überfalls jemanden in Not. Schaltet die Maske "Aubrey", den Ergo-Griff, das größere Magazin und den aufgeklappten Schaft für die Cobra-Maschinenpistole, das Material "Sonnenuntergang" und das Muster "Doodles" frei.

italian.name: C'è mancato poco!
italian.description: Durante il secondo giorno del contratto "HOTLINE MIAMI", salva qualcuno in difficoltà. Sblocca la maschera "AUBREY", l'impugnatura ergonomica, il caricatore esteso e il calcio disteso per la pistola mitragliatrice Cobra, il materiale "TRAMONTO" e il motivo "SCARABOCCHI".

russian.name: Фух!
russian.description: Выполняя контракт "Hotline Miami", помогите нуждающемуся. Выполнение достижения открывает маску "Обри", эргономичную рукоять, увеличенный магазин и развёрнутый приклад для пистолета-пулемёта Cobra, а также материал "Закат" и рисунок "Каракули".

schinese.name: 好险！
schinese.description: 在《迈阿密热线》任务第二日，救助需要帮助的人。解锁奥布里面具、眼镜蛇冲锋枪的人体工学握把、加长弹匣和展开枪托，以及“日落”材质和“涂鸦”图案。

spanish.name: ¡Uff!
spanish.description: En el día 2 del trabajo Hotline Miami, salva a cierta persona en apuros. Desbloquea la máscara “Aubrey”, la "Empuñadura ergonómica", el "Cargador doble", la "Culata desplegada" para la Metralleta Cobra, el material “Atardecer” y el patrón “Garabatos”.

dutch.name: State of the Art
dutch.description: Complete the Art Gallery heist on the Death Wish difficulty or above.

english.name: State of the Art
english.description: Complete the Art Gallery heist on the Death Wish difficulty or above.

french.name: Du grand art
french.description: Terminez le contrat Musée d'art en difficulté Suicidaire.

german.name: Kunststück
german.description: Beende den Kunstgalerie-Überfall auf der Schwierigkeit Todesmut.

italian.name: Stato dell'arte
italian.description: Completa il contratto "GALLERIA D'ARTE" in difficoltà Apocalisse.

russian.name: Современное искусство
russian.description: Завершите контракт "Художественая галерея" на уровне сложности "Жажда смерти".

schinese.name: 艺术前沿
schinese.description: 在死亡之愿或更高难度下完成美术馆劫案。

spanish.name: Arte-facto
spanish.description: Completa el trabajo Galería de Arte en la dificultad Death Wish.

dutch.name: Why Don't We Just Use a Spoon?
dutch.description: Complete the  Hoxton Breakout heist on the Normal difficulty or above. Unlocks "Hoxton" as a playable character and the "Nova's Shank" melee weapon.

english.name: Why Don't We Just Use a Spoon?
english.description: Complete the  Hoxton Breakout heist on the Normal difficulty or above. Unlocks "Hoxton" as a playable character and the "Nova's Shank" melee weapon.

french.name: Autant utiliser une cuillère
french.description: Terminez le contrat Évasion d'Hoxton dans n'importe quelle difficulté.

german.name: Warum nehmen wir nicht einfach einen Löffel?
german.description: Beende den Hoxton-Ausbruch auf einer beliebigen Schwierigkeit.

italian.name: Perché non usiamo un cucchiaio?
italian.description: Completa il contratto "VENDETTA DI HOXTON" in qualsiasi difficoltà.

russian.name: Почеу бы нам просто не использовать ложку?
russian.description: Завершите контракт "Спасение Хокстона" на любой сложности.

schinese.name: 咱们何不用勺子？
schinese.description: 在普通或更高难度下完成霍克斯顿突围劫案。解锁“霍克斯顿”作为可用角色，以及“诺瓦之刺”近战武器。

spanish.name: ¿Y por qué mejor no usamos una cuchara?
spanish.description: Completa el trabajo La Fuga de Hoxton en cualquier dificultad.

dutch.name: No Bars Can Hold Me
dutch.description: Complete the Hoxton Breakout heist on the Death Wish difficulty or above.

english.name: No Bars Can Hold Me
english.description: Complete the Hoxton Breakout heist on the Death Wish difficulty or above.

french.name: Aucune prison, aucun barreau ne me résiste
french.description: Terminez le contrat Évasion d'Hoxton en difficulté Suicidaire.

german.name: Keine Gitter könne mich halten
german.description: Beende den Hoxton-Ausbruch auf der Schwierigkeit Todesmut.

italian.name: Nessuna prigione può fermarmi
italian.description: Completa il contratto "EVASIONE DI HOXTON" in difficoltà Apocalisse.

russian.name: За решёткой меня не удержишь
russian.description: Завершите контракт "Спасение хокстона" на уровне сложности "Жажда смерти".

schinese.name: 铁窗关不住我
schinese.description: 在死亡之愿或更高难度下完成霍克斯顿突围劫案。

spanish.name: No hay rejas que me retengan
spanish.description: Completa el trabajo La Fuga de Hoxton en la dificultad Death Wish.

dutch.name: Cavity
dutch.description: Hurt an enemy using the Nova's Shank melee weapon.

english.name: Cavity
english.description: Hurt an enemy using the Nova's Shank melee weapon.

french.name: Carie
french.description: Blessez un ennemi à la mêlée avec le Surin de Nova.

german.name: Zahnfleischbluten
german.description: Verletze einen Feind mit der Nahkampfwaffe "Novas Schaft".

italian.name: Carie
italian.description: Colpisci un nemico con lo spazzolino NOVA.

russian.name: Полость рта
russian.description: Раньте противника заточкой Новы.

schinese.name: 穿孔
schinese.description: 使用“诺瓦之刺”近战武器伤害一名敌人。

spanish.name: Carie
spanish.description: Hiere a un enemigo usando la Navaja Casera de Nova.

dutch.name: Sixth Nightmare
dutch.description: Complete the Safe House Nightmare job on the Death Wish difficulty or above.

english.name: Sixth Nightmare
english.description: Complete the Safe House Nightmare job on the Death Wish difficulty or above.

french.name: Cinquième cauchemar
french.description: Ceci est un succès secret. Il peut uniquement être obtenu au cours de l'événement Halloween annuel !

german.name: Fünfter Albtraum
german.description: Dies ist eine geheime Errungenschaft. Sie ist nur während des jährlichen Halloween-Events verfügbar!

italian.name: Quinto incubo
italian.description: Questo è un achievement segreto che può essere ottenuto solamente durante l'evento annuale di Halloween!

russian.name: Пятый кошмар
russian.description: Это секретное достижение. Его можно получить только во время ежегодного празднования Хэллоуина.

schinese.name: 第六梦魇
schinese.description: 在死亡之愿或更高难度下完成安全屋梦魇任务。

spanish.name: Quinta pesadilla
spanish.description: Este es un logro secreto. ¡Solo es obtenible durante el evento anual de Halloween!

dutch.name: Death From Below
dutch.description: Kill 25 enemies as they rappel using the Nagant sniper rifle. Unlocks the Constable mask, the Silenced Barrel and the Long Barrel for the Nagant sniper rifle, “Gunsmoke” material and “Dazzle” pattern.

english.name: Death From Below
english.description: Kill 25 enemies as they rappel using the Nagant sniper rifle. Unlocks the Constable mask, the Silenced Barrel and the Long Barrel for the Nagant sniper rifle, “Gunsmoke” material and “Dazzle” pattern.

french.name: La mort venue d'en bas
french.description: Tuez 25 ennemis alors qu'ils descendent en rappel à l'aide du fusil de précision Nagant. Débloque le masque "Le Gendarme", le canon silencieux et le canon long pour le fusil de précision Nagant, le matériau "Canon fumant" et le motif "Tape-à-l'oeil".

german.name: Tod von unte
german.description: Töte mit dem Nagant-Scharfschützengewehr 25 Feinde, während sie sich abseilen. Schaltet die Maske "Konstabel", den schallgedämpften Lauf und den langen Lauf für das Nagant-Scharfschützengewehr, das Material "Pulverdampf" und das Muster "Grell" frei.

italian.name: Morte dal basso
italian.description: Uccidi 25 nemici mentre si calano con la corda usando soltanto il fucile di precisione Nagant. Sblocca la maschera "IL CONNESTABILE", la Canna silenziata e la Canna lunga per il fucile di precisione Nagant, il materiale "FUOCO E FIAMME" e il motivo "BAGLIORE".

russian.name: Патрон земля-воздух
russian.description: Убейте 25 противников, спускающихся по канату, с помощью винтовки Nagant. Выполнение достижения открывает маску "Констебль", приглушённый ствол и удлинённый ствол для винтовки Nagant, а также материал "Дым из ствола" и рисунок "Блеск".

schinese.name: 来自下方的死亡
schinese.description: 使用纳甘狙击步枪击杀25名正在索降的敌人。解锁警员面具、纳甘狙击步枪的静音枪管和长枪管，以及“硝烟”材质和“炫目”图案。

spanish.name: Muerte desde abajo
spanish.description: Mata a 25 enemigos con el Fusil de Francotirador Nagant mientras que hacen rápel. Desbloquea la máscara “Alguacil”, el “Cañón especial con supresor” y el “Cañón largo” para el Fusil de Francotirador Nagant, el material “Humo de arma” y el patrón “Resplandor”.

dutch.name: Special Operations Execution
dutch.description: Kill 25 enemies while in stealth using the Trench knife. Unlocks the Red Bear mask, Short Barrel, Suppressed Barrel, Short Mag, Folded Stock, No Stock, Solid Stock, Heatsinked Suppressed Barrel for the Patchett L2A1 submachine gun, Barrel Sight 44, Damper.L 44 Nozzle for the Broomstick pistol, “Red Sun” material and “Death Dealer” pattern.

english.name: Special Operations Execution
english.description: Kill 25 enemies while in stealth using the Trench knife. Unlocks the Red Bear mask, Short Barrel, Suppressed Barrel, Short Mag, Folded Stock, No Stock, Solid Stock, Heatsinked Suppressed Barrel for the Patchett L2A1 submachine gun, Barrel Sight 44, Damper.L 44 Nozzle for the Broomstick pistol, “Red Sun” material and “Death Dealer” pattern.

french.name: Services secrets tyranniques
french.description: Tuez 25 ennemis discrètement à l'aide du couteau de tranchée. Débloque le masque "L'Ours rouge", le canon court, le canon silencieux, le chargeur réduit, la crosse pliée, le "Pas de crosse", la crosse pleine, le silencieux dissipateur de chaleur pour la mitraillette Patchett L2A1, la lunette de canon 44, l'embout Damper.L 44 pour le pistolet Broomstick, le matériau "Soleil rouge" et le motif "Ange de la mort".

german.name: SEK-Hinrichtung
german.description: Töte mit dem Grabendolch 25 Feinde im Schleich-Modus. Schaltet die Maske "Roter Bär", den kurzen Lauf, den schallgedämpften Lauf, das kurze Magazin, den abgeklappten Schaft, kein Schaft, den festen Schaft, den schallgedämpften Lauf mit Kühlkörper für die Patchett-L2A1-Maschinenpistole, das Laufvisier 44, die Dämpfer-L44-Mündung für die Broomstick-Pistole, das Material "Rote Sonne" und das Muster "Todeshändler" frei.

italian.name: Operazioni speciali
italian.description: Uccidi silenziosamente 25 nemici usando il Coltello da trincea. Sblocca la maschera "L'ORSO ROSSO", la Canna corta, la Canna silenziata, il Caricatore ridotto, il Calcio ripiegato, il Calcio rimosso, il Calcio solido, il Dissipatore silenziato per la pistola mitragliatrice Patchett L2A1, il Mirino 44, l'Estensione modello Damper.L per la pistola Broomstick, il materiale "SOLE ROSSO" e il motivo "SOFFIO DELLA MORTE".

russian.name: Тайный агент
russian.description: Убейте 25 противников траншейным ножом, не поднимая тревоги. Выполнение достижения открывает маску "Красный медведь", укороченный ствол, приглушённый ствол, укороченный магазин, сложенный приклад, модификацию "без приклада", прочный приклад и приглушённый ствол с перфорацией для пистолета-пулемёта Patchett L2A1. Достижение также открывает прицел на ствол 44, пламегаситель .L 44 для пистолета Broomstick, а также материал "Красное солнце" и рисунок "Торговец смертью".

schinese.name: 特种作战执行
schinese.description: 使用战壕刀在潜行状态下击杀25名敌人。解锁红熊面具、帕切特L2A1冲锋枪的短枪管、消音枪管、短弹匣、折叠枪托、无枪托、固定枪托和散热消音枪管，扫帚柄手枪的44式枪管瞄具和L型阻尼44喷嘴，以及“红日”材质和“死亡贩子”图案。

spanish.name: Ejecución de operaciones especiales
spanish.description: Mata a 25 enemigos en sigilo usando el "Cuchillo de Trinchera". Desbloquea la máscara “El Oso Rojo”, el “Cañón corto”, el “Cañón silenciado”, el “Cargador pequeño”, la “Culata plegada”, la culata “Sin Culata”, la “Culata sólida” y el “Cañón disipado silenciado” para la Metralleta "Patchett L2A1", la “Mira óptica de cañón 44”, la boquilla “Damper.L 44” para la Pistola "Broomstick", el material “Sol rojo” y el patrón “Repartidor de muerte”.

dutch.name: Wind of Change
dutch.description: In the Hoxton Breakout job, complete the heist while you and your four man crew are wearing one different "Historical" mask each on OVERKILL difficulty or above. Unlocks the Discrete Stock and Short Barrel for the Nagant sniper rifle, Precision Barrel for the Broomstick pistol, Extended Mag and Long Barrel for the Patchett L2A1 submachine gun and the Heatsinked Suppressed Barrel for the Buzzsaw 42 light machine gun.

english.name: Wind of Change
english.description: In the Hoxton Breakout job, complete the heist while you and your four man crew are wearing one different "Historical" mask each on OVERKILL difficulty or above. Unlocks the Discrete Stock and Short Barrel for the Nagant sniper rifle, Precision Barrel for the Broomstick pistol, Extended Mag and Long Barrel for the Patchett L2A1 submachine gun and the Heatsinked Suppressed Barrel for the Buzzsaw 42 light machine gun.

french.name: Originaires des quatre vents
french.description: Terminez le contrat Évasion d'Hoxton, en difficulté OVERKILL ou supérieure, alors chaque membre de votre équipe de 4 porte un masque du Gage Historical Pack différent. Débloque la crosse discrète et le canon court pour le fusil de précision Nagant, le canon de précision pour le pistolet Broomstick, le chargeur à grande capacité et le canon long pour la mitraillette Patchett L2A1 et le silencieux dissipateur de chaleur pour la mitrailleuse légère Buzzsaw 42.

german.name: Wind of Change
german.description: Beende den Hoxton-Ausbruch auf der Schwierigkeit OVERKILL oder höher, wobei jedes der 4 Crewmitglieder eine andere "historische" Maske trägt. Schaltet den diskreten Schaft und den kurzen Lauf für das Nagant-Scharfschützengewehr, den Präzisionslauf für die Broomstick-Pistole, das größere Magazin und den langen Lauf für die Patchett-L2A1-Maschinenpistole und den schallgedämpften Lauf mit Kühlkörper für das Buzzsaw-42-LMG.

italian.name: Il vento del cambiamento
italian.description: Completa il contratto "EVASIONE DI HOXTON" in difficoltà OVERKILL o superiore facendo in modo che tutti i membri della squadra indossino una maschera diversa del DLC Gage Historical Pack. Sblocca il Calcio discreto e la Canna corta per il fucile di precisione Nagant, la Canna di precisione per la pistola Broomstick, il Caricatore maggiorato e la Canna lunga per la pistola mitragliatrice Patchett L2A1 e il Dissipatore silenziato per la mitragliatrice leggera Buzzsaw 42.

russian.name: Ветер перемен
russian.description: Завершите контракт "Спасение хокстона" вчетвером на уровне сложности "OVERKILL" или выше так, чтобы все члены команды носили 4 разные маски из комплекта дополнений "Historical Pack". Выполнение достижения открывает дискретный приклад и укороченный ствол для винтовки Nagant, точный ствол для пистолета Broomstick, увеличенный магазин и удлинённый ствол для пистолета-пулемёта Patchett L2A1, а также приглушённый ствол с перфорацией для пулемёта Buzzsaw 42.

schinese.name: 变革之风
schinese.description: 在“霍克斯顿突围”任务中，于OVERKILL或更高难度下，你与四人小队各佩戴一个不同的“历史”面具并完成此次劫案。解锁纳甘狙击步枪的隐蔽枪托与短枪管、驳壳枪手枪的精准枪管、帕切特L2A1冲锋枪的加长弹匣与长枪管，以及电锯42轻机枪的散热消音枪管。

spanish.name: Viento del cambio
spanish.description: Completa el trabajo La Fuga de Hoxton mientras tú y tu equipo de cuatro usan una máscara del “Gage Historical Pack” diferente en la dificultad OVERKILL o más alta. Desbloquea el “Cuerpo discreto” y el “Cañón corto” para el Fusil de Francotirador Nagant, el “Cañón de precisión” para la Pistola Broomstick, el “Cargador extendido” y el “Cañón largo” para la Metralleta Patchett L2A1 y el “Cañón disipado silenciado” para la Ametralladora Ligera Sierra 42.

dutch.name: So Uncivilized
dutch.description: Equip a Broomstick pistol with the Damper.L 44 Nozzle and the Barrel Sight 44. Unlocks the British Bulldog mask, High Capacity Mag and Holster Stock for the Broomstick pistol, "Army Green" material and "Filthy Thirteen" pattern.

english.name: So Uncivilized
english.description: Equip a Broomstick pistol with the Damper.L 44 Nozzle and the Barrel Sight 44. Unlocks the British Bulldog mask, High Capacity Mag and Holster Stock for the Broomstick pistol, "Army Green" material and "Filthy Thirteen" pattern.

french.name: Quel manque d'éducation
french.description: Équipez le pistolet Broomstick de l'embout Damper.L 44 et de la lunette de canon 44. Débloque le masque "Bulldog anglais", le chargeur à grande capacité et la crosse holster pour le pistolet Broomstick, le matériau "Camouflage vert" et le motif "Filthy Thirteen".

german.name: So unzivilisiert
german.description: Rüste eine Broomstick-Pistole mit Dämpfer-L44-Mündung und Laufvisier 44 aus. Schaltet die Maske "Englische Bulldogge", das große Magazin und den Holsterschaft für die Broomstick-Pistole, das Material "Armeegrün" und das Muster "Dreckige Dreizehn" frei.

italian.name: Incivile
italian.description: Equipaggia la pistola Broomstick modificata con l'estensione modello Damper.L 44 e il mirino 44. Sblocca il caricatore ad alta capacità e il calcio allungato per la pistola Broomstick, la maschera "IL BULLDOG INGLESE", il materiale "VERDE MILITARE" e il motivo "TREDICESIMO SQUADRONE".

russian.name: Нецивилизованный
russian.description: Выберите в инвентаре пистолет Broomstick с установленным на него пламегасителем L 44 и прицелом на ствол 44. Выполнение достижения открывает маску "Английский бульдог", увеличенный магазин и кобуру-приклад для пистолета Broomstick, а также материал "Армейский зелёный" и рисунок "Чёртова дюжина".

schinese.name: 真不文明

spanish.name: Qué incivilizado
spanish.description: Modifica la Pistola Broomstick con la boquilla "Damper.L 44” y la “Mira óptica de cañón 44”. Desbloquea la máscara “Bulldog Británico”, el "Cargador de gran capacidad” y la “Culata para pistolera” para la Pistola "Broomstick", el material “Verde del ejército” y el patrón “Trece sucios”.

dutch.name: Bullet Hell
dutch.description: Kill 10 enemies within 10 seconds using the Buzzsaw 42 light machine gun. Unlocks the Old Blood and Guts mask, Light Barrel for the Buzzsaw 42 light machine gun, "Patriot" material and "Captain War" pattern.

english.name: Bullet Hell
english.description: Kill 10 enemies within 10 seconds using the Buzzsaw 42 light machine gun. Unlocks the Old Blood and Guts mask, Light Barrel for the Buzzsaw 42 light machine gun, "Patriot" material and "Captain War" pattern.

french.name: Déluge de balles

german.name: Kugelhagel
german.description: Töte mit dem Buzzsaw-42-LMG 10 Feinde innerhalb 10 Sekunden. Schaltet die Maske "Der alte Haudegen", den leichten Lauf für das Buzzsaw-42-LMG, das Material "Patriot" und das Muster "Captain War" frei.

italian.name: Un inferno di proiettili

russian.name: Град пуль
russian.description: Убейте 10 противников в течение 10 секунд с помощью пулемёта Buzzsaw 42. Открывает маску "Старые кровь и кишки", лёгкий ствол для пулемёта Buzzsaw 42, а также материал "Патриот" и рисунок "Капитан Война".

schinese.name: 弹幕地狱

spanish.name: Infierno de balas

schinese.name: 取消圣诞老人的圣诞节

schinese.name: 幽闭恐惧症

italian.name: Diamanti grezzi
italian.description: Durante il contratto "IL DIAMANTE", completa l'enigma del diamante, recupera il Diamante e raggiungi il punto di estrazione dopo aver fatto scattare l'allarme in difficoltà OVERKILL o superiore. Sblocca la maschera "ANUBI", il materiale "BENDE DI MUMMIA" e il motivo "ELMO DEL FALCO".

russian.name: Необработанные бриллианты
russian.description: Решите головоломку в контракте "Бриллиант" и украдите бриллиант после того, как поднимется тревога на уровне сложности "OVERKILL" или выше. Выполнение достижения открывает маску "Анубис", материал "Бинты мумии" и рисунок "Соколиный шлем"

schinese.name: 浑金璞玉
schinese.description: 在“钻石”任务中，于OVERKILL或更高难度下，在警报触发后完成劫案、解开钻石谜题并偷走钻石。解锁“阿努比斯”面具、“木乃伊绷带”材质和“鹰盔”图案。

spanish.name: Diamantes en bruto
spanish.description: En el trabajo El Diamante, habiendo activado la alarma, completa el rompecabezas de El Diamante, roba El Diamante y huye en la dificultad OVERKILL o más alta. Desbloquea la máscara “Anubis”, el material “Vendas de momia” y el patrón “Casco de halcón”.

dutch.name: Tabula Rasa
dutch.description: In the Hoxton Breakout job, complete the heist on OVERKILL difficulty or above with each crew member using no skills, wearing suits, wielding Golden AK.762 rifles and Chicago Typewriter submachine guns. Unlocks a new skill slot.

english.name: Tabula Rasa
english.description: In the Hoxton Breakout job, complete the heist on OVERKILL difficulty or above with each crew member using no skills, wearing suits, wielding Golden AK.762 rifles and Chicago Typewriter submachine guns. Unlocks a new skill slot.

french.name: Tabula Rasa
french.description: Terminez le contrat Évasion d'Hoxton en difficulté OVERKILL ou supérieure. Chaque membre de l'équipe ne doit avoir aucune compétence, doit porter un costume deux pièces et doit utiliser le fusil AK.762 en or ainsi que la mitraillette Chicago Typewriter. Débloque un profil de compétences supplémentaire.

german.name: Tabula Rasa
german.description: Beende den Hoxton-Ausbruch auf der Schwierigkeit OVERKILL oder höher, wobei alle Crewmitglieder keine Fertigkeiten benutzen, den klassischen Anzug tragen, goldene AK.762-Gewehre und Chicago-Typewriter-Maschinenpistolen einsetzen. Schaltet einen neuen Fertigkeitsplatz frei.

italian.name: Tabula rasa
italian.description: Completa il contratto "EVASIONE DI HOXTON" in difficoltà OVERKILL o superiore facendo in modo che tutti i membri della squadra non abbiano abilità, indossino l'abito elegante e abbiano equipaggiato il fucile d'orato AK.762 e la pistola mitragliatrice Chicago Typewriter. Sblocca un nuovo profilo per le abilità.

russian.name: Tabula Rasa
russian.description: Завершите контракт "Спасение Хокстона" на сложности "OVERKILL" или выше так, чтобы все члены команды не потратили ни одного очка в деревьях навыков, носили костюмы и использовали золотые АК.762 и пистолеты-пулемёты Chicago Typewriter. Выполнение достижения открывает дополнительную ячейку для набора навыков.

schinese.name: 白纸一张
schinese.description: 在“霍克斯顿突围”任务中，于OVERKILL或更高难度下完成劫案，每名小队成员不使用任何技能、身穿西装，并手持黄金AK.762步枪和芝加哥打字机冲锋枪。解锁一个新的技能栏位。

spanish.name: Tabula rasa
spanish.description: Completa el trabajo La Fuga de Hoxton en la dificultad OVERKILL o más alta mientras todo el equipo lleva el Fusil AK 7,62 Dorado, la Máquina de Escribir Chicago, el Traje de Dos Piezas/Sin Blindaje y ninguna habilidad equipada. Desbloquea un conjunto de habilidades adicional.

dutch.name: Knockout!
dutch.description: Knock out a Bulldozer using the OVERKILL boxing gloves. Unlocks "The Champ" mask.

english.name: Knockout!
english.description: Knock out a Bulldozer using the OVERKILL boxing gloves. Unlocks "The Champ" mask.

french.name: K.O. !
french.description: Envoyez un Bulldozer au tapis à l'aide des gants de boxe OVERKILL. Débloque le masque "Le Champion".

german.name: Knockout!
german.description: Schlage mit den OVERKILL-Boxhandschuhen einen Bulldozer nieder. Schaltet die Maske "Der Champ" frei.

italian.name: K.O.
italian.description: Atterra un Bulldozer usando i guantoni da boxe OVERKILL. Sblocca la maschera "IL CAMPIONE".

russian.name: Нокаут!
russian.description: Нокаутируйте бульдзоера боксёрскими перчатками OVERKILL. Выполнение достижения открывает маску "Чемпион".

schinese.name: 击倒！
schinese.description: 使用OVERKILL拳击手套击倒一名推土机。解锁“冠军”面具。

spanish.name: ¡K.O.!
spanish.description: Noquea a un Bulldozer con los Guantes de Boxeo OVERKILL. Desbloquea la máscara “El Campeón”.

dutch.name: Derailed
dutch.description: Complete the Bomb: Forest heist on Normal difficulty or above.

english.name: Derailed
english.description: Complete the Bomb: Forest heist on Normal difficulty or above.

french.name: Déraillement
french.description: Terminez le contrat La Bombe : Forêt dans n'importe quelle difficulté.

german.name: Entgleist
german.description: Beende den Überfall "Die Bombe: Wald" auf einer beliebigen Schwierigkeit.

italian.name: Deragliato
italian.description: Completa il contratto "LA BOMBA - FORESTA" in qualsiasi difficoltà.

russian.name: Сошёл с рельс
russian.description: Завершите контракт "Бомба: лес" на любом уровне сложности.

schinese.name: 脱轨
schinese.description: 在普通或更高难度下完成“炸弹：森林”劫案。

spanish.name: Desviado
spanish.description: Completa el trabajo La Bomba: Bosque en cualquier dificultad.

dutch.name: A Pine in the Ass
dutch.description: Complete the Bomb: Forest heist on the Death Wish difficulty or above.

english.name: A Pine in the Ass
english.description: Complete the Bomb: Forest heist on the Death Wish difficulty or above.

french.name: Voilà qui m’enlève une épine du cul
french.description: Terminez le contrat La Bombe : Forêt en difficulté Suicidaire.

german.name: Waldmeister
german.description: Beende den Überfall "Die Bombe: Wald" auf der Schwierigkeit Todesmut.

italian.name: Foresta da incubo
italian.description: Completa il contratto "LA BOMBA - FORESTA" in difficoltà Apocalisse.

russian.name: Заноза в заднице
russian.description: Завершите контракт "Бомба: лес" на уровне сложности "Жажда смерти".

schinese.name: 屁股扎松树
schinese.description: 在死亡之愿或更高难度下完成“炸弹：森林”劫案。

spanish.name: Como una piña en el culo
spanish.description: Completa el trabajo La Bomba: Bosque en la dificultad Death Wish.

dutch.name: Beaver Team
dutch.description: In the Bomb: Forest heist, cut down all trees within 5 seconds. Unlocks the "Butcher From Hell" mask, "Meat" material and "Pleter" pattern.

english.name: Beaver Team
english.description: In the Bomb: Forest heist, cut down all trees within 5 seconds. Unlocks the "Butcher From Hell" mask, "Meat" material and "Pleter" pattern.

french.name: Castors Juniors
french.description: Dans le contrat La Bombe : Forêt, coupez tous les arbres de la piste en moins de 5 secondes. Débloque le masque "Le Boucher des enfers", le matériau "Viande" et le motif "Pleter".

german.name: Bieber-Team
german.description: Fälle beim Überfall "Die Bombe: Wald" innerhalb von 5 Sekunden alle Bäume. Schaltet die Maske "Schlächterin aus der Hölle", das Material "Fleisch" und das Muster "Flechtwerk" frei.

italian.name: Squadra di castori
italian.description: Durante il contratto "LA BOMBA - FORESTA", abbatti tutti gli alberi in 5 secondi. Sblocca la maschera "IL MACELLAIO INFERNALE", il materiale "CARNE" e il motivo "PLETER".

russian.name: Команда бобров
russian.description: Выполняя контракт "Бомба: лес", повалите все деревья в течение пяти секунд. Выполнение достижения открывает маску "Мясник из ада", материал "Мясо" и рисунок "Сплетение".

schinese.name: 海狸小队
schinese.description: 在“炸弹：森林”劫案中，于 5 秒内砍倒所有树木。解锁“地狱屠夫”面具、“肉”材质和“编绳纹”图案。

spanish.name: Equipo de castores
spanish.description: En el trabajo La Bomba: Bosque, al usar el plan de huida “Huida en avioneta” corta todos los árboles en menos de 5 segundos de cortar el primero. Desbloquea la máscara “Carnicero Infernal”, el material “Carne” y el patrón “Pleter”.

dutch.name: Pump It Up
dutch.description: In the Bomb: Forest heist, do not let the cops disconnect the water hose while you are using the river water pump. Unlocks the "Tech Lion" mask, "Marble Rock" material and "Lion Game Lion" pattern.

english.name: Pump It Up
english.description: In the Bomb: Forest heist, do not let the cops disconnect the water hose while you are using the river water pump. Unlocks the "Tech Lion" mask, "Marble Rock" material and "Lion Game Lion" pattern.

french.name: Et les Shadoks pompaient...
french.description: Dans le contrat La Bombe : Forêt, ne laissez pas les flics saboter le tuyau alors que vous utilisez la pompe à eau de la rivière. Débloque le masque "Méca-Lion", le matériau "Marbre" et le motif "Lion Game Lion".

german.name: Pumpernickel
german.description: Lass beim Überfall "Die Bombe: Wald" die Polizisten nicht den Wasserschlauch entfernen, während du die Wasserpumpe benutzt. Schaltet die Maske "Tech-Löwe", das Material "Marmor" und das Muster "Lion Game Lion" frei.

italian.name: A tutta pompa
italian.description: Durante il contratto "LA BOMBA - FORESTA", impedisci agli sbirri di staccare la manichetta dell'acqua dalla pompa vicino al fiume. Sblocca la maschera "LEONE DEL FUTURO", il materiale "MARMO" e il motivo "LION GAME LION".

russian.name: Качай на полную
russian.description: Выполняя контракт "Бомба: лес", не позвольте полицейским повредить или отсоединить шланг во время качки воды с помощью насоса. Выполнение достижения открывает маску "Технолев", материал "Мраморный камень" и рисунок "Lion Game Lion".

schinese.name: 泵起来
schinese.description: 在“炸弹：森林”劫案中，使用河水水泵时不要让警察切断水管。解锁“科技狮”面具、“大理石”材质和“Lion Game Lion”图案。

spanish.name: ¡Vamos, bombea!
spanish.description: En el trabajo La Bomba: Bosque, no dejes que la policía desconecte la manguera al usar la bomba del río. Desbloquea la máscara “León Tecnológico”, el material “Roca de mármol” y el patrón “Lion Game Lion”.

dutch.name: Oppressor
dutch.description: Finish the Bomb: Forest heist without letting any civilian flee or die, having at least five civilians in the heist while escaping with the boat. Unlocks "The Doctor" mask, "Plywood" material and "Caduceus" pattern.

english.name: Oppressor
english.description: Finish the Bomb: Forest heist without letting any civilian flee or die, having at least five civilians in the heist while escaping with the boat. Unlocks "The Doctor" mask, "Plywood" material and "Caduceus" pattern.

french.name: Tyran
french.description: Terminez le contrat La Bombe : Forêt avec au moins 5 civils attachés, sans qu'un seul d'entre eux ne s’enfuie ou ne meure, et en vous échappant avec le bateau. Débloque le masque "Le Docteur", le matériau "Contreplaqué" et le motif "Caduceus".

german.name: Unterdrücker
german.description: Beende den Überfall "Die Bombe: Wald", ohne Zivilisten entkommen oder sterben zu lassen und habe mindestens fünf Zivilisten in deiner Gewalt, wenn du mit dem Boot entkommst. Schaltet die Maske "Der Doktor", das Material "Sperrholz" und das Muster "Hermesstab" frei.

italian.name: Tiranno
italian.description: Durante il contratto "LA BOMBA - FORESTA", prendi in ostaggio almeno 5 civili e assicurati che non fuggano e non vengano uccisi prima di andartene con la barca. Sblocca la maschera "IL DOTTORE", il materiale "COMPENSATO" e il motivo "CADUCEO".

russian.name: Притеснитель
russian.description: Завершите контракт "Бомба: лес", выбрав побег на лодке, не убивая никого из пяти гражданских и позволив ни одному из них сбежать. Выполнение достижения открывает маску "Доктор", материал "Фанера" и рисунок "Кадуцей".

schinese.name: 压迫者
schinese.description: 完成“炸弹：森林”劫案，不让任何平民逃跑或死亡，且劫案中至少有五名平民，随后乘船逃离。解锁“医生”面具、“胶合板”材质和“双蛇杖”图案。

spanish.name: Opresor
spanish.description: Completa el trabajo La Bomba: Bosque usando el plan de huida “Huida en barco” y sin que ningún civil muera o logre huir, teniendo al menos 5 civiles. Desbloquea la máscara “El Médico”, el material “Contrachapado” y el patrón “Caduceus”.

dutch.name: Maiden Voyage
dutch.description: Complete the Bomb: Dockyard heist on any difficulty.

english.name: Maiden Voyage
english.description: Complete the Bomb: Dockyard heist on any difficulty.

french.name: Voyage inaugural
french.description: Terminez le contrat La Bombe : Chantier naval dans n'importe quelle difficulté.

german.name: Jungfernfahrt
german.description: Beende den Überfall "Die Bombe: Schiffswerft" auf einer beliebigen Schwierigkeit.

italian.name: Viaggio inaugurale
italian.description: Completa il contratto "LA BOMBA - ZONA PORTUALE" in qualsiasi difficoltà.

russian.name: Первое плавание
russian.description: Завершите контракт "Бомба: доки" на любой сложности.

schinese.name: 处女航
schinese.description: 在任意难度下完成“炸弹：船坞”劫案。

spanish.name: Viaje inaugural
spanish.description: Completa el trabajo La Bomba: Astillero en cualquier dificultad.

dutch.name: Fisherman's Fiend
dutch.description: Complete the Bomb: Dockyard heist on the Death Wish difficulty or above.

english.name: Fisherman's Fiend
english.description: Complete the Bomb: Dockyard heist on the Death Wish difficulty or above.

french.name: Pardonnez-moi mon père car j'ai pêché
french.description: Terminez le contrat La Bombe : Chantier naval en difficulté Suicidaire.

german.name: Fischers Fritz fischt frische Fische
german.description: Beende den Überfall "Die Bombe: Schiffswerft" auf der Schwierigkeit Todesmut.

italian.name: Incubo del pescatore
italian.description: Completa il contratto "LA BOMBA - ZONA PORTUALE" in difficoltà Apocalisse.

russian.name: Враг рыбака
russian.description: Завершите контракт "Бомба: доки" на уровне сложности "Жажда смерти".

schinese.name: 渔夫之魔
schinese.description: 在死亡愿望或更高难度下完成“炸弹：船坞”劫案。

spanish.name: El demonio del pescador
spanish.description: Completa el trabajo La Bomba: Astillero en la dificultad Death Wish.

dutch.name: Sneaking With the Fishes
dutch.description: Complete the Bomb: Dockyard heist in stealth on the Death Wish difficulty or above. Unlocks the "Lady Butcher" mask, "Rhino" material and "Checker Board" pattern.

english.name: Sneaking With the Fishes
english.description: Complete the Bomb: Dockyard heist in stealth on the Death Wish difficulty or above. Unlocks the "Lady Butcher" mask, "Rhino" material and "Checker Board" pattern.

french.name: Muet comme une carpe
french.description: Terminez le contrat La Bombe : Chantier naval en difficulté Suicidaire sans déclencher l'alarme. Débloque le masque "Madame le boucher", le matériau "Rhinocéros" et le motif "Échiquier".

german.name: Leise wie ein Fisch
german.description: Beende den Überfall "Die Bombe: Schiffswerft" im Schleich-Modus auf der Schwierigkeit Todesmut. Schaltet die Maske "Die Schlächterin", das Material "Nashorn" und das Muster "Schachbrett" frei.

italian.name: Muto come un pesce
italian.description: Completa il contratto "LA BOMBA - ZONA PORTUALE" in difficoltà Apocalisse senza far scattare l'allarme. Sblocca la maschera "LA MACELLAIA", il materiale "RINOCERONTE" e il motivo "SCACCHIERA".

russian.name: Тише рыбы
russian.description: Завершите контракт "Бомба: доки" на уровне сложности "Жажда смерти", не поднимая тревоги. Выполнение достижения открывает маску "Леди мясник", материал "Носорог" и рисунок "Шахматная доска".

schinese.name: 与鱼共潜
schinese.description: 在死亡愿望或更高难度下以潜行方式完成“炸弹：船坞”劫案。解锁“女屠夫”面具、“犀牛”材质和“棋盘格”图案。

spanish.name: Tan escurridizo como un pez
spanish.description: Completa sigilosamente el trabajo La Bomba: Astillero en la dificultad Death Wish. Desbloquea la máscara “Dama Carnicera”, el material “Rino” y el patrón “Tablero a cuadros”.

dutch.name: Breaking Dead
dutch.description: In the Bomb: Dockyard heist, find the meth lab. Unlocks the "Extended Mag" for the LEO pistol.

english.name: Breaking Dead
english.description: In the Bomb: Dockyard heist, find the meth lab. Unlocks the "Extended Mag" for the LEO pistol.

french.name: Breaking Bâbord
french.description: Dans le contrat La Bombe : Chantier naval, trouvez le labo de méthamphétamine. Débloque le chargeur à grande capacité pour le pistolet LEO.

german.name: Walter Werft
german.description: Finde beim Überfall "Die Bombe: Schiffswerft" das Meth-Labor. Schaltet das größere Magazin für die LEO-Pistole frei.

italian.name: Lo scaricatore di droga
italian.description: Trova il laboratorio di metanfetamina durante il contratto "LA BOMBA - ZONA PORTUALE". Sblocca il caricatore esteso per la pistola LEO.

russian.name: Во все мёртвые
russian.description: Найдите мет-лабораторию в контракте "Бомба: доки". Выполнение достижения открывает увеличенный магазин для пистолета LEO.

schinese.name: 绝命毒尸
schinese.description: 在“炸弹：船坞”劫案中找到冰毒实验室。解锁 LEO 手枪的“加长弹匣”。

spanish.name: Breaking Dead
spanish.description: En el trabajo La Bomba: Astillero, encuentra el laboratorio de metanfetamina. Desbloquea el “Cargador extendido” para la pistola LEO.

dutch.name: I've Got the Power
dutch.description: In the Bomb: Dockyard heist, don't let the enemies cut the power. Unlocks the "Long Slide" for the LEO pistol.

english.name: I've Got the Power
english.description: In the Bomb: Dockyard heist, don't let the enemies cut the power. Unlocks the "Long Slide" for the LEO pistol.

french.name: Je suis au courant
french.description: Dans le contrat La Bombe : Chantier naval, ne laissez pas les flics couper le courant. Débloque la culasse longue pour le pistolet LEO.

german.name: Unter Strom
german.description: Lass beim Überfall "Die Bombe: Schiffswerft" die Feinde nicht den Strom kappen. Schaltet den langen Schlitten die LEO-Pistole frei.

italian.name: Il potere è mio
italian.description: Durante il contratto "LA BOMBA - ZONA PORTUALE", impedisci ai nemici di staccare la corrente. Sblocca il Carrello esteso per la pistola LEO.

russian.name: I've Got the Power
russian.description: Выполняя контракт "Бомба: доки", ни разу не дайте противникам отключить питание. Выполнение достижения открывает длинный затвор для пистолета LEO.

schinese.name: 电力在我手
schinese.description: 在“炸弹：船坞”劫案中，别让敌人切断电源。解锁 LEO 手枪的“长滑套”。

spanish.name: ¡Tengo el poder!
spanish.description: En el trabajo La Bomba: Astillero, no dejes que la policía corte la electricidad al hackear el terminal del barco. Desbloquea la “Corredera larga” para la Pistola LEO.

dutch.name: Done in 60 Seconds
dutch.description: In the Bomb: Dockyard heist, open the dock gate in 60 seconds using the keycards. Unlocks the "Custom Slide" for the LEO pistol.

english.name: Done in 60 Seconds
english.description: In the Bomb: Dockyard heist, open the dock gate in 60 seconds using the keycards. Unlocks the "Custom Slide" for the LEO pistol.

french.name: 60 secondes chrono
french.description: Dans le contrat La Bombe : Chantier naval, ouvrez les portes du quai avec les cartes d'accès en moins de 60 secondes. Débloque la culasse personnalisée pour le pistolet LEO.

german.name: Tor noch 60 Sekunden
german.description: Öffne beim Überfall "Die Bombe: Schiffswerft" das Werfttor innerhalb von 60 Sekunden mit Schlüsselkarten. Schaltet den abgepassten Schlitten für die LEO-Pistole frei.

italian.name: Pronto in 60 secondi
italian.description: Durante il contratto "LA BOMBA - ZONA PORTUALE", apri la barriera dell'ormeggio in 60 secondi usando le schede magnetiche. Sblocca il Carrello personalizzato per la pistola LEO.

russian.name: Украсть за 60 секунд
russian.description: Выполняя контракт "Бомба: доки", откройте ворота дока ключ-картами не более чем за 60 секунд после начала ограбления. Выполнение достижения открывает особый затвор для пистолета LEO.

schinese.name: 极速60秒
schinese.description: 在“炸弹：船坞”劫案中，使用钥匙卡在 60 秒内打开船坞闸门。解锁 LEO 手枪的“定制滑套”。

spanish.name: Listo en 60 segundos
spanish.description: En el trabajo La Bomba: Astillero, abre la puerta del muelle usando las tarjetas en 60 segundos o menos de haber empezado el golpe. Desbloquea la “Corredera especial” para la Pistola LEO.

dutch.name: OVE SAW 72000
dutch.description: In the Nightclub job, complete the heist on any difficulty with each crew member using the OVE 9000 saw as primary and secondary weapons. Unlocks the "THRUST Upper Receiver", "THRUST Lower Receiver" and "Long Ergo Foregrip" for the CAR weapon family.

english.name: OVE SAW 72000
english.description: In the Nightclub job, complete the heist on any difficulty with each crew member using the OVE 9000 saw as primary and secondary weapons. Unlocks the "THRUST Upper Receiver", "THRUST Lower Receiver" and "Long Ergo Foregrip" for the CAR weapon family.

french.name: Si six cents scies scient six cents policiers
french.description: Terminez le contrat Boîte de nuit dans n'importe quelle difficulté alors que chaque membre de votre équipe utilise la scie OVE9000 en arme primaire et en arme secondaire. Débloque la platine supérieure THRUST, la platine inférieure THRUST et la poignée avant ergonomique longue pour les armes de type CAR.

german.name: OVE72000
german.description: Beende den Nachtclub-Überfall auf beliebiger Schwierigkeit, wobei alle Crewmitglieder die OVE9000-Handkreissäge als Primär und Sekundärwaffe benutzt. Schaltet das obere Verschlussgehäuse (THRUST), das untere Verschlussgehäuse (THRUST) und den langen ergonomischen Handgriff für die CAR-Waffenfamilie frei.

italian.name: Motosega 72000
italian.description: Completa il contratto "NIGHT CLUB" in qualsiasi difficoltà facendo in modo che tutti i membri della squadra utilizzino la sega OVE 9000 come arma primaria e come arma secondaria. Sblocca il castello superiore THRUST, il castello inferiore THRUST e l'impugnatura anteriore militare per le armi della famiglia CAR.

russian.name: OVE SAW 72000
russian.description: Завершите контракт "Ночной клуб" на любом уровне сложности так, чтобы все члены команды использовали пилу как первичное и вторичное оружие. Выполнение достижения открывает нижний и верхний ресивер THRUST, а также длинное эргономичное цевьё для винтовок типа CAR.

schinese.name: OVE 电锯 72000
schinese.description: 在“夜总会”任务中，以任意难度完成劫案，且每名队员的主、副武器均为 OVE 9000 电锯。解锁 CAR 系列武器的“THRUST 上机匣”、“THRUST 下机匣”和“Ergo 长护木”。

spanish.name: OVE SIERRA 72000
spanish.description: Completa el trabajo Club Nocturno en cualquier dificultad mientras todo el equipo usa la Sierra OVE9000 como arma principal y secundaria. Desbloquea el “Cajón superior THRUST” y el “Cajón inferior THRUST” para armas CAR y el “Guardamanos largo y ergonómico” para el Fusil AMR-16.

dutch.name: Hey Mr. DJ
dutch.description: In the Nightclub job, have 12 hostages or more on the dance floor when you escape. Unlocks the "Aluminum Grip" for the AK weapon family, the "Aluminum Foregrip" for the Krinkov submachine gun and the "LW Upper Receiver" for the CAR weapon family.

english.name: Hey Mr. DJ
english.description: In the Nightclub job, have 12 hostages or more on the dance floor when you escape. Unlocks the "Aluminum Grip" for the AK weapon family, the "Aluminum Foregrip" for the Krinkov submachine gun and the "LW Upper Receiver" for the CAR weapon family.

french.name: Hey Mr. DJ
french.description: Terminez le contrat Boîte de nuit avec au moins 12 otages allongés sur la piste de dance. Débloque la poignée en aluminium pour les armes de type AK, la poignée avant en aluminium pour la mitraillette Krinkov et la platine supérieure LW pour les armes de type CAR.

german.name: Hey, DJ!
german.description: Hab beim Nachtclub-Überfall bei deiner Flucht mindestens 12 Geiseln auf der Tanzfläche. Schaltet den Aluminium-Griff für die AK-Waffenfamilie, den Aluminium-Handgriff für die Krinkov-Maschinenpistole und das obere Verschlussgehäuse (LW) fpr die CAR-Waffenfamilie.

italian.name: Ehi, Mr. DJ!
italian.description: Durante il contratto "NIGHT CLUB", lascia almeno 12 ostaggi sulla pista da ballo e raggiungi il punto di estrazione. Sblocca l'Impugnatura in alluminio per i fucili AK, l'Impugnatura anteriore in alluminio per la pistola mitragliatrice Krinkov e il Castello superiore LW per i fucili CAR.

russian.name: Эй, диджей
russian.description: Завершите контракт "Ночной клуб", оставив 12 связанных заложников на танцполе перед побегом. Выполнение достижения открывает алюминиевую рукоять для винтовок типа АК, алюминиевое цевьё для пистолета-пулемёта Krinkov и верхний ресивер LW для винтовок типа CAR.

schinese.name: 嘿，DJ先生
schinese.description: 在夜店任务中，逃脱时舞池中有12名或更多人质。解锁AK枪族的“铝制握把”、Krinkov冲锋枪的“铝制前握把”以及CAR枪族的“LW上机匣”。

spanish.name: ¡Oiga Sr. DJ!
spanish.description: Completa el trabajo Club Nocturno dejando al menos a 12 civiles atados en la pista de baile. Desbloquea la “Empuñadura de aluminio” para armas AK, el “Guardamanos de aluminio” para la Metralleta Krinkov y el “Cajón superior LW” para armas CAR.

dutch.name: $1.8M Speedrun
dutch.description: In the Mallcrasher job, loot $1,800,000 in loose cash within 50 seconds of starting the heist on the OVERKILL difficulty. Unlocks the "Scope Mount" and "PBS Suppressor" for the AK weapon family, "Alfred" mask, "Dawn" material and "Dinosaur Skull" pattern.

english.name: $1.8M Speedrun
english.description: In the Mallcrasher job, loot $1,800,000 in loose cash within 50 seconds of starting the heist on the OVERKILL difficulty. Unlocks the "Scope Mount" and "PBS Suppressor" for the AK weapon family, "Alfred" mask, "Dawn" material and "Dinosaur Skull" pattern.

french.name: Speedrun de 1,8 millions
french.description: Dans le contrat Vandale, récupérez 1 800 000$ en argent facile en moins de 50 secondes, en difficulté OVERKILL. Débloque le support lunette et le silencieux PBS pour les armes de type AK, le masque "Alfred", le matériau "Aube" et le motif "Crâne de dinosaure".

german.name: 1,8-Millionen-Dollar-Sprint
german.description: Erbeute beim Einkaufszentrum-Überfall auf der Schwierigkeit OVERKILL innerhalb von 50 Sekunden 1.800.000 $ in Bargeld. Schaltet die Visierhalterung und den PBS-Schalldämpfer für die AK-Waffenfamilie, die Maske "Alfred", das Material "Dämmerung" und das Muster "Dino-Schädel" frei.

italian.name: Speedrun da 1.8 milioni di dollari
italian.description: Durante il contratto "CENTRO COMMERCIALE", recupera 1.800.000 dollari di contanti sfusi entro 50 secondi dall'inizio del colpo in difficoltà OVERKILL o superiore. Sblocca l'adattatore per mirini e il silenziatore PBS per le armi della famiglia AK, la maschera "ALFRED", il materiale "ALBA" e il motivo "TESCHIO DI DINOSAURO".

russian.name: Спидран на $1.8M
russian.description: Выполняя контракт "Крушитель" на уровне сложности "OVERKILL", украдите мелкие предметы общей стоимостью в $1,800,000 в течение 50 секунд после начала ограбления. Выполнение достижения открывает рейку для прицела и глушитель PBS для винтовок семейства AK, а также маску "Альфред", материал "Рассвет" и рисунок "Череп динозавра".

schinese.name: 180万美元速通
schinese.description: 在商场破坏者任务中，于OVERKILL难度下，在突袭开始后50秒内掠取1,800,000美元的散落现金。解锁AK枪族的“瞄准镜座”与“PBS消音器”、“阿尔弗雷德”面具、“黎明”材质和“恐龙头骨”图案。

spanish.name: Speedrun de $1.8 millones
spanish.description: En el trabajo Destrozacentros, roba $1.800.000 en objetos sueltos en menos de 50 segundos de empezar el golpe en la dificultad OVERKILL. Desbloquea el “Riel para montaje de miras AK” y el “Supresor PBS” para armas AK, la máscara “Alfred”, el material “Amanecer” y el patrón “Cráneo de dinosaurio”.

dutch.name: Here Comes the Pain Train
dutch.description: In the Firestarter job, complete the heist on OVERKILL difficulty or above, with all days done in loud and with a crew of 4 players using unmodified "AK Rifle" rifles and "PARA" submachine guns. Unlocks the "DMR Kit AK.762" and the "Low Drag Magazine" for the AK weapon family, "Timothy" mask, "Prehistoric" material and "Dinosaur Stripes" pattern.

english.name: Here Comes the Pain Train
english.description: In the Firestarter job, complete the heist on OVERKILL difficulty or above, with all days done in loud and with a crew of 4 players using unmodified "AK Rifle" rifles and "PARA" submachine guns. Unlocks the "DMR Kit AK.762" and the "Low Drag Magazine" for the AK weapon family, "Timothy" mask, "Prehistoric" material and "Dinosaur Stripes" pattern.

french.name: On va vous rouler dessus !
french.description: Terminez le contrat Pyromane en difficulté OVERKILL ou supérieure. Aucun jour ne doit être terminé discrètement et chaque membre de votre équipe de 4 doit utiliser le fusil AK et la mitraillette Para, sans aucune modification sur les deux armes. Débloque le Kit DMR AK.762 et le chargeur à traînée faible pour les armes de type AK, le masque "Timothy", le matériau "Préhistorique" et le motif "Rayures de dinosaure".

german.name: Jetzt wird's schmerzhaft
german.description: Beende den Brandstifter-Überfall auf der Schwierigkeit OVERKILL oder höher, wobei alle Tage laut und mit 4 Crewmitgliedern mit unmodifizierten AK-Gewehren und PARA-Maschinenpistolen gespielt werden. Schaltet den DMR-Rüstsatz und das Magazin mit wenig Widerstand für die AK-Waffenfamilie, die Maske "Timothy", das Material "Prähistorisch" und das Muster "Dino-Streifen" frei.

italian.name: Il treno del dolore
italian.description: Completa il contratto Completa il contratto "PIROMANI" in difficoltà OVERKILL o superiore facendo sempre scattare l'allarme e facendo in modo che tutti i membri della squadra utilizzino un fucile AK e una pistola mitragliatrice PARA non modificati. Sblocca il kit DMR AK.762 e il caricatore stabilizzante per le armi della famiglia AK, la maschera "TIMOTHY", il materiale "PREISTORICO" e il motivo "STRISCE DA DINOSAURO".

russian.name: Разбирайте костыли
russian.description: Завершите контракт "Поджигатель" вчетвером на уровне сложности "OVERKILL" или выше так, чтобы все члены команды использовали только немодифицированные винтовки АК и пистолеты-пулемёты PARA. Выполнение достижения открывает набор DMR для АК.762, расширенный магазин для винтовок типа АК, а также маску "Тимоти", материал "Доисторический" и рисунок "Полосы на динозавре".

schinese.name: 痛苦列车来袭
schinese.description: 在纵火狂任务中，以OVERKILL或更高难度完成突袭，所有天数均以强攻方式完成，且由4名玩家组成的队伍使用未改装的“AK步枪”和“PARA”冲锋枪。解锁AK枪族的“AK.762 DMR套件”与“低阻弹匣”、“蒂莫西”面具、“史前”材质和“恐龙条纹”图案。

spanish.name: Aquí viene el tren del dolor
spanish.description: Completa el trabajo Pirómano sin optar por el sigilo en ningún día, mientras tú y tu equipo de cuatro usan el Fusil AK y la Metralleta PARA, ambas armas sin modificaciones equipadas, en la dificultad OVERKILL o más alta. Desbloquea el “Kit de DMR” y el “Cargador de baja resistencia” para armas AK, la máscara “Timothy”, el material “Prehistórico” y el patrón “Rayas de dinosaurio”.

dutch.name: The Wolf Lures You to Your Grave
dutch.description: In the Art Gallery job, kill two of the patrolling guards in stealth in the bathroom. Unlocks the "E.M.O. Foregrip" and the "OVAL Foregrip" for the CAR weapon family and the "Aftermarket Shorty" for the PARA submachine gun.

english.name: The Wolf Lures You to Your Grave
english.description: In the Art Gallery job, kill two of the patrolling guards in stealth in the bathroom. Unlocks the "E.M.O. Foregrip" and the "OVAL Foregrip" for the CAR weapon family and the "Aftermarket Shorty" for the PARA submachine gun.

french.name: Se précipiter dans la gueule du loup
french.description: Dans le contrat Musée d'art, tuez discrètement 2 gardes qui patrouillent dans les toilettes. Débloque la poignée avant E.M.O. et la poignée avant OVAL pour les armes de type CAR ainsi que la poignée avant courte d'occasion pour la mitraillette Para.

german.name: Der Wolf lockt dich in dein Grab
german.description: Töte beim Kunstgalerie-Überfall im Schleich-Modus zwei der patrouillierenden Wachen in der Toilette. Schaltet den E.M.O.-Handgriff und den "OVAL-Handgriff" für die CAR-Waffenfamilie und den Aftermarket-Handgriff für die PARA-Maschinenpistole frei.

italian.name: Il lupo ti porta alla tomba
italian.description: Durante il contratto "GALLERIA D'ARTE", uccidi silenziosamente due guardie mentre si trovano nel bagno. Sblocca l'Impugnatura anteriore E.M.O. e l'Impugnatura anteriore OVAL per i fucili CAR e l'Impugnatura anteriore aftermarket per le pistole mitragliatrici PARA.

russian.name: Волк заманит вас в могилу
russian.description: Выполняя контракт "Художественная галерея", убейте двух охранников в туалете, не поднимая тревоги. Выполнение достижения открывает цевье E.M.O. и цевье OVAL для винтовок типа CAR и модификацию "Подержанный короткий" для пистолета-пулемёта PARA.

schinese.name: 沃夫引你走向坟墓
schinese.description: 在艺术画廊任务中，在潜行状态下于卫生间内杀死两名巡逻守卫。解锁CAR枪族的“E.M.O.前握把”与“椭圆前握把”以及PARA冲锋枪的“改装短管”。

spanish.name: El lobo te atrae a tú tumba
spanish.description: En el trabajo Galería de Arte, en sigilo, mata a 2 guardias en el baño. Desbloquea el “Guardamanos E.M.O.” y el “Guardamanos OVAL” para armas CAR y el “Guardamanos pequeñito de postventa” para la Metralleta PARA.

dutch.name: The Turtle Always Wins
dutch.description: In the Art Gallery job, complete the heist in stealth within 4 minutes with each crew member wearing the Improved Combined Tactical Vest and no Armor Kit deployable equipped. Unlocks the "Classic Stock" for the AK weapon family, "2 Piece Stock" for the AK and CAR weapon families, "Pachy" mask, "Fossil" material and "Prehistoric Predator" pattern.

english.name: The Turtle Always Wins
english.description: In the Art Gallery job, complete the heist in stealth within 4 minutes with each crew member wearing the Improved Combined Tactical Vest and no Armor Kit deployable equipped. Unlocks the "Classic Stock" for the AK weapon family, "2 Piece Stock" for the AK and CAR weapon families, "Pachy" mask, "Fossil" material and "Prehistoric Predator" pattern.

french.name: La tortue gagne toujours
french.description: Terminez le contrat Musée d'art discrètement en moins de 4 minutes alors que chaque membre de l'équipe porte le Gilet tactique polyvalent amélioré, mais ne transporte pas de sac d'armure. Débloque la crosse classique pour les armes de type AK, la crosse 2 pièces pour les armes de type AK et CAR, le masque "Packy", le matériau "Fossile" et le motif "Prédateur préhistorique".

german.name: Die Schildkröte gewinnt immer
german.description: Beende den Kunstgalerie-Überfall im Schleich-Modus innerhalb 4 Minuten, wobei alle Crewmitglieder die verbesserte taktische Panzerweste tragen aber keine Panzerungstasche bei sich führen. Schaltet den klassischen Schaft für die AK-Waffenfamilie, den zweiteiligen Schaft für die AK- und CAR-Waffenfamilien, die Maske "Pachy", das Material "Fossil" und das Muster "Prähistorischer Prädator" frei.

italian.name: La tartaruga vince sempre
italian.description: Completa il contratto "GALLERIA D'ARTE" entro 4 minuti senza far scattare l'allarme. Ogni membro della squadra deve indossare il giubbotto tattico combinato migliorato e la valigetta per l'armatura non è ammessa. Sblocca il Calcio classico per i fucili AK, il Calcio a due pezzi per i fucili AK e CAR, la maschera "PACHY", il materiale "FOSSILE" ed il motivo "PREDATORE PREISTORICO".

russian.name: Черепаха всегда приходит первой
russian.description: Завершите контракт "Художественная галерея" за 4 минуты, не поднимая тревоги, так, чтобы каждый член команды носил улучшенный КТЖ и не брал с собой на ограбление сумку с бронёй. Выполнение достижения открывает классический приклад для винтовок типа АК, приклад из двух частей для винтовок типа АК и CAR, маску "Пахи", материал "Окаменелость" и рисунок "Доисторический хищник".

schinese.name: 乌龟总是赢
schinese.description: 在艺术画廊任务中，在4分钟内以潜行方式完成突袭，且每名队员都穿戴改进型组合战术背心、未携带护甲包投放物。解锁AK枪族的“经典枪托”、AK与CAR枪族的“两件式枪托”、“肿头龙”面具、“化石”材质和“史前掠食者”图案。

spanish.name: La tortuga siempre gana
spanish.description: Completa sigilosamente el trabajo Galería de Arte en menos de 4 minutos mientras todo el equipo usa el Chaleco Táctico Combinado Mejorado y sin llevar la Maleta de Blindaje. Desbloquea la “Culata clásica” para armas AK, la “Culata de 2 piezas” para armas AK y CAR, la máscara “Pachy”, el material “Fósil” y el patrón “Depredador prehistórico”.

dutch.name: Private Party
dutch.description: In the Jewelry store job, don't let the cops enter the jewelry store until the van comes back on OVERKILL difficulty or above. Unlocks the "DMR Kit AMR-16" and the "L5 Magazine" for the CAR weapon family, "Vincent" mask, "Feathers" material and "Dinosaur Scars" pattern.

english.name: Private Party
english.description: In the Jewelry store job, don't let the cops enter the jewelry store until the van comes back on OVERKILL difficulty or above. Unlocks the "DMR Kit AMR-16" and the "L5 Magazine" for the CAR weapon family, "Vincent" mask, "Feathers" material and "Dinosaur Scars" pattern.

french.name: Soirée privée
french.description: Dans le contrat Bijouterie, empêchez les flics pénétrer dans la bijouterie jusqu'à ce que le fourgon revienne, en difficulté OVERKILL ou supérieure. Débloque le Kit DMR AMR-16 et le chargeur L5 pour les armes de type CAR, le masque "Vincent", le matériau "Plumes" et le motif "Cicatrices de dinosaure".

german.name: Privatparty
german.description: Lass beim Juwelier-Überfall auf der Schwierigkeit OVERKILL oder höher die Polizisten nicht ins Gebäude, bis der Transporter zurückgekommen ist. Schaltet den DMR-Rüstsatz und das L5-Magazin für die CAR-Waffenfamilie, die Maske "Vincent", das Material "Federn" und das Muster "Dino-Narben

italian.name: Festa privata
italian.description: Durante il contratto "GIOIELLERIA", impedisci agli sbirri di entrare nel negozio fino al ritorno del furgone in difficoltà OVERKILL o superiore. Sblocca il kit DMR AMR-16 e il caricatore L5 per le armi della famiglia CAR, la maschera "VINCENT", il materiale "PIUME" e il motivo "CICATRICI DA DINOSAURO".

russian.name: Закрытая вечеринка
russian.description: Выполняя контракт "Ювелирный магазин" на сложности "OVERKILL" или выше, не дайте полицейским войти в магазин до повторного прибытия фургона для побега. Выполнение достижения открывает набор DMR для AMR-16, магазин L5 для винтовок типа CAR, а также маску "Винсент", материал "Перья" и рисунок "Шрамы динозвра".

schinese.name: 私人派对
schinese.description: 在珠宝店任务中，于OVERKILL或更高难度下，在逃亡车返回之前不让警察进入珠宝店。解锁CAR枪族的“AMR-16 DMR套件”与“L5弹匣”、“文森特”面具、“羽毛”材质和“恐龙伤疤”图案。

spanish.name: Fiesta privada
spanish.description: En el trabajo Joyería, no dejes que ningún policía entre a la joyería (los Cloakers en los conductos de ventilación no cuentan) hasta que el vehículo de huida regrese en la dificultad OVERKILL o más alta. Desbloquea el “Kit de DMR” y el “Cargador L5” para armas CAR, la máscara “Vincent”, el material “Plumas” y el patrón “Cicatrices de dinosaurio”.

dutch.name: The Collector
dutch.description: Kill 100 cops using only weapons from the AK or CAR weapon families. Unlocks the "Keymod Rail", the "Crabs Rail" and the "Modern Barrel" for the AK weapon family.

english.name: The Collector
english.description: Kill 100 cops using only weapons from the AK or CAR weapon families. Unlocks the "Keymod Rail", the "Crabs Rail" and the "Modern Barrel" for the AK weapon family.

french.name: C'est pour ma collection
french.description: Tuez 100 flics en utilisant uniquement des armes de type AK ou CAR. Débloque le rail Keymod, le rail Crabs et le canon moderne pour les armes de type AK.

german.name: Der Sammler
german.description: Töte 100 Polizisten nur mit Waffen der AK- und CAR-Waffenfamilien. Schaltet die Keymod-Schiene, die Crabs-Schiene und den modernen Lauf für die AK-Waffenfamilie frei.

italian.name: Il collezionista
italian.description: Uccidi 100 sbirri usando soltanto armi delle famiglie AK o CAR. Sblocca l'impugnatura anteriore KEYMOD, l'impugnatura anteriore antisommossa e la canna moderna per le armi della famiglia AK.

russian.name: Коллекционер
russian.description: Убейте 100 полицейских, используя только винтовки типа АК или CAR. Выполнение достижения открывает рейку "Keymod", рейку "Crabs" и современный ствол для винтовок типа АК.

schinese.name: 收藏家
schinese.description: 仅使用AK枪族或CAR枪族的武器击杀100名警察。解锁AK枪族的“Keymod导轨”、“螃蟹导轨”和“现代枪管”。

spanish.name: El recolector
spanish.description: Mata a 100 enemigos con armas AK o CAR. Desbloquea el “Riel Keymod”, el “Riel Crabs” y el "Cañón moderno" para armas AK.

dutch.name: Becoming Villainous
dutch.description: Reach the sixth level of infamy.

english.name: Becoming Villainous
english.description: Reach the sixth level of infamy.

french.name: Devenir un scélérat
french.description: Atteignez le sixième niveau d'Infamie.

german.name: Schurkenhaft
german.description: Erreiche den sechsten Verrufenheits-Level.

italian.name: Perfido
italian.description: Raggiungi il sesto livello d'infamia.

russian.name: Подлый
russian.description: Достигните шестого уровня дурной репутации.

schinese.name: 成为恶棍
schinese.description: 达到恶名第6级。

spanish.name: Malvado
spanish.description: Alcanza el sexto nivel de Infamia.

dutch.name: Becoming Abominable
dutch.description: Reach the seventh level of infamy.

english.name: Becoming Abominable
english.description: Reach the seventh level of infamy.

french.name: Devenir abominable
french.description: Atteignez le septième niveau d'Infamie.

german.name: Abscheulich
german.description: Erreiche den siebten Verrufenheits-Level.

dutch.description: Complete the Rats job with you and your four man crew having Combined Tactical Vests, Vulcan Miniguns, HRL-7 Rocket Launchers and General Overkill masks equipped on the OVERKILL difficulty or above.

english.name: Cooking With Style
english.description: Complete the Rats job with you and your four man crew having Combined Tactical Vests, Vulcan Miniguns, HRL-7 Rocket Launchers and General Overkill masks equipped on the OVERKILL difficulty or above.

french.name: Cuisiner avec style
french.description: Terminez le contrat Balances, en difficulté OVERKILL ou supérieure, alors que chaque membre de votre équipe de 4 est équipé d'un Gilet tactique polyvalent, du minigun Vulcan, du lance-roquettes HRL-7 et du masque "Général Overkill".

german.name: Stilvoll Kochen
german.description: Beende den Ratten-Überfall auf der Schwierigkeit OVERKILL oder höher, wobei jedes der 4 Crewmitglieder die taktische Panzerweste, die Vulcan-Minigun, den HRL-7-Raketenwerfer und die Maske "General Overkill" benutzt.

italian.name: Cucinare con stile
italian.description: Completa il contratto "SPIE" in difficoltà OVERKILL o superiore mentre tu e la tua squadra avete equipaggiato il giubbotto tattico combinato, il minigun Vulcan, il lanciarazzi HRL-7 e la maschera "GENERALE OVERKILL".

russian.name: Cooking With Style
russian.description: Complete the Rats job with you and your four man crew having Combined Tactical Vests, Vulcan Miniguns, HRL-7 Rocket Launchers and General Overkill masks equipped on the OVERKILL difficulty or above.

schinese.name: 有格调的制毒
schinese.description: 在OVERKILL或更高难度下完成“老鼠”任务，且你和你的四人小队全员装备组合战术背心、火神转管机枪、HRL-7火箭筒以及OVERKILL将军面具。

spanish.name: Cocinando con estilo
spanish.description: Completa el trabajo Ratas mientras tú y tu equipo de cuatro usan el Chaleco Táctico Combinado, la Minigun Vulcan, el Lanzacohetes HRL-7 y la máscara “General OVERKILL”, en la dificultad OVERKILL o más alta.

dutch.name: I Have No Idea What I'm Doing
dutch.description: In the Shadow Raid job, complete the heist in stealth while having the Vulcan Minigun and HRL-7 Rocket Launcher equipped.

english.name: I Have No Idea What I'm Doing
english.description: In the Shadow Raid job, complete the heist in stealth while having the Vulcan Minigun and HRL-7 Rocket Launcher equipped.

french.name: J'ai aucune idée de ce qu'il faut faire
french.description: Terminez le contrat Pillage nocturne, équipé du minigun Vulcan et du lance-roquettes HRL-7, sans déclencher l'alarme.

german.name: Keine Ahnung, was ich hier tue
german.description: Beende den Schattenraub-Überfall im Schleich-Modus, wobei du die Vulcan-Minigun und den HRL-7-Raketenwerfer ausgerüstet hast.

italian.name: Non ho idea di cosa sto facendo
italian.description: Completa il contratto "OMBRE CINESI" avendo equipaggiato il minigun Vulcan e il lanciarazzi HRL-7.

russian.name: Я понятия не имею что я делаю
russian.description: Завершите контракт "Теневой рейд", не поднимая тревоги, используя миниган Vulcan и гранатомёт HRL-7.

schinese.name: 我完全不知道自己在干嘛
schinese.description: 在“暗影突袭”任务中，装备火神转管机枪和HRL-7火箭筒，并以潜行方式完成劫案。

spanish.name: No sé qué estoy haciendo
spanish.description: Completa sigilosamente el trabajo Redada Sombra mientras llevas la Minigun Vulcan y el Lanzacohetes HRL-7.

dutch.name: Oh, That’s How You Do It
dutch.description: Fire the Vulcan Minigun for 25 seconds without reloading or letting go of the trigger.

english.name: Oh, That’s How You Do It
english.description: Fire the Vulcan Minigun for 25 seconds without reloading or letting go of the trigger.

french.name: Aah, c'est comme ça qu'il faut faire
french.description: Tirez avec le minigun Vulcan pendant 25 secondes sans recharger ni relâcher la gâchette.

german.name: Oh, so macht man das
german.description: Feuer die Vulcan-Minigun 25 Sekunden lang ohne nachzuladen oder den Abzug loszulassen.

italian.name: Ah, ecco come si fa!
italian.description: Spara con il minigun Vulcan per 25 secondi senza mai ricaricare e senza mai lasciare il grilletto.

russian.name: Ах вот как это делается
russian.description: Непрерывно стреляйте из минигана Vulcan в течение 25 секунд.

schinese.name: 哦，原来是这么用的
schinese.description: 在不换弹、不松开扳机的情况下，用火神转管机枪持续射击25秒。

spanish.name: Oh, así es como se hace
spanish.description: Dispara la Minigun Vulcan durante 25 segundos sin recargar ni soltar el gatillo.

dutch.name: We Are Rockstars On This Job
dutch.description: Complete the Watchdogs job with each crew member using no skills, wielding the AMCAR Rifle and Chimano 88 Pistol on OVERKILL difficulty or above.

english.name: We Are Rockstars On This Job
english.description: Complete the Watchdogs job with each crew member using no skills, wielding the AMCAR Rifle and Chimano 88 Pistol on OVERKILL difficulty or above.

french.name: À nous la vedette
french.description: Terminez le contrat Chiens de garde en difficulté OVERKILL ou supérieure. Chaque membre de l'équipe ne doit avoir aucune compétence et doit utiliser le fusil AMCAR ainsi que le pistolet Chimano 88.

german.name: Wir sind Rockstars in diesem Job
german.description: Beende den Wachhunde-Überfall auf der Schwierigkeit OVERKILL oder höher, wobei alle Crewmitglieder keine Fertigkeiten, das AMCAR-Gewehr und die Chimano-88-Pistole einsetzen.

italian.name: Questo lavoro fa per noi
italian.description: Completa il contratto "CANI DA GUARDIA" facendo in modo che tutti i membri della squadra non abbiano abilità e abbiano equipaggiato il fucile AMCAR e la pistola Chimano 88.

russian.name: Мы - рок-звёзды
russian.description: Завершите контракт "Сторожевые псы" вчетвером на уровне сложности "OVERKILL" или выше, используя винтовки AMCAR и одиночные пистолеты Chimano 88 так, чтобы ни у одного члена команды не было открыто ни одного навыка.

schinese.name: 这活儿我们是摇滚巨星
schinese.description: 在 OVERKILL 或更高难度下完成看门狗任务，每名队员均不使用任何技能，仅装备 AMCAR 步枪和奇马诺 88 手枪。

spanish.name: En este trabajo, seremos estrellas de rock
spanish.description: Completa el trabajo Perros Guardianes en la dificultad OVERKILL o más alta mientras todo el equipo lleva el Fusil AMCAR, la Pistola Chimano 88 y ninguna habilidad equipada.

dutch.name: Reputation Beyond Reproach
dutch.description: In the Breaking Ballot heist in the Election Day job, complete the heist with you and your four man crew without letting anyone getting downed, cloaked or cuffed on the Death Wish difficulty or above.

english.name: Reputation Beyond Reproach
english.description: In the Breaking Ballot heist in the Election Day job, complete the heist with you and your four man crew without letting anyone getting downed, cloaked or cuffed on the Death Wish difficulty or above.

french.name: Sans peur et sans reproche
french.description: Terminez le 2ème jour du contrat Election Day, "Bulletin nul", en Suicidaire. Aucun membre de votre équipe de 4 ne doit tomber à terre, se prendre un coup de pied de Cloaker ou se faire menotter.

german.name: Tadelloser Ruf
german.description: Beende an Tag 2 (Plan C, Wahlbetrug) den Wahltag-Überfall auf der Schwierigkeit Todesmut, wobei keines der 4 Crewmitglieder zu Boden geht, von einem Cloaker niedergeschlagen oder in Handschellen gelegt wird.

italian.name: Ottima reputazione
italian.description: Completa il secondo giorno (Elezioni guidate) del contratto "GIORNO DELL'ELEZIONE" in difficoltà Apocalisse senza che nessun membro della squadra cada a terra, venga colpito da un Cloaker o ammanettato dalle forze di polizia.

russian.name: Безупречная репутация
russian.description: Выполняя второй день контракта "День выборов" по плану C вчетвером, завершите контракт так, чтобы никто из четырёх игроков ни разу не упал, не был сбит с ног клокером и не был закован в наручники на уровне сложности "Жажда смерти".

schinese.name: 无可指摘的声誉
schinese.description: 在选举日任务的破坏选票行动中，于死亡之愿或更高难度下，你与四人小队完成行动，期间无人倒地、被潜伏者击晕或被戴上手铐。

spanish.name: Reputación indiscutible
spanish.description: Completa el día 2 (Voto Rompedor) del trabajo Día de las Elecciones sin que incapaciten o esposen a ningún jugador en la dificultad Death Wish.

dutch.name: House Keeping
dutch.description: In the Big Oil job, complete day one in stealth on the OVERKILL difficulty or above.

english.name: House Keeping
english.description: In the Big Oil job, complete day one in stealth on the OVERKILL difficulty or above.

french.name: C'est la femme de ménage
french.description: Terminez le 1er jour de Pétrole en péril sans déclencher l'alarme, en difficulté OVERKILL ou supérieure.

german.name: Ölschleich
german.description: Beende Tag 1 den Ölmultis-Überfall im Schleich-Modus auf der Schwierigkeit OVERKILL oder höher.

italian.name: Tutto in ordine
italian.description: Completa il primo giorno del contratto "ORO NERO" in difficoltà OVERKILL o superiore senza far scattare l'allarme.

russian.name: Работа по дому
russian.description: Завершите первый день контракта "Нефтяное дело" на уровне сложности "OVERKILL" или выше.

schinese.name: 内务整理
schinese.description: 在大石油任务中，于 OVERKILL 或更高难度下潜行完成第一天。

spanish.name: Mantenimiento de domicilios
spanish.description: Completa sigilosamente el día 1 del trabajo Fusión y Petróleo pro en la dificultad OVERKILL o más alta.

dutch.name: 120 Proof
dutch.description: Kill 120 or more enemies in any day in a heist, with you and your four man crew having at least 120% crew accuracy at the end of the heist.

english.name: 120 Proof
english.description: Kill 120 or more enemies in any day in a heist, with you and your four man crew having at least 120% crew accuracy at the end of the heist.

french.description: Dans n'importe quel casse, tuez au moins 120 ennemis en un seul jour. Votre équipe de 4 joueurs doit avoir atteint une précision d'équipe d'au moins 120% à la fin du casse.

german.name: 120 Prozent
german.description: Töte mindestens 120 Feinde an einem beliebigen Überfalltag, wobei du und deine 4-köpfige Crew am Ende des Überfalls eine Crew-Genauigkeit von 120% habt.

italian.description: Uccidi almeno 120 nemici durante un giorno di un qualsiasi contratto, facendo in modo che tu e la tua squadra totalizziate una precisione di squadra pari ad almeno il 120% alla fine del colpo.

russian.name: Меткий на все 120%
russian.description: Выполняя вчетвером любой день любого контракта, убейте не менее 120 противников так, чтобы общая точность команды по результатам ограбления была не менее 120%.

schinese.name: 120度烈酒
schinese.description: 在行动的任意一天击杀120名或更多敌人，且行动结束时你与四人小队的队伍准确率合计至少达到120%。

spanish.name: 120 Proof
spanish.description: Completa cualquier día o trabajo matando entre tú y tu equipo de cuatro a un total de 120 o más enemigos y con una precisión del equipo igual o mayor a 120%.

dutch.name: Boston Saints
dutch.description: Complete the Big Oil job, with at least one other player, all using suits and Akimbo Bernetti 9 Pistols on the OVERKILL difficulty or above.

english.name: Boston Saints
english.description: Complete the Big Oil job, with at least one other player, all using suits and Akimbo Bernetti 9 Pistols on the OVERKILL difficulty or above.

french.name: Boston Saints
french.description: Terminez le contrat Pétrole en péril, en difficulté OVERKILL ou supérieure, avec au moins un autre joueur. Chaque membre de l'équipe doit porter un costume deux pièces et utiliser des pistolets Bernetti 9 Akimbo.

german.name: Der blutige Pfad Bostons
german.description: Beende den Ölmultis-Überfall auf der Schwierigkeit OVERKILL oder höher mit mindestens einem Spieler, wobei alle Spieler den klassischen Anzug, und Akimbo-Bernetti-9-Pistolen benutzen.

italian.name: I santi di Boston
italian.description: Completa il contratto "ORO NERO" in difficoltà OVERKILL o superiore con almeno un altro giocatore. Ogni membro della squadra deve indossare l'abito elegante ed aver equipaggiato le pistole akimbo Bernetti 9.

russian.name: Святоши из Бостона
russian.description: Завершите контракт "Нефтяное дело" на уровне сложности "OVERKILL" или выше с ещё как минимум одним игроком так, чтобы все игроки были в костюмах и с парными пистолетами Bernetti 9.

schinese.name: 波士顿圣徒
schinese.description: 与至少一名其他玩家一起完成大石油任务，全员身穿西装、手持双持贝内蒂 9 手枪，难度为 OVERKILL 或更高。

spanish.name: Santos de Boston
spanish.description: Completa el trabajo Fusión y Petróleo pro con al menos otro jugador, mientras todos los jugadores solo usan el Traje de Dos Piezas/Sin Blindaje y las Pistolas Bernetti 9 duales en la dificultad OVERKILL o más alta.

dutch.name: Bring Your Cop To Work Day
dutch.description: On any day of a heist, have four law enforcers converted at the same time on the OVERKILL difficulty or above.

english.name: Bring Your Cop To Work Day
english.description: On any day of a heist, have four law enforcers converted at the same time on the OVERKILL difficulty or above.

french.name: Promotion sur les poulets
french.description: Dans n'importe quel casse en difficulté OVERKILL ou supérieure, faites en sorte d'avoir 4 flics convertis en même temps.

german.name: Praktikanten gesucht
german.description: Habe bei einem beliebigen Überfall auf der Schwierigkeit OVERKILL oder höher vier Polizisten gleichzeitig konvertiert.

italian.name: Porta il tuo sbirro al lavoro
italian.description: Durante un qualsiasi contratto in difficoltà OVERKILL o superiore, fai in modo di avere quattro nemici convertiti allo stesso tempo.

russian.name: Домашний питомец
russian.description: Выполняя любой контракт на уровне сложности "OVERKILL" или выше, переведите на свою сторону четырёх полицейских одновременно.

schinese.name: 带警察上班日
schinese.description: 在行动的任意一天，于 OVERKILL 或更高难度下同时策反四名执法人员。

spanish.name: Hoy es el día de llevar a tu policía al trabajo
spanish.description: En cualquier golpe, ten a cuatro enemigos convertidos a la vez en la dificultad OVERKILL o más alta.

dutch.name: Wasteful
dutch.description: In the Firestarter job, complete day one having burned all weapons on the Death Wish difficulty or above.

english.name: Wasteful
english.description: In the Firestarter job, complete day one having burned all weapons on the Death Wish difficulty or above.

french.name: Un vrai gâchis

german.name: Verschwenderisch
german.description: Beende Tag 1 des Brandstifter-Überfalls auf der Schwierigkeit Todesmut, nachdem du alle Waffen verbrannt hast.

italian.name: Sprecone

russian.name: Растратчик
russian.description: Завершите первый день контракта "Поджигатель" и сожгите всё оружие на уровне сложности "Жажда смерти".

schinese.name: 挥霍无度
schinese.description: 在纵火狂任务中，于死亡之愿或更高难度下完成第一天，并烧毁所有武器。

spanish.name: Desperdicio

dutch.name: Speedlock Holmes
