english.name: Speedlock Holmes
english.description: On day 1 of the Election Day job, tag the right truck and leave within a minute of the start of the heist.

french.name: Véloce Holmes
french.description: Au 1er jour d'Election Day, marquez le bon camion et partez en moins d'une minute, en comptant à partir du début du casse.

german.name: Schnelllock Holmes
german.description: Markiere an Tag 1 des Wahltag-Überfalls den richtigen Laster und verschwinde innerhalb von einer Minute nach Beginn des Überfalls.

schinese.name: 速尔摩斯

spanish.description: Completa el día 1 del trabajo Día de las Elecciones en menos de un 1 minuto y marcando el camión correcto.

english.name: Nothing Out of the Ordinary

french.name: Rien à signaler

german.name: Nichts Außergewöhnliches

italian.name: Non c'è niente che non va

russian.name: Ничего необычного

schinese.name: 一切如常

spanish.name: Nada fuera de lo normal
spanish.description: Contesta a 4 buscas por ti mismo en menos de 90 segundos a partir de contestar el primero.

dutch.name: Situation Normal
dutch.description: In the Hoxton Breakout job, complete day 2 without using a single keycard on the OVERKILL difficulty or above.

english.name: Situation Normal

french.name: Tout est en ordre
french.description: Terminez le 2ème jour du contrat Évasion d'Hoxton, en difficulté OVERKILL ou supérieure, sans utiliser une seule carte d'accès.

german.name: Situation normal
german.description: Beende Tag 2 des Hoxton-Ausbruchs auf der Schwierigkeit OVERKILL oder höher, ohne eine Schlüsselkarte zu benutzen.

russian.name: Всё в порядке

schinese.name: 情况正常

spanish.name: Situación bajo control
spanish.description: Completa el día 2 del trabajo La Fuga de Hoxton sin usar tarjetas en la dificultad OVERKILL o más alta.

dutch.name: Keep the Party Going

english.name: Keep the Party Going
english.description: In the Nightclub job, zip-tie the DJ and bring him to the escape zone by the escape van.

french.name: Que la fête continue
french.description: Dans le contrat Boîte de nuit, attachez le DJ et amenez-le jusqu'au fourgon.

german.description: Fessele beim Nachtclub-Überfall den DJ und schaffe ihn in die Fluchtzone beim Fluchttransporter.

italian.name: La festa deve continuare

dutch.name: It's Getting Hot in Here

english.name: It's Getting Hot in Here

french.name: Il commence à faire chaud ici

german.description: Beende Tag 3 des Brandstifter-Überfalls auf der Schwierigkeit Todesmut, wobei du mit deiner Crew im Tresorraum bleibst, bis das ganze Geld verbrannt ist.

dutch.name: Cooking By the Book

english.name: Cooking By the Book
english.description: Complete the Cook Off job on the Death Wish difficulty or above.

french.name: Il suffit de suivre la recette

german.name: Ultimatives Kochduell

italian.name: Cuoco provetto

russian.name: Готовка по рецепту

schinese.name: 照谱烹饪

german.name: Erster!

spanish.name: ¡Alcánzame si puedes!

dutch.name: A Dish Best Served Cold

english.name: A Dish Best Served Cold
english.description: Complete the Hoxton Revenge job on the Death Wish difficulty or above.

french.name: Un plat qui se mange froid

german.name: Rache ist Blutwurst

italian.name: Un piatto che va servito freddo
italian.description: Completa il contratto "VENDETTA DI HOXTON" in difficoltà Apocalisse.

russian.name: Блюдо, которое подаётся холодным
russian.description: Завершите контракт "Месть Хокстона" на уровне сложности "Жажда смерти".

english.description: Complete the Hoxton Revenge job without triggering the alarm.

french.name: La mort arrive sans prévenir
french.description: Terminez le contrat Vengeance d'Hoxton sans déclencher l'alarme.

italian.name: La morte silenziosa

russian.name: Скрытный и опасный

french.name: Super sans plomb

italian.description: Fai in modo di bruciare 10 nemici allo stesso tempo. Sblocca la maschera "GRAUG", il materiale "CARBONE" e il motivo "FUOCO E FIAMME".

russian.name: Диско инферно
russian.description: Сделайте так, чтобы 10 врагов горели одновременно. Выполнение дстижения открывает маску "Грауг", материал "Уголь" и рисунок "Огнерождённый".

schinese.name: 迪斯科炼狱
schinese.description: 让10名敌人同时燃烧。解锁“格劳格”面具、“煤炭”材质和“浴火而生”图案。

spanish.name: Discoteca infernal
spanish.description: Haz que 10 enemigos estén en llamas al mismo tiempo. Desbloquea la máscara “Graug”, el material “Carbón” y el patrón “Nacido del fuego”. (Tu equipo puede ayudarte con este logro)

dutch.name: Stick a Fork in Me, I'm Done
dutch.description: Set an enemy on fire and kill him with the "Motherforker" melee weapon. Unlocks "The Gas Mask" mask, "Candlelight" material and "Flammable" pattern.

english.name: Stick a Fork in Me, I'm Done
english.description: Set an enemy on fire and kill him with the "Motherforker" melee weapon. Unlocks "The Gas Mask" mask, "Candlelight" material and "Flammable" pattern.

french.name: Piquez la viande pour vérifier la cuisson
french.description: Enflammez un ennemi et tuez-le à la mêlée avec "L'Enfourcheur". Débloque le masque "Masque à gaz", le matériau "Aux chandelles" et le motif "Inflammable".

german.name: Mit Essen spielt man nicht
german.description: Setze einen Feind in Brand und töte ihn mit der "Mutterforke"-Nahkampfwaffe. Schaltet die Maske "Die Gasmaske", das Material "Kerzenlicht" und das Muster "Brennbar" frei.

italian.name: Assaggiami, sono quasi pronto
italian.description: Incendia un nemico e uccidilo con l'arma da mischia "Forchettone". Sblocca la maschera "MASCHERA ANTIGAS", il materiale "LUME DI CANDELA" e il motivo "INFIAMMABILE".

russian.name: Можешь воткнуть в меня вилку. Я готов.
russian.description: Подожгите противника и убейте его оружием ближнего боя "Motherforker". Выполнение достижения открывает маску "Противогаз", материал "Горящая свеча" и рисунок "Огнеопасно".

schinese.name: 叉子插我，我熟了
schinese.description: 点燃一名敌人，再用“妈了个叉”近战武器将其击杀。解锁“防毒面具”面具、“烛光”材质和“易燃”图案。

spanish.name: Que me claven un tenedor, ya he tenido suficiente
spanish.description: Quema a un enemigo y mátalo con el arma cuerpo a cuerpo El "Motherforker”. Desbloquea “La Máscara de Gas”, el material “Luz de vela” y el patrón “Inflamable”.

dutch.name: Not Invited
dutch.description: Kill 10 enemies within 10 seconds using the Piglet Grenade Launcher without using Incendiary rounds. Unlocks the "Firefighter's Helmet" mask, "Burn" material and "Flamer" pattern.

english.name: Not Invited
english.description: Kill 10 enemies within 10 seconds using the Piglet Grenade Launcher without using Incendiary rounds. Unlocks the "Firefighter's Helmet" mask, "Burn" material and "Flamer" pattern.

french.name: On vous a pas invités
french.description: Tuez 10 ennemis en moins de 10 secondes à l'aide du lance-grenades Piglet, sans utiliser les grenades incendiaires. Débloque le masque "Casque de pompier", le matériau "Brûlé" et le motif "Enflammé".

german.name: Nicht eingeladen
german.description: Töte 10 Feinde in 10 Sekunden mit dem Piglet-Granatenwerfer ohne Brandmunition. Schaltet die Maske "Feuerwehrhelm", das Material "Brand" und das Muster "Flamer" frei.

italian.name: Senza invito
italian.description: Uccidi 10 nemici in meno di 10 secondi utilizzando il lanciagranate Piglet non equipaggiato con i colpi incendiari. Sblocca la maschera "ELMETTO DA VIGILE DEL FUOCO", il materiale "BRUCIATURA" e il motivo "FIAMMEGGIANTE".

russian.name: Без приглашения
russian.description: Убейте 10 противников в течение 10 секунд с помощью гранатомёта Piglet. Запрещается использовать зажигательные боеприпасы. Выполнение достижения открывает маску "Шлем пожарного", материал "Огонь" и рисунок "Поджигатель".

schinese.name: 不速之客
schinese.description: 在10秒内用“小猪”榴弹发射器击杀10名敌人，且不使用燃烧弹。解锁“消防员头盔”面具、“灼烧”材质和“喷火者”图案。

spanish.name: No han sido invitados
spanish.description: Mata a 10 enemigos en menos de 10 segundos con el Lanzagranadas Cerdito sin cartuchos incendiarios. Desbloquea la máscara “Casco de Bombero”, el material “Quemadura” y el patrón “Calentador”.

dutch.name: OVERGRILL
dutch.description: Set a Bulldozer on fire for at least 10 seconds. Unlocks "The Chef" mask, "Toast" material and "Hot Flames" pattern.

english.name: OVERGRILL
english.description: Set a Bulldozer on fire for at least 10 seconds. Unlocks "The Chef" mask, "Toast" material and "Hot Flames" pattern.

french.name: OVERGRILL
french.description: Enflammez un Bulldozer pendant au moins 10 secondes. Débloque le masque "Le Chef", le matériau "Toast" et le motif "Flammes brûlantes".

german.name: OVERGRILL
german.description: Setzt einen Bulldozer mindestens 10 Sekunden lang in Brand. Schaltet die Maske "Der Chefkoch", das Material "Toast" und das Muster "Heiße Flammen" frei.

italian.name: OVERGRILL
italian.description: Incendia un Bulldozer per almeno 10 secondi. Sblocca la maschera "LO CHEF", il materiale "TOAST" e il motivo "FIAMME ROVENTI".

russian.name: OVERGRILL
russian.description: Подожгите бульдозера на 10 секунд. Выполнение достижения открывает маску "Шеф-повар", материал "Тост" и рисунок "Пламя".

schinese.name: 烤过头
schinese.description: 让一名推土机燃烧至少10秒。解锁“厨师”面具、“吐司”材质和“炽焰”图案。

spanish.name: OVERGRILL
spanish.description: Quema a un Bulldozer por al menos 10 segundos. Desbloquea la máscara “El Chef”, el material “Tostado” y el patrón “Llamas calientes”. (Tu equipo puede ayudarte con este logro)

dutch.name: Recycling
dutch.description: Pick up 100 arrows. Unlocks the "Desert Skull" mask, "Western Sunset" material and "Mystical" pattern.

english.name: Recycling
english.description: Pick up 100 arrows. Unlocks the "Desert Skull" mask, "Western Sunset" material and "Mystical" pattern.

french.name: Recyclage
french.description: Ramassez 100 flèches. Débloque le masque "Crâne du désert", le matériau "Coucher de soleil Western" et le motif "Mystique".

german.name: Recycling
german.description: Hebe 100 Pfeile auf. Schaltet die Maske "Wüstenschädel", das Material "Abendrot" und das Muster "Mystisch" frei.

italian.name: Riciclaggio
italian.description: Raccogli 100 frecce. Sblocca la maschera "TESCHIO DEL DESERTO", il materiale "TRAMONTO DEL WEST" e il motivo "MISTICO".

russian.name: Утилизация
russian.description: Соберите 100 стрел. Выполнение достижения открывает маску "Пустынный череп", материал "Западный закат" и рисунок "Мистический".

schinese.name: 回收利用
schinese.description: 捡起100支箭。解锁“沙漠骷髅”面具、“西部日落”材质和“神秘”图案。

spanish.name: Reciclaje
spanish.description: Recoge 100 flechas. Desbloquea la máscara “Cráneo del Desierto”, el material “Atardecer del oeste” y el patrón “Místico”.

dutch.name: The Nobel Prize
dutch.description: Kill 3 enemies at the same time with the Dynamite. Unlocks the "Wild West Classic" mask, "Cactus" material and "Coyote" pattern.

english.name: The Nobel Prize
english.description: Kill 3 enemies at the same time with the Dynamite. Unlocks the "Wild West Classic" mask, "Cactus" material and "Coyote" pattern.

french.name: Prix Nobel
french.description: Tuez 3 ennemis d'une seule explosion de dynamite. Débloque le masque "Grand classique du Far West", le matériau "Cactus" et le motif "Coyote".

german.name: Der Nobelpreis
german.description: Töte mit dem Dynamit 3 Feinde auf einmal. Schaltet die Maske "Wildwest-Klassiker", das Material "Kaktus" und das Muster "Coyote" frei.

italian.name: Il Premio Nobel
italian.description: Uccidi 3 nemici con un singolo candelotto di dinamite. Sblocca la maschera "CLASSICO DEL FAR WEST", il materiale "CACTUS" e il motivo "COYOTE".

russian.name: Нобелевская премия
russian.description: Убейте трёх противников одним взрывом динамита. Выполнение достижения открывает маску "Классика дикого запада", материал "Кактус" и рисунок "Койот".

schinese.name: 诺贝尔奖
schinese.description: 用炸药同时炸死3名敌人。解锁“狂野西部经典”面具、“仙人掌”材质和“郊狼”图案。

spanish.name: El premio Nobel
spanish.description: Mata a 3 enemigos con una sola Dinamita arrojadiza. Desbloquea la máscara “Clásico del Salvaje Oeste”, el material “Cactus” y el patrón “Coyote”.

dutch.name: Hedgehog
dutch.description: Get 10 or more arrows stuck in a Bulldozer at the same time. Unlocks the "Lone Heister" mask, "Scorpion" material and "Totem" pattern.

english.name: Hedgehog
english.description: Get 10 or more arrows stuck in a Bulldozer at the same time. Unlocks the "Lone Heister" mask, "Scorpion" material and "Totem" pattern.

french.name: Porc-épic
french.description: Plantez plus de 10 flèches dans un Bulldozer vivant. Débloque le masque "Braqueur solitaire", le matériau "Scorpion" et le motif "Totem".

german.name: Igel
german.description: Schaffe es, dass mindestens 10 Pfeile gleichzeitig in einem Bulldozer stecken. Schaltet die Maske "Einsamer Räuber", das Material "Skorpion" und das Muster "Totem" frei.

italian.name: Il riccio
italian.description: Colpisci un singolo Bulldozer con almeno 10 frecce. Sblocca la maschera "RAPINATORE SOLITARIO", il materiale "SCORPIONE" e il motivo "TOTEM".

russian.name: Дикообраз
russian.description: Оставьте 10 стрел в бульдозере. Выполнение достижения открывает маску "Вор-одиночка", материал "Скорпион" и рисунок "Тотем".

schinese.name: 刺猬
schinese.description: 让10支或更多箭同时插在一名推土机身上。解锁“独行劫匪”面具、“蝎子”材质和“图腾”图案。

spanish.name: Erizo
spanish.description: Haz que un Bulldozer tenga 10 o más flechas clavadas al mismo tiempo. Desbloquea la máscara “Ladrón Solitario”, el material “Escorpión” y el patrón “Tótem”. (Tu equipo puede ayudarte con este logro)

dutch.name: Fastest Gun in the West
dutch.description: Kill 6 law enforcers within 6 seconds of killing the first while hipfiring with the Peacemaker .45 Revolver. Unlocks the "Apache Mystic" mask, "Gold Fever" material and "Sacred" pattern.

english.name: Fastest Gun in the West
english.description: Kill 6 law enforcers within 6 seconds of killing the first while hipfiring with the Peacemaker .45 Revolver. Unlocks the "Apache Mystic" mask, "Gold Fever" material and "Sacred" pattern.

french.name: L'homme qui tirait plus vite que son ombre
french.description: Tuez 6 flics en moins de 6 secondes en tirant à la hanche avec le revolver Peacemaker .45. Débloque le masque "Mystique apache", le matériau "Fièvre de l'or" et le motif "Sacré".

german.name: Schnellster Revolver des Westens
german.description: Töte mit dem Peacemaker-.45-Revolver aus der Hüfte schießend innerhalb von 6 Sekunden 6 Polizisten. Schaltet die Maske "Apachen-Mystiker", das Material "Goldfieber" und das Muster "Heilig" frei.

italian.name: La pistola più veloce del West
italian.description: Uccidi 6 sbirri in meno di 6 secondi sparando senza mirare con il revolver Peacemaker .45. Sblocca la maschera "MASCHERA APACHE", il materiale "FEBBRE DELL'ORO" e il motivo "CONSACRATO".

russian.name: Самый быстрый стрелок на западе
russian.description: Убейте 6 полицейских за 6 секунд, ведя стрельбу от бедра с револьвером Peacemaker .45. Выполнение достижения открывает маску "Мистик апачей", материал "Золотая лихорадка" и рисунок "Священный".

schinese.name: 西部第一快枪
schinese.description: 用“和平使者”.45左轮手枪腰射，在击杀第一名执法人员后的6秒内击杀6名执法人员。解锁“阿帕奇秘术师”面具、“淘金热”材质和“神圣”图案。

spanish.name: El arma más rápida del oeste
spanish.description: Mata a 6 policías en menos de 6 segundos de matar al primero y disparando desde la cadera con el Revólver Peacemaker .45. Desbloquea la máscara “Apache Místico”, el material “Fiebre del oro” y el patrón “Sagrado”.

dutch.name: Pedal to the Metal
dutch.description: Complete the Meltdown job on the Death Wish difficulty or above.

english.name: Pedal to the Metal
english.description: Complete the Meltdown job on the Death Wish difficulty or above.

french.name: Pied au plancher
french.description: Terminez le contrat Fusion en difficulté Suicidaire.

german.name: Vollgas
german.description: Beende den Kernschmelze-Überfall auf der Schwierigkeit Todesmut.

italian.name: A tavoletta
italian.description: Completa il contratto "FUSIONE NUCLEARE" in difficoltà Apocalisse.

russian.name: Гашетку в пол
russian.description: Завершите контракт "Ядерная угроза" на уровне сложности "Жажда смерти".

schinese.name: 油门踩到底
schinese.description: 在“死亡之愿”或更高难度下完成“熔毁”任务。

spanish.name: Con el pedal pegado al metal
spanish.description: Completa el trabajo Riesgo Nuclear en la dificultad Death Wish.

dutch.name: Sunday Drive
dutch.description: Complete the Meltdown job.

english.name: Sunday Drive
english.description: Complete the Meltdown job.

french.name: Une petite ballade tranquille
french.description: Terminez le contrat Fusion.

german.name: Spazierfahrt
german.description: Beende den Kernschmelze-Überfall.

italian.name: Una tranquilla gita della domenica
italian.description: Completa il contratto "FUSIONE NUCLEARE".

russian.name: Воскресная поездка
russian.description: Завершите контракт "Ядерная угроза".

schinese.name: 周日兜风

spanish.name: Paseando en un Domingo
spanish.description: Completa el trabajo Riesgo Nuclear.

english.name: They Don’t Pay Us Enough
english.description: In the Meltdown job, secure all additional loot. Unlocks the "Rad Mutant" mask.

french.name: On nous paye pas assez
french.description: Dans le contrat Fusion, récupérez tous les sacs bonus. Débloque le masque "Mutant tendance".

german.name: Sie bezahlen uns nicht genug
german.description: Sichere beim Kernschmelze-Überfall sämtliche zusätzliche Beute. Schaltet die Maske "Strahlungsmutant" frei.

italian.name: Non ci pagano abbastanza
italian.description: Durante il contratto "FUSIONE NUCLEARE", recupera tutto il bottino extra. Sblocca la maschera "IL MUTANTE ALLA MODA".

russian.name: Они мало нам платят
russian.description: Выполняя контракт "Ядерная угроза", унесите с собой все дополнительные сумки с ценностями. Выполнение достижения открывает маску "Радиоактивный мутант".

schinese.name: 他们给的钱不够多
schinese.description: 在熔毁劫案中，带走所有额外赃物。解锁“辐射变种人”面具。

spanish.name: No nos pagan los suficiente
spanish.description: En el trabajo Riesgo Nuclear, asegura todas las bolsas opcionales. Desbloquea la máscara “Mutante Radioactivo”.

dutch.name: There Was a Car?!
dutch.description: In the Meltdown job, complete the heist without using the "Longfellow".

english.name: There Was a Car?!
english.description: In the Meltdown job, complete the heist without using the "Longfellow".

french.name: Attendez, y'avait une caisse ?!
french.description: Terminez le contrat Fusion sans utiliser la voiture "Longfellow".

german.name: Da war ein Auto?!
german.description: Beende den Kernschmelze-Überfall, ohne den "Longfellow" zu benutzen.

italian.name: C'era un auto?!
italian.description: Completa il contratto "FUSIONE NUCLEARE" senza usare la "Longfellow".

russian.name: Разве там была машина?!
russian.description: Завершите контракт "Ядерная угроза", не используя автомобиль "Longfellow".

schinese.name: 刚才有辆车吗？！
schinese.description: 在熔毁劫案中，不使用“朗费罗”完成劫案。

spanish.name: ¡¿Había un auto?!

english.name: We Built This City on Electric Progressive House Music

french.name: Sur un prélude d'electro house progressive

german.name: We Built This City on Electric Progressive House Music
german.description: Beende den Alesso-Überfall auf der Schwierigkeit Todesmut.

italian.name: Una città costruita con musica elettronica

russian.name: Мы построили этот город на электро

schinese.name: 我们用电子渐进浩室乐筑起了这座城市

spanish.name: Construimos esta ciudad a base de música electrónica y house progresivo

dutch.name: Sound of Silence

english.name: Sound of Silence
english.description: Complete the Alesso Heist without your crew killing anyone. Unlocks the "Boom Box" mask, "Enlightenment" material and "Alesso Logo" pattern.

french.name: Chanson d'innocence
french.description: Terminez le contrat Concert d'Alesso sans tuer qui que ce soit. Débloque le masque "Boombox", le matériau "Illumination" et le motif "Logo d'Alesso".

german.name: Sound of Silence
german.description: Beende den Alesso-Überfall, ohne jemanden zu töten. Schaltet die Maske "Boom Box", das Material "Erleuchtung" und das Muster "Alesso-Logo" frei.

italian.name: Il suono del silenzio
italian.description: Completa il contratto "IL CONCERTO DI ALESSO" senza uccidere nessuno. Sblocca la maschera "STEREO PORTATILE", il materiale "ILLUMINAZIONE" e il motivo "IL LOGO DI ALESSO".

russian.name: Звук тишины
russian.description: Завершите контракт "Алессо", никого не убив. Выполнение достижения открывает маску "Бумбокс", материал "Просветление" и рисунок "Логотип Алессо".

schinese.name: 寂静之声
schinese.description: 在你的队伍没有击杀任何人的情况下完成 Alesso 劫案。解锁“轰鸣音箱”面具、“启蒙”材质和“Alesso 标志”图案。

spanish.name: El sonido del silencio
spanish.description: Completa el trabajo El Golpe de Alesso sin que nadie mate guardias o civiles. Desbloquea la máscara “Equipo de Música”, el material “Ilustración” y el patrón “El logo de Alesso”.

dutch.name: Even Steven
dutch.description: In the Alesso heist job, get your seven bucks back. Unlocks the "Cantus" mask, "Bionic" material and "Circle Raster" pattern.

english.name: Even Steven
english.description: In the Alesso heist job, get your seven bucks back. Unlocks the "Cantus" mask, "Bionic" material and "Circle Raster" pattern.

french.name: On est quittes
french.description: Dans le contrat Concert d'Alesso, récupérez vos 7 dollars. Débloque le masque "Cantus", le matériau "Bionique" et le motif "Trame de cercle".

german.name: Quitt
german.description: Hol dir beim Alesso-Überfall deine sieben Dollar zurück. Schaltet die Maske "Cantus", das Material "Bionisch" und das Muster "Kreisraster" frei.

italian.name: Ora siamo pari
italian.description: Durante il contratto "IL CONCERTO DI ALESSO", fai in modo di recuperare i tuoi sette dollari. Sblocca la maschera "CANTUS", il materiale "BIONICO" e il motivo "INGRANDIMENTO CIRCOLARE".

russian.name: Even Steven
russian.description: Верните свои честно заработанные семь долларов, выполняя контракт "Алессо". Выполнение достижения открывает маску "Кантус", материал "Бионик" и рисунок "Круговой растр".

schinese.name: 两不相欠

dutch.name: Fuck It, We're Walking

english.name: Fuck It, We're Walking

french.description: Terminez le Concert d'Alesso, en difficulté OVERKILL ou supérieure, en ayant déclenché l'alarme et sans utiliser de monte-plat ou de tyrolienne. Débloque le masque "Habituée des concerts", le matériau "Vitrail" et le motif "Onde sonore".

german.name: Scheiß drauf, wir gehen
german.description: Beende den Alesso-Überfall auf der Schwierigkeit OVERKILL oder höher, ohne deine primäre Waffe zu benutzen. Schaltet die Maske "Konzertbesucherin", das Material "Glasmalerei" und das Muster "Schallwelle" frei.

italian.name: A passo d'uomo
italian.description: Completa il contratto "IL CONCERTO DI ALESSO" in difficoltà OVERKILL o superiore dopo aver fatto scattare l'allarme e facendo in modo di non usare la teleferica o i montacarichi per i borsoni. Sblocca la maschera "LA FANATICA DI CONCERTI", il materiale "VETRO COLORATO" e il motivo "ONDA SONORA".

russian.name: К чёрту всё это, мы пойдём пешком
russian.description: Завершите контракт "Алессо" на уровне сложности "OVERKILL" или выше по-громкому, не используя зиплайны и лифты для переноски сумок. Выполнение достижения открывает маску "Девушка-фанат", материал "Цветное стекло" и рисунок "Звуковая волна".

schinese.name: 去他的，走着去
schinese.description: 在 Alesso 劫案中，以强攻方式在不使用滑索和丢包滑道的情况下于 OVERKILL 或更高难度完成劫案。解锁“女观众”面具、“彩绘玻璃”材质和“声波”图案。

spanish.name: A la mierda con los atajos, lo haremos caminando
spanish.description: Completa el trabajo El Golpe de Alesso sin optar por el sigilo y sin usar los transportadores verticales o la tirolina en la dificultad OVERKILL o más alta. Desbloquea la máscara “Fan Femenina”, el material “Vitral” y el patrón “Onda sonora”.

dutch.name: M.F. Stev
dutch.description: In the Alesso Heist job, complete the pyrosequences without failing even once. Unlocks the "Male Concert Goer" mask, "Dim Blue" material and "Smoke" pattern.

english.name: M.F. Stev
english.description: In the Alesso Heist job, complete the pyrosequences without failing even once. Unlocks the "Male Concert Goer" mask, "Dim Blue" material and "Smoke" pattern.

french.name: M.F. Stev
french.description: Dans le contrat Concert d'Alesso, complétez la séquence des effets pyrotechniques sans vous tromper une seule fois. Débloque le masque "Habitué des concerts", le matériau "Bleu pâle" et le motif "Fumée".

german.name: M.F. Stev
german.description: Beende im Alesso-Überfall die Pyrotechnik-Steuerung ohne einen Fehler. Schaltet die Maske "Konzertbesucher", das Material "Graublau" und das Muster "Rauch" frei.

italian.name: M.F. Stev
italian.description: Durante il contratto "IL CONCERTO DI ALESSO", completa la sequenza degli effetti pirotecnici senza sbagliare neanche una volta. Sblocca la maschera "IL FANATICO DI CONCERTI", il materiale "BLU PALLIDO" e il motivo "FUMO".

russian.name: M.F. Stev
russian.description: Выполняя контракт "Алессо", не ошибитесь ни разу, работая пиротехниками. Выполнение достижения открывает маску "Мужчина-фанат", материал "Тускло-синий" и рисунок "Дым".

schinese.name: M.F. 斯蒂夫
schinese.description: 在 Alesso 劫案中，完成所有烟火序列且一次都不失败。解锁“男观众”面具、“暗蓝”材质和“烟雾”图案。

spanish.name: M.F. Stev
spanish.description: En el trabajo El Golpe de Alesso, completa las secuencias de la cabina de pirotecnia sin fallar ni una vez. Desbloquea la máscara “Fan Masculino”, el material “Azul tenue” y el patrón “Humo”.

dutch.name: How the Fuck Can You Grin?
dutch.description: Complete the Golden Grin Casino job  on the Death Wish difficulty or above.

english.name: How the Fuck Can You Grin?
english.description: Complete the Golden Grin Casino job  on the Death Wish difficulty or above.

french.name: Et ça vous fait marrer, vous ?
french.description: Terminez le contrat Casino Golden Grin en difficulté Suicidaire.

german.name: Wie kannst du noch grinsen?
german.description: Beende den Golden-Grin-Casino-Überfall auf der Schwierigkeit Todesmut.

italian.name: Non c'è niente da ridere
italian.description: Completa il contratto "CASINÒ GOLDEN GRIN" in difficoltà Apocalisse.

russian.name: И ты ещё ухмыляешься?
russian.description: Завершите контракт "Казино Golden Grin" на уровне сложности "Жажда смерти".

schinese.name: 你他妈还笑得出来？
schinese.description: 在死亡愿望或更高难度下完成金色笑容赌场劫案。

spanish.name: ¿Cómo diablos puedes sonreír?
spanish.description: Completa el trabajo Casino Golden Grin en la dificultad Death Wish.

dutch.name: Blind Eye in the Sky
dutch.description: Complete the Golden Grin Casino heist in stealth. Unlocks the "Wheeler Dealer" mask, "Stars" material and "Chips" pattern.

english.name: Blind Eye in the Sky
english.description: Complete the Golden Grin Casino heist in stealth. Unlocks the "Wheeler Dealer" mask, "Stars" material and "Chips" pattern.

french.name: Ce qui se passe à Vegas reste à Vegas
french.description: Terminez le contrat Casino Golden Grin discrètement. Débloque le masque "Dealeur sans-peur", le matériau "Étoiles" et le motif "Jetons".

german.name: Blindes Auge am Himmel
german.description: Beende den Golden-Grin-Casino-Überfall im Schleich-Modus. Schaltet die Maske "Plastik-Schirmmütze", das Material "Sterne" und das Muster "Chips" frei.

italian.name: Un occhio cieco nel cielo
italian.description: Completa il contratto "CASINÒ GOLDEN GRIN" senza far scattare l'allarme. Sblocca la maschera "L'AFFARISTA", il materiale "STELLE" e il motivo "FICHES".

russian.name: Защита от солнца
russian.description: Завершите контракт "Казино Golden Grin", не поднимая тревогу. Выполнение достижения открывает маску "Козырёк крупье", материал "Звёзды" и рисунок "Фишки".

schinese.name: 天上的盲眼
schinese.description: 以潜入方式完成金色笑容赌场劫案。解锁“投机商人”面具、“星辰”材质和“筹码”图案。

spanish.name: Ojo ciego en el cielo
spanish.description: Completa sigilosamente el trabajo Casino Golden Grin. Desbloquea la máscara "Croupier", el material "Estrellas" y el patrón "Fichas".

dutch.name: City of Sin and Well-Oiled Gears
dutch.description: Complete the Golden Grin Casino heist without having the Big Fucking Drill ever break in loud. Unlocks the "Murmillo Galea Helmet" mask, "Casino" material and "Royale" pattern.

english.name: City of Sin and Well-Oiled Gears
english.description: Complete the Golden Grin Casino heist without having the Big Fucking Drill ever break in loud. Unlocks the "Murmillo Galea Helmet" mask, "Casino" material and "Royale" pattern.

french.name: La ville du pêché et des machines bien huilées
french.description: Terminez le contrat Casino Golden Grin sans jamais laisser la Putain de Perceuse Géante s'arrêter. Débloque le masque "Casque de Mirmillon Galea", le matériau "Casino" et le motif "Royale".

german.name: Stadt der Sünde und gute geschmierte Maschine
german.description: Beende den Golden-Grin-Casino-Überfall laut, ohne dass der Big Fucking Drill kaputt geht. Schaltet die Maske "Murmillo-Galea-Helm", das Material "Kasino" und das Muster "Royale" frei.

italian.name: Città di peccatori e ingranaggi ben oliati
italian.description: Completa il contratto "CASINÒ GOLDEN GRIN" senza mai lasciare che il trapano usato per accedere al caveau si fermi. Sblocca la maschera "ELMO DA GUERRA DEL MURMILLO", il materiale "CASINÒ" e il motivo "REGALE".

russian.name: Город грехов и качественных деталей
russian.description: Завершите контракт "Казино Golden Grin" и ни разу не дайте ОБД остановиться. Выполнение достижения открывает маску "Шлем мурмиллона", материал "Казино" и рисунок "Королевский".

schinese.name: 罪恶之城与顺滑齿轮
schinese.description: 在强攻中完成金色笑容赌场劫案，且“他妈的大钻机”从未损坏。解锁“穆尔米洛角斗士头盔”面具、“赌场”材质和“皇家”图案。

spanish.name: La ciudad del pecado y unos engranajes bien aceitados
spanish.description: Completa el trabajo Casino Golden Grin sin optar por el sigilo y sin que el BFD se detenga ni una vez. Desbloquea la máscara "Casco de Murmillo Galea", el material "Casino" y el patrón "Royale".

dutch.name: High Roller
dutch.description: Complete the Golden Grin Casino heist under 14 minutes. Unlocks "The King" mask, "Plush" material and "Cards" pattern.

english.name: High Roller
english.description: Complete the Golden Grin Casino heist under 14 minutes. Unlocks "The King" mask, "Plush" material and "Cards" pattern.

french.name: Flambeur
french.description: Terminez le contrat Casino Golden Grin en moins de 14 minutes. Débloque le masque "Le King", le matériau "Peluche" et le motif "Cartes".

german.name: Schnell abgezockt
german.description: Beende den Golden-Grin-Casino-Überfall unter 14 Minuten. Schaltet die Maske "Der King", das Material "Plüsch" und das Muster "Karten" frei.

italian.name: Giocatore d'azzardo
italian.description: Completa il contratto "CASINÒ GOLDEN GRIN" in meno di 14 minuti. Sblocca la maschera "IL RE", il materiale "PELUCHE" e il motivo "CARTE".

russian.name: Крупный игрок
russian.description: Завершите контракт "Казино Golden Grin" не более чем за 14 минут. Выполнение достижения открывает маску "Да здравствует Король!", материал "Плюшевый" и рисунок "Карты"

schinese.name: 豪赌客
schinese.description: 在14分钟内完成黄金笑容赌场劫案。解锁“国王”面具、“毛绒”材质和“扑克牌”图案。

spanish.name: Gran apostador
spanish.description: Completa el trabajo Casino Golden Grin en menos de 14 minutos. Desbloquea la máscara “El Rey”, el material “Felpa” y el patrón “Cartas”.

dutch.name: Hail to the King, Baby
dutch.description: In the Golden Grin Casino heist, kill "The King" and complete the heist in stealth. Unlocks the "Sports Utility Mask" mask, "Carpet" material and "Dices" pattern.

english.name: Hail to the King, Baby
english.description: In the Golden Grin Casino heist, kill "The King" and complete the heist in stealth. Unlocks the "Sports Utility Mask" mask, "Carpet" material and "Dices" pattern.

french.name: (Pas si) Longue vie au King
french.description: Dans le contrat Casino Golden Grin, tuez le King et terminez le casse discrètement. Débloque le masque "Masque sport multi-usages", le matériau "Tapis" et le motif "Dés".

german.name: Lang lebe der King, Baby!
german.description: Töte im Golden-Grin-Casino-Überfall "Den King" und beende den Überfall im Schleich-Modus. Schaltet die Maske "Mehrzweck-Sportmaske", das Material "Teppich" und das Muster "Würfel" frei.

italian.name: Lunga vita al Re
italian.description: Durante il contratto "CASINÒ GOLDEN GRIN", uccidi "Il Re" e completa il colpo senza far scattare l'allarme. Sblocca la maschera "MASCHERA SPORTIVA MULTIUSO", il materiale "TAPPETO" e il motivo "DADI".

russian.name: Да здравствует король, детка
russian.description: Завершите контракт "Казино Golden Grin", не поднимая тревоги, и убейте "Короля". Выполнение достижения открывает спортивную маску, материал "Ковёр" и рисунок "Кубики"

schinese.name: 向国王致敬，宝贝
schinese.description: 在黄金笑容赌场劫案中击杀“国王”并潜行完成劫案。解锁“运动型多用途”面具、“地毯”材质和“骰子”图案。

spanish.name: Saluda al rey, nena
spanish.description: En el trabajo Casino Golden Grin, mata a “El Rey” y completa el golpe sigilosamente. Desbloquea la máscara "Máscara Multiusos para Deportes", el material "Alfombrado" y el patrón "Dados".

dutch.name: Names Are for Friends, so I Don't Need One
dutch.description: Get eleven kills with the Lebensauger .308 Sniper Rifle without reloading it. Unlocks the "Slicer" mask, "Still Waters" material and "Youkai" pattern.

english.name: Names Are for Friends, so I Don't Need One
english.description: Get eleven kills with the Lebensauger .308 Sniper Rifle without reloading it. Unlocks the "Slicer" mask, "Still Waters" material and "Youkai" pattern.

french.name: Je ne vois pas en quoi mon nom vous serait utile
french.description: Tuez 11 ennemis avec le fusil de précision Lebensauger .308 sans recharger. Débloque le masque "Le Découpeur", le matériau "Eaux calmes" et le motif "Youkai".

german.name: Namen sind für Freunde, also brauche ich keinen
german.description: Erziele elf Kills mit dem Lebensauger-.308-Scharfschützengewehr ohne Nachladen. Schaltet die Maske "Schlitzer", das Material "Stille Wasser" und das Muster "Youkai" frei.

italian.name: Gli amici hanno un nome, io no
italian.description: Ottieni undici uccisioni con il fucile di precisione Lebensauger .308 senza mai ricaricare. Sblocca la maschera "IL TAGLIAGOLE", il materiale "ACQUE FERME" e il motivo "YOUKAI".

russian.name: Имена для друзей, поэтому мне оно не нужно
russian.description: Убейте 11 противников с помощью снайперской винтовки Lebensauger .308, не перезаряжаясь. Выполнение достижения открывает маску "Слайсер", материал "Омут" и рисунок "Ёкай".

schinese.name: 名字是给朋友用的，所以我不需要
schinese.description: 用“生命吸取者”.308 狙击步枪在不重新装弹的情况下击杀11名敌人。解锁“切割者”面具、“静水”材质和“妖怪”图案。

spanish.name: Los nombres son para los amigos, así que no necesito uno
spanish.description: Mata a 11 enemigos con el Fusil de Francotirador Lebensauger .308, sin recargar. Desbloquea la máscara “Cortador”, el material “Aguas naturales” y el patrón “Youkai”.

dutch.name: Swiss Cheese
dutch.description: Kill 100 enemies in a single day of a heist with the Kross Vertex Submachine Gun. Unlocks the "Kage" mask, "Sakura" material and "Oni" pattern.

english.name: Swiss Cheese
english.description: Kill 100 enemies in a single day of a heist with the Kross Vertex Submachine Gun. Unlocks the "Kage" mask, "Sakura" material and "Oni" pattern.

french.name: Gruyère
french.description: Tuez 100 ennemis en un seul casse à l'aide la mitraillette Kross Vertex. Débloque le masque "Kage", le matériau "Sakura" et le motif "Oni".

german.name: Schweizer Käse
german.description: Töte in einem Überfall 100 Feinde mit der Kross-Vertex-Maschinenpistole. Schaltet die Maske "Kage", das Material "Sakura" und das Muster "Oni" frei.

italian.name: Groviera
italian.description: Uccidi 100 nemici in un singolo contratto usando la pistola mitragliatrice Kross Vertex. Sblocca la maschera "KAGE", il materiale "SAKURA" e il motivo "ONI".

russian.name: Шведский сыр
russian.description: Завершите любой контракт, убейте четырёх противников, не поднимая тревоги, используя только сюрикены. Выполнение достижения открывает маску "Тёмный капюшон", материал "Бамбук" и рисунок "Кои".

schinese.name: 瑞士奶酪
schinese.description: 用克罗斯·维泰克斯冲锋枪在劫案的单独一天内击杀100名敌人。解锁“影”面具、“樱花”材质和“恶鬼”图案。

spanish.name: Queso suizo
spanish.description: Mata a 100 enemigos en un solo día o trabajo con la Metralleta KROSS Vertex. Desbloquea la máscara “Kage”, el material “Sakura” y el patrón “Oni”.

dutch.name: Shuriken Shenanigans
dutch.description: Complete a single day of a heist in stealth using only the Shuriken throwable and killing at least 4 enemies. Unlocks the "Kuro Zukin" mask, "Bamboo" material and "Koi" pattern.

english.name: Shuriken Shenanigans
english.description: Complete a single day of a heist in stealth using only the Shuriken throwable and killing at least 4 enemies. Unlocks the "Kuro Zukin" mask, "Bamboo" material and "Koi" pattern.

french.name: Singeries au Shuriken
french.description: Terminez un casse discrètement en utilisant uniquement les Shurikens à lancer et en tuant au moins 4 ennemis. Débloque le masque "Kuro Zukin", le matériau "Bambou" et le motif "Koi".

german.name: Shuriken-Spaß
german.description: Beende einen Überfall im Schleichmodus, benutze nur das Wurfstern-Wurfobjekt und töte mindestens 4 Feinde. Schaltet die Maske "Kuro Zukin", das Material "Bambus" und das Muster "Koi" frei.

italian.name: A colpi di shuriken
italian.description: Completa un contratto senza far scattare l'allarme, usando soltanto gli Shuriken e uccidendo almeno 4 nemici. Sblocca la maschera "KURO ZUKIN", il materiale "BAMBÙ" e il motivo "KOI".

russian.name: Проделки сюрикена
russian.description: Завершите любой контракт, убейте четырёх противников, не поднимая тревоги, используя только сюрикены. Выполнение достижения открывает маску "Тёмный капюшон", материал "Бамбук" и рисунок "Кои".

schinese.name: 手里剑的把戏
schinese.description: 仅使用手里剑投掷物并击杀至少4名敌人，潜行完成劫案的单独一天。解锁“黑头巾”面具、“竹子”材质和“锦鲤”图案。

spanish.name: Tonterías con Shurikens
spanish.description: Completa un trabajo sigilosamente usando solo la Arrojadiza "Shuriken" y habiendo matado al menos a 4 enemigos. Desbloquea la máscara “Kuro Zukin”, el material “Bambú” y el patrón “Koi”.

dutch.name: Fugu Fighter
dutch.description: Have at least 3 enemies poisoned at the same time with your poisoned weapons. Unlocks the "Shirai" mask, "Origami" material and "Hanabi" pattern.

english.name: Fugu Fighter
english.description: Have at least 3 enemies poisoned at the same time with your poisoned weapons. Unlocks the "Shirai" mask, "Origami" material and "Hanabi" pattern.

french.name: Comme un poison dans l'eau
french.description: Empoisonnez au moins 3 ennemis en même temps à l'aide de vos armes empoisonnées. Débloque le masque "Shirai", le matériau "Origami" et le motif "Hanabi".

german.name: Fugu-Kämpfer
german.description: Schaffe es, dass 3 Feinde gleichzeitig vergiftet sind. Schaltet die Maske "Shirai", das Material "Origami" und das Muster "Hanabi" frei.

italian.name: Lottatore Fugu
italian.description: Avvelena almeno 3 nemici allo stesso tempo con l'aiuto delle tue armi avvelenate. Sblocca la maschera "SHIRAI", il materiale "ORIGAMI" e il motivo "HANABI".

russian.name: Боец фугу
russian.description: Сделайте так, чтобы три врага были отравлены вашим оружием одновременно. Выполнение достижения открывает маску "Шираи", материал "Оригами" и рисунок "Фейерверк".

schinese.name: 河豚斗士
schinese.description: 用你的毒武器同时使至少3名敌人中毒。解锁“白井”面具、“折纸”材质和“花火”图案。

spanish.name: Luchador de Fugu
spanish.description: Con tus armas envenenadas, haz que 3 enemigos estén envenenados al mismo tiempo.	 Desbloquea la máscara “Shirai”, el material “Origami” y el patrón “Hanabi”.

dutch.name: Heisters of the Round Table
dutch.description: Complete any heist on the OVERKILL difficulty or above with 4 players using only Gage Chivalry Pack masks, primary weapons, melee weapons and Ballistic Vests or heavier armors. Unlocks the "Agatha Knight Veteran" mask, "Blooded" material and "Agatha" pattern.

english.name: Heisters of the Round Table
english.description: Complete any heist on the OVERKILL difficulty or above with 4 players using only Gage Chivalry Pack masks, primary weapons, melee weapons and Ballistic Vests or heavier armors. Unlocks the "Agatha Knight Veteran" mask, "Blooded" material and "Agatha" pattern.

french.name: Les braqueurs de la table ronde
french.description: Terminez n'importe quel casse en difficulté OVERKILL ou supérieure. Chaque membre de votre équipe de 4 doit être équipé d'un masque, d'une arme primaire et d'une arme de mêlée du Gage Chivalry Pack, ainsi que d'un gilet balistique ou d'un gilet plus lourd. Débloque le masque "Chevalier Agathien vétéran", le matériau "Ensanglanté" et le motif "Royaume d'Agatha".

german.name: Gangster der Tafelrunde
german.description: Beende mit 4 Spielern einen beliebigen Überfall auf der Schwierigkeit OVERKILL oder höher und trage dabei nur Masken, Primärwaffen, und Nahkampfwaffen aus dem Gage Chivalry Pack sowie Schutzwesten oder schwerere Panzerung. Schaltet die Maske "Agatha-Ritter-Veteran", das Material "Blutig" und das Muster "Agatha" frei.

italian.name: I rapinatori della tavola rotonda
italian.description: Completa un qualsiasi contratto in difficoltà OVERKILL o superiore facendo in modo che tutti i membri della squadra utilizzino soltanto maschere, armi primarie e armi da mischia del DLC Gage Chivalry Pack e indossino giubbotti antiproiettile o armature più pesanti. Sblocca la maschera "CAVALIERE DI SANT'AGATA", il materiale "INSANGUINATO" e il motivo "ORDINE DI SANT'AGATA".

russian.name: Грабители круглого стола
russian.description: Завершите любой контракт вчетвером на уровне сложности "OVERKILL" или выше так, чтобы все члены команды носили 4 разных маски, первичное, вторичное и оружие ближнего боя из комплекта дополнений "Gage Chivalry Pack", а также любой баллистический бронежилет. Выполнение достижения открывает маску "Рыцарь Агаты", материал "Окровавленный", а также рисунок "Агата".

schinese.name: 圆桌劫匪
schinese.description: 由4名玩家仅使用盖奇骑士包的面具、主武器、近战武器以及弹道背心或更重的护甲，在OVERKILL或更高难度下完成任意劫案。解锁“阿加莎骑士老兵”面具、“染血”材质和“阿加莎”图案。

spanish.name: Los ladrones de la mesa redonda
spanish.description: Completa cualquier golpe en la dificultad OVERKILL o más alta mientras tú y tu equipo de cuatro solo usan máscaras, armas principales y armas cuerpo a cuerpo del “Gage Chivalry Pack” junto con el Chaleco Antibalas o un blindaje más pesado. Desbloquea la máscara “Caballero Veterano de Ágata”, el material “Ensangrentado” y el patrón “Ágata”.

dutch.name: Their Armor Is Thick and Their Shields Broad
dutch.description: Kill 10 shields with a Gage Chivalry Pack melee weapon in a single heist. Unlocks the "Agatha Vanguard Veteran" mask, "Chain Armor" material and "Medieval" pattern.

english.name: Their Armor Is Thick and Their Shields Broad
english.description: Kill 10 shields with a Gage Chivalry Pack melee weapon in a single heist. Unlocks the "Agatha Vanguard Veteran" mask, "Chain Armor" material and "Medieval" pattern.

french.name: Leur armure est épaisse et large est leur bouclier
french.description: En un seul casse, tuez 10 Shields à l'aide d'une arme de mêlée du Gage Chivalry Pack. Débloque le masque "Conquérent Agathien vétéran", le matériau "Cotte de mailles" et le motif "Médiéval".

german.name: Ihre Panzer sind stark und ihre Schilde breit
german.description: Töte bei einem Überfall 10 Shields mit einer Nahkampfwaffe aus dem Gage Chivalry Pack. Schaltet die Maske "Agatha-Vorhut-Veteran", das Material "Kettenrüstung" und das Muster "Mittelalter" frei.

italian.name: Spesse armature e grandi scudi
italian.description: Durante un singolo contratto, uccidi 10 Scudi con un'arma da mischia del DLC Gage Chivalry Pack. Sblocca la maschera "CONQUISTATORE DI SANT'AGATA", il materiale "ARMATURA DI MAGLIA" e il motivo "MEDIEVALE".

russian.name: Их броня толста, а щиты широки
russian.description: Убейте 10 полицейских с щитом на любом ограблении с помощью любого оружия ближнего боя из комплекта Gage Chivalry Pack. Выполнение достижения открывает маску "Авангард Агаты" и материал "Средневековый".

schinese.name: 他们的护甲厚实，盾牌宽大
schinese.description: 在单次劫案中用盖奇骑士包的近战武器击杀10名盾牌兵。解锁“阿加莎先锋老兵”面具、“锁子甲”材质和“中世纪”图案。

spanish.name: Sus armaduras son gruesas y sus escudos son grandes
spanish.description: Mata a 10 Shields con un arma cuerpo a cuerpo del “Gage Chivalry Pack” en un solo día o trabajo. Desbloquea la máscara “Veterano de Vanguardia de Ágata”, el material “Cota de malla” y el patrón “Medieval”.

dutch.name: Skewer
dutch.description: Kill a Cloaker with the Javelin throwable. Unlocks the "Mason Knight Veteran" mask, "Scale Armor" material and "Mason" pattern.

english.name: Skewer
english.description: Kill a Cloaker with the Javelin throwable. Unlocks the "Mason Knight Veteran" mask, "Scale Armor" material and "Mason" pattern.

french.name: Embroché
french.description: Tuez un Cloaker à l'aide du Javelot à lancer. Débloque le masque "Chevalier Mason vétéran", le matériau "Broigne" et le motif "Ordre de Mason".

german.name: Fleischspieß
german.description: Töte einen Cloaker mit dem Wurfspeer-Wurfobjekt. Schaltet die Maske "Mason-Ritter-Veteran", das Material "Schuppenrüstung" und das Muster "Mason" frei.

italian.name: Impalatore
italian.description: Uccidi un Cloaker con un giavellotto. Sblocca la maschera "CAVALIERE MASSONE", il materiale "ARMATURA A SCAGLIE" e il motivo "ORDINE DEI MASSONI".

russian.name: Клокер на вертеле
russian.description: Убейте чёрного бульдозера двуручным мечом. Выполнение достижения открывает маску "Авангард Мейсона", материал "Кованый" и рисунок "Клетчатый".

schinese.name: 串烧
schinese.description: 用标枪投掷物击杀一名潜伏者。解锁“梅森骑士老兵”面具、“鳞甲”材质和“梅森”图案。

spanish.name: Empalador
spanish.description: Mata a un Cloaker con la Jabalina Arrojadiza. Desbloquea la máscara “Caballero Veterano Masón”, el material “Armadura escamada” y el patrón “Masón”.

dutch.name: Black Knight
dutch.description: Kill a black Bulldozer with the Great Sword melee weapon. Unlocks the "Mason Vanguard Veteran" mask, "Forged" material and "Checkered Out" pattern.

english.name: Black Knight
english.description: Kill a black Bulldozer with the Great Sword melee weapon. Unlocks the "Mason Vanguard Veteran" mask, "Forged" material and "Checkered Out" pattern.

french.name: Chevalier noir
french.description: Tuez un Bulldozer noir à la mêlée avec l'épée à deux mains. Débloque le masque "Conquérant Mason vétéran", le matériau "Forgé" et le motif "Damier".

german.name: Schwarzer Ritter
german.description: Töte einen schwarzen Bulldozer mit der Großschwert-Nahkampfwaffe. Schaltet die Maske "Mason-Vorhut-Veteran", das Material "Geschmiedet" und das Muster "Beta-Karotin" frei.

italian.name: Cavaliere nero
italian.description: Uccidi un Bulldozer nero con l'arma da mischia "Spada a due mani". Sblocca la maschera "CONQUISTATORE MASSONE", il materiale "FORGIATO" e il motivo "DAMA".

russian.name: Тёмный рыцарь
russian.description: Убейте чёрного бульдозера двуручным мечом. Выполнение достижения открывает маску "Авангард Мейсона", материал "Кованый" и рисунок "Клетчатый".

schinese.name: 黑骑士
schinese.description: 用巨剑近战武器击杀一名黑色推土机。解锁“梅森先锋老兵”面具、“锻造”材质和“棋盘格”图案。

spanish.name: Caballero negro
spanish.description: Mata a un Bulldozer negro usando el Espadón. Desbloquea la máscara "Veterano de Vanguardia masón", el material "Forjado" y el patrón "Cuadros a medias".

dutch.name: Choo Choo
dutch.description: Complete the Transport: Train Heist job on the Death Wish difficulty or above.

english.name: Choo Choo
english.description: Complete the Transport: Train Heist job on the Death Wish difficulty or above.

french.name: Tchou tchou
french.description: Terminez le contrat Convoi blindé : Train en difficulté Suicidaire.

german.name: Töff-töff
german.description: Beende den Überfall "Transport: Eisenbahnraub" auf der Schwierigkeit Todesmut.

italian.name: Ciuf ciuf
italian.description: Completa il contratto "ASSALTO AL TRENO" in difficoltà Apocalisse.

russian.name: Choo Choo
russian.description: Завершите контракт "Транспорт: ограбление поезда" на уровне сложности "Жажда смерти".

schinese.name: 呜呜
schinese.description: 在死亡之愿或更高难度下完成“运输：火车劫案”任务。

spanish.name: ¡Chuu chuu!
spanish.description: Completa el trabajo Transporte Blindado: Golpe al Tren en la dificultad Death Wish.

dutch.name: 400 Bucks
dutch.description: I may be homeless, but at least I have a sick knife.

english.name: 400 Bucks
english.description: I may be homeless, but at least I have a sick knife.

french.name: 400 balles
french.description: Je suis peut-être SDF mais au moins j'ai un couteau qui déchire.

german.name: 400 Kröten
german.description: Ich mag obdachlos sein, aber wenigstens habe ich ein krasses Messer.

italian.name: 400 dollari
italian.description: Sarò anche un senzatetto, ma almeno ho un coltello da paura!

russian.name: 400 долларов
russian.description: Хоть я и бомж, зато у меня есть крутой нож.

schinese.name: 400大洋
schinese.description: 我也许无家可归，但至少我有把超酷的刀。

spanish.name: 400 dólares
spanish.description: Puede que no tenga hogar, pero al menos tengo un cuchillo de lujo.

dutch.name: Aftershocked
dutch.description: Complete the Aftershock job on Death Wish difficulty or above.

english.name: Aftershocked
english.description: Complete the Aftershock job on Death Wish difficulty or above.

french.name: Pas trop secoués ?
french.description: Terminez le contrat Contrecoup en difficulté Suicidaire.

german.name: Nachgebebt
german.description: Beende den Nachbeben-Überfall auf der Schwierigkeit Todesmut.

italian.name: Scosso
italian.description: Completa il contratto "SCOSSE DI ASSESTAMENTO" in difficoltà Apocalisse.

russian.name: Последствия
russian.description: Завершите контракт "Последствия" на уровне сложности "Жажда смерти".

schinese.name: 余震惊魂
schinese.description: 在死亡之愿或更高难度下完成“余震”任务。

spanish.name: Réplica-do
spanish.description: Completa el trabajo Réplica en la dificultad Death Wish.

dutch.name: Hidden Hostages
dutch.description: Finish the First World Bank job with 6 or more hostages alive behind the wall by the elevators in the main lobby.

english.name: Hidden Hostages
english.description: Finish the First World Bank job with 6 or more hostages alive behind the wall by the elevators in the main lobby.

french.name: Cache-cache avec les otages
french.description: Terminez le contrat First World Bank avec au moins 6 otages en vie planqués derrière le mur devant les ascenseurs du hall principal.

german.name: Versteckte Geiseln
german.description: Beende den Überfall "First World Bank", wobei sich mindestens 6 lebendige Geiseln hinter der Wand bei den Aufzügen in der Hauptlobby befinden.

italian.name: Ostaggi nascosti
italian.description: Completa il contratto "PRIMA BANCA MONDIALE" avendo almeno 6 ostaggi dietro al muro di fronte agli ascensori nell'atrio principale.

russian.name: Спрятанные заложники
russian.description: Завершите контракт "Первый мировой банк", укрыв 6 заложников за стеной в главном зале рядом с лифтами.

schinese.name: 暗藏的人质
schinese.description: 在主大厅电梯旁的墙后藏有6名或以上存活人质的情况下完成“第一世界银行”任务。

spanish.name: Rehenes ocultos
spanish.description: Completa el trabajo First World Bank teniendo 6 o más rehenes detrás del gran muro del vestíbulo.

dutch.name: Original Heisters
dutch.description: Complete the First World Bank on the OVERKILL difficulty or above using the PAYDAY: The Heist crew, Reinfeld Shotguns, and Bernetti 9 Pistols.

english.name: Original Heisters
english.description: Complete the First World Bank on the OVERKILL difficulty or above using the PAYDAY: The Heist crew, Reinfeld Shotguns, and Bernetti 9 Pistols.

french.name: Les braqueurs originaux
french.description: Terminez le contrat First World Bank en difficulté OVERKILL ou supérieure. Chaque membre de votre équipe de 4 doit incarner l'un des 4 personnages de PAYDAY : The Heist et utiliser le fusil à pompe Reinfeld ainsi que le pistolet Bernetti 9.

german.name: Original Heisters
german.description: Beende den Überfall "First World Bank" auf der Schwierigkeit OVERKILL oder höher mit der Crew aus PAYDAY: The Heist, Reinfeld-Schrotflinten und Bernetti-9-Pistolen.

italian.name: Rapinatori originali
italian.description: Completa il contratto "PRIMA BANCA MONDIALE" in difficoltà OVERKILL o superiore. Ciascun membro della squadra deve usare uno dei personaggi di PAYDAY: The Heist, il fucile Reinfeld e la pistola Bernetti 9.

russian.name: Классические грабители
russian.description: Завершите контракт "Первый мировой банк" на уровне сложности "OVERKILL" или выше, играя за членов команды оригинального PAYDAY: The Heist, используя дробовики Reinfeld и одиночные пистолеты Bernetti 9.

schinese.name: 初代劫匪
schinese.description: 使用《收获日：掠夺》原班人马、雷恩菲尔德霰弹枪和贝尔内蒂9手枪，在OVERKILL或更高难度下完成“第一世界银行”任务。

spanish.name: Los cuatro originales
spanish.description: Completa el trabajo First World Bank en la dificultad OVERKILL o más alta usando a los cuatro personajes originales de PAYDAY: The Heist, y mientras todo el equipo lleva la Escopeta Reinfeld 880 y la Pistola Bernetti 9.

dutch.description: Complete the First World Bank job in stealth under 13 minutes and 37 seconds.

english.description: Complete the First World Bank job in stealth under 13 minutes and 37 seconds.

french.description: Terminez le contrat First World Bank discrètement en moins de 13 minutes et 37 secondes.

german.description: Beende den Überfall "First World Bank" in weniger las 13 Minuten und 37 Sekunden.

italian.description: Completa il contratto "PRIMA BANCA MONDIALE" in meno di 13 minuti e 37 secondi senza mai far scattare l'allarme.

russian.description: Завершите контракт "Первый мировой банк", не более чем за 13 минут и 37 секунд.

schinese.description: 在13分37秒内以潜行方式完成“第一世界银行”任务。

spanish.description: Completa sigilosamente el trabajo First World Bank en menos de 13 minutos y 37 segundos.

dutch.name: Cloaker Fear
dutch.description: Finish the First World Bank job on the OVERKILL difficulty or above by securing all additional money bags while not using the loot vent bag shortcut for the additional money bags.

english.name: Cloaker Fear
english.description: Finish the First World Bank job on the OVERKILL difficulty or above by securing all additional money bags while not using the loot vent bag shortcut for the additional money bags.

french.name: Peur des Cloakers
french.description: Terminez le contrat First World Bank, en difficulté OVERKILL ou supérieure, en ayant récupéré tous les sacs d'argent mais sans utiliser le raccourci du conduit d'aération pour transporter les sacs bonus.

german.name: Cloaker-Angst
german.description: Beende den Überfall "First World Bank" auf der Schwierigkeit OVERKILL oder höher, indem du alle zusätzlichen Geldtaschen sicherst und nicht die Schacht-Abkürzung für die zusätzlichen Geldtaschen benutzt.

italian.name: Paura dei Cloaker
italian.description: Completa il contratto "PRIMA BANCA MONDIALE" in difficoltà OVERKILL o superiore recuperando tutto il denaro senza usare il condotto di aerazione per i borsoni extra.

russian.name: Боязнь клокеров
russian.description: Завершите контракт "Первый мировой банк" на уровне сложности "OVERKILL" или выше, унеся с собой все дополнительные сумки с деньгами, не используя вентиляцию для переноса дополнительных сумок.

schinese.name: 潜行者恐惧
schinese.description: 在杀戮或更高难度下完成第一世界银行任务，将所有额外钱袋全部送达，且运送额外钱袋时不得使用通风管道捷径。

spanish.name: Miedo a los Cloakers
spanish.description: Completa el trabajo First World Bank en la dificultad OVERKILL o más alta sin enviar las bolsas de dinero adicionales por el conducto de ventilación, asegurando todas las bolsas de dinero.

dutch.name: CVL+
dutch.description: Complete the First World Bank job on the Death Wish difficulty or above.

english.name: CVL+
english.description: Complete the First World Bank job on the Death Wish difficulty or above.

french.name: CVL+
french.description: Terminez le contrat First World Bank en difficulté Suicidaire.

german.name: CVL+
german.description: Beende den Überfall "First World Bank" auf der Schwierigkeit Todesmut.

italian.name: CVL+
italian.description: Completa il contratto "PRIMA BANCA MONDIALE" in difficoltà Apocalisse.

russian.name: CVL+
russian.description: Завершите контракт "Первый мировой банк" на уровне сложности "Жажда смерти".

schinese.name: CVL+
schinese.description: 在死亡愿望或更高难度下完成第一世界银行任务。

spanish.name: CVL+
spanish.description: Completa el trabajo First World Bank en la dificultad Death Wish.

dutch.name: OVERDRILL
dutch.description: In the First World Bank job, solve the PAYDAY: The Heist secret on the Death Wish difficulty or above and enter the OVERVAULT. To complete this challenge, you have to have played the heist from start to end.

english.name: OVERDRILL
english.description: In the First World Bank job, solve the PAYDAY: The Heist secret on the Death Wish difficulty or above and enter the OVERVAULT. To complete this challenge, you have to have played the heist from start to end.

french.name: OVERDRILL
french.description: Dans le contrat First World Bank, percez le secret de PAYDAY : The Heist en difficulté Suicidaire et pénétrez dans l'OVERCOFFRE. Pour terminer ce défi, vous devrez avoir joué à ce casse depuis le début.

german.name: OVERDRILL
german.description: Löse im Überfall "First World Bank" das "PAYDAY: The Heist" Geheimnis auf der Schwierigkeit Todesmut. und betritt den OVERVAULT. Um diese Errungenschaft zu erhalten musst du den Überfall vom Anfang bis zum Ende spielen.

italian.name: OVERDRILL
italian.description: Durante il contratto "PRIMA BANCA MONDIALE", risolvi il segreto di PAYDAY: The Heist in difficoltà Apocalisse ed accedi al leggendario OVERVAULT. Devi aver partecipato al colpo fin dall'inizio per sbloccare questo achievement.

russian.name: OVERDRILL
russian.description: Выполняя контракт "Первый мировой банк", откройте секрет PAYDAY: The Heist на уровне сложности "Жажда смерти" и войдите в OVERVAULT. Чтобы выполнить достижение, нужно играть контракт с самого начала.

schinese.name: OVERDRILL
schinese.description: 在死亡愿望或更高难度下，于第一世界银行任务中解开《收获日：掠夺》的秘密并进入OVERVAULT超级金库。要完成此挑战，你必须从头到尾完整游玩该劫案。

spanish.name: OVERDRILL
spanish.description: En el trabajo First World Bank, resuelve el secreto de PAYDAY: The Heist en la dificultad Death Wish y entra en la OVERVAULT. Para obtener este logro, debes permanecer en el juego desde la sala de planificación hasta completar el desafío.

dutch.name: Au Ticket
dutch.description: In the First World Bank job, find the Titan safe and collect the special item inside.

english.name: Au Ticket
english.description: In the First World Bank job, find the Titan safe and collect the special item inside.

french.name: Ticket d'or
french.description: Dans le contrat First World Bank, trouvez le coffre-fort en titane et récupérez l'objet spécial qu'il contient.

german.name: Au-Ticket
german.description: Finde beim Überfall "First World Bank" den Titan-Tresor und nimm dir den Spezialgegenstand darin.

italian.name: Biglietto dorato
italian.description: Durante il contratto "PRIMA BANCA MONDIALE", trova la cassaforte in titanio e recupera l'oggetto speciale al suo interno.

russian.name: Золотой билет
russian.description: Выполняя контракт "Первый мировой банк", найдите титановый сейф и заберите его содержимое.

schinese.name: 黄金门票
schinese.description: 在第一世界银行任务中找到泰坦保险箱并取出其中的特殊物品。

spanish.name: Boleto de Au
spanish.description: En el trabajo First World Bank, encuentra la caja fuerte TITAN y toma el objeto especial que contiene.

dutch.name: Not Hard Enough
dutch.description: Complete the Slaughterhouse job on the OVERKILL difficulty or above while Captain Winters is still present on the level.

english.name: Not Hard Enough
english.description: Complete the Slaughterhouse job on the OVERKILL difficulty or above while Captain Winters is still present on the level.

french.name: Ça manque de challenge tout ça
french.description: Terminez le contrat Abattoir en difficulté OVERKILL ou supérieure sans vous débarrasser du Capitaine Winters.

german.name: Nicht schwer genug
german.description: Beende den Schlachthaus-Überfall auf der Schwierigkeit OVERKILL oder höher, während Captain Winters im Level anwesend ist.

italian.name: Poteva essere più difficile
italian.description: Completa il contratto "MATTATOIO" in difficoltà OVERKILL o superiore mentre il Capitano Winters è ancora sul posto.

russian.name: Недостаточно сложно
russian.description: Завершите контракт "Скотобойня" на уровне сложности "OVERKILL" или выше, не убивая капитана Уинтерса.

schinese.name: 还不够硬
schinese.description: 在温特斯上尉仍在关卡中的情况下，于OVERKILL或更高难度完成屠宰场任务。

spanish.name: Podría ser más difícil
spanish.description: Completa el trabajo Slaughterhouse en la dificultad OVERKILL o más alta sin derrotar al Captain Winters mientras esté presente.

dutch.name: But How?
dutch.description: In the Slaughterhouse job, get the armored truck to drop without shooting at the wires on which it is suspended.

english.name: But How?
english.description: In the Slaughterhouse job, get the armored truck to drop without shooting at the wires on which it is suspended.

french.name: Mais... comment ?
french.description: Dans le contrat Abattoir, faites descendre le camion blindé sans tirer sur les câbles qui le retiennent.

german.name: Aber wie?
german.description: Lass beim Schlachthaus-Überfall den gepanzerten Transporter herunterfallen, ohne auf die Kabel, in denen er hängt, zu schießen.

italian.name: Ma come?
italian.description: Durante il contratto "MATTATOIO", fai cadere il blindato senza sparare ai cavi che lo tengono sospeso.

russian.name: Но как?
russian.description: Выполняя контракт "Скотобойня", не стреляйте по проводам и сделайте так, чтобы застрявший грузовик упал.

schinese.name: 这是怎么办到的？
schinese.description: 在屠宰场任务中，不射击悬挂装甲运钞车的缆线，让它掉落下来。

spanish.name: Pero... ¿cómo?
spanish.description: En el trabajo Slaughterhouse, haz que la furgoneta blindada baje sin disparar a los cables con los que se sostiene.

dutch.name: Making a Statement
dutch.description: Finish the Slaughterhouse job on the OVERKILL difficulty or above without anyone killing a single sniper.

english.name: Making a Statement
english.description: Finish the Slaughterhouse job on the OVERKILL difficulty or above without anyone killing a single sniper.

french.name: Si vous croyez nous intimider
french.description: Terminez le contrat Abattoir en difficulté OVERKILL ou supérieure sans tuer un seul Sniper.

german.name: Ein Herz für Sniper
german.description: Beende den Schlachthaus-Überfall auf der Schwierigkeit OVERKILL oder höher ohne dass jemand einen einzigen Scharfschützen tötet.

italian.name: Mettersi in evidenza
italian.description: Completa il contratto "MATTATOIO" in difficoltà OVERKILL o superiore senza che nessun membro della squadra uccida un singolo cecchino.

russian.name: Сделать заявление
russian.description: Завершите контракт "Скотобойня" на уровне сложности "OVERKILL" или выше, не убив ни одного снайпера.

schinese.name: 表明立场
schinese.description: 在OVERKILL或更高难度下完成屠宰场任务，且无人击杀任何一名狙击手。

spanish.name: Haciendo una declaración
spanish.description: Completa el trabajo Slaughterhouse en la dificultad OVERKILL o más alta sin matar Snipers.

dutch.name: Pyromaniacs
dutch.description: In the Slaughterhouse job, pick up two gasoline tanks within 30 seconds of entering the slaughterhouse.

english.name: Pyromaniacs
english.description: In the Slaughterhouse job, pick up two gasoline tanks within 30 seconds of entering the slaughterhouse.

french.name: Pyromanes
french.description: Dans le contrat Abattoir, récupérez deux bidons d'essence dans les 30 secondes qui suivent votre entrée dans l'abattoir.

german.name: Pyromanen
german.description: Hebe beim Schlachthaus-Überfall innerhalb 30 Sekunden nach dem Betreten des Schlachthauses zwei Benzinkanister auf.

italian.name: Piromani
italian.description: Durante il contratto "MATTATOIO", raccogli due taniche di benzina entro 30 secondi dall'ingresso nel mattatoio.

russian.name: Пироманьяки
russian.description: Выполняя контракт "Скотобойня", соберите две канистры с горючим за 30 секунд после того, как войдёте в помещение.

schinese.name: 纵火狂
schinese.description: 在屠宰场任务中，进入屠宰场后30秒内捡起两个汽油桶。

spanish.name: Piromaníacos
spanish.description: En el trabajo Slaughterhouse, recoge dos bidones de gasolina en menos de 30 segundos de entrar en el matadero.

dutch.name: Dead Meat
dutch.description: Complete the Slaughterhouse job on the Death Wish difficulty or above.

english.name: Dead Meat
english.description: Complete the Slaughterhouse job on the Death Wish difficulty or above.

french.name: Viande avariée
french.description: Terminez le contrat Abattoir en difficulté Suicidaire.

german.name: Totes Fleisch
german.description: Beende den Schlachthaus-Überfall auf der Schwierigkeit Todesmut.

italian.name: Carne morta
italian.description: Completa il contratto "MATTATOIO" in difficoltà Apocalisse.

russian.name: Куски мяса
russian.description: Завершите контракт "Скотобойня" на уровне сложности "Жажда смерти".

schinese.name: 案板上的肉
schinese.description: 在死亡之愿或更高难度下完成屠宰场任务。

spanish.name: Carne muerta
spanish.description: Completa el trabajo Slaughterhouse en la dificultad Death Wish.

dutch.name: Pork Royale
dutch.description: In the Slaughterhouse job, find the marked pig, secure it in the container and then finish the heist on OVERKILL or above.

english.name: Pork Royale
english.description: In the Slaughterhouse job, find the marked pig, secure it in the container and then finish the heist on OVERKILL or above.

french.name: Porc royal
french.description: Dans le contrat Abattoir, trouvez le cochon marqué d'une croix, placez-le dans le container puis terminez le casse en difficulté OVERKILL ou supérieure.

german.name: Edelschwein
german.description: Finde beim Schlachthaus-Überfall auf der Schwierigkeit OVERKILL oder höher das markierte Schwein, sichert es im Container und beendet dann den Überfall.

italian.name: Carne di prima scelta
italian.description: Completa il contratto "MATTATOIO" trovando il maiale contrassegnato e mettendolo al sicuro nel container.

russian.name: Королевская хрюшка
russian.description: Завершите контракт "Скотобойня" на уровне сложности "OVERKILL" или выше, унеся с собой отмеченную свиную тушу.

schinese.name: 至尊猪肉
schinese.description: 在屠宰场任务中，找到被标记的猪，把它装进容器并回收，然后在OVERKILL或更高难度下完成这次劫案。

spanish.name: Puerco Real
spanish.description: En el trabajo Slaughterhouse, encuentra el cerdo marcado, asegúralo en el contenedor y completa el golpe, en la dificultad OVERKILL o más alta.

dutch.name: I Want to Get Away
dutch.description: Jump. Unlocks the "Funnyman" mask.

english.name: I Want to Get Away
english.description: Jump. Unlocks the "Funnyman" mask.

french.name: Je veux m'en aller loin d'ici
french.description: Sautez. Débloque le masque "Le Rigolo".

german.name: Ich will hier weg
german.description: Spring. Schaltet die "Baitface"-Maske frei.

italian.name: Voglio andarmene
italian.description: Salta. Sblocca la maschera "IL BURLONE".

russian.name: Я просто хочу сбежать отсюда
russian.description: Прыгните. Выполнение достижения открывает маску "Весельчак".

schinese.name: 我想逃
schinese.description: 跳一下。解锁“滑稽男”面具。

spanish.name: Quiero alejarme
spanish.description: Salta. Desbloquea la máscara "Gracioso".

dutch.name: Bunnyhopping
dutch.description: Jump 100 times within 30 seconds. Unlocks the "No Me Gusta" mask.

english.name: Bunnyhopping
english.description: Jump 100 times within 30 seconds. Unlocks the "No Me Gusta" mask.

french.name: Bunny hopping
french.description: Sautez 100 fois en moins de 30 secondes. Débloque le masque "No Me Gusta".

german.name: Hoppelhäschen
german.description: Spring 100-mal binnen 30 Sekunden. Schaltet die "No Me Gusta"-Maske frei.

italian.name: Il salto del coniglio
italian.description: Salta 100 volte entro 30 secondi. Sblocca la maschera "NO ME GUSTA".

russian.name: Банни хоп
russian.description: Прыгните 100 раз в течение 30 секунд. Выполнение достижения открывает маску "Ме Густа".

schinese.name: 兔子跳
schinese.description: 在30秒内跳跃100次。解锁“我不喜欢”面具。

spanish.name: Saltando como conejo
spanish.description: Salta 100 veces en menos de 30 segundos. Desbloquea la máscara "No Me Gusta".

dutch.name: I Never Asked for This
dutch.description: Don't jump a single time during an entire heist. Unlocks the "Rageface" mask.

english.name: I Never Asked for This
english.description: Don't jump a single time during an entire heist. Unlocks the "Rageface" mask.

french.name: J'ai rien demandé
french.description: Terminez un casse sans sauter ne serait-ce qu'une seule fois. Débloque le masque "Rageface".

german.name: Das habe ich nie gewollt
german.description: Spring während eines ganzen Überfalls kein einziges Mal. Schaltet die "Rageface"-Maske frei.

italian.name: Questo non era negli accordi
italian.description: Completa un contratto senza mai saltare. Sblocca la maschera "RAGEFACE".

russian.name: I Never Asked for This
russian.description: Не прыгайте в течение всего ограбления. Выполнение достижения открывает маску "НЕНАВИСТЬ".

schinese.name: 我从未要求这些
schinese.description: 在整个劫案过程中一次都不要跳跃。解锁“暴走脸”面具。

spanish.name: Yo no quería esto
spanish.description: No saltes ni una vez durante todo un golpe. Desbloquea la máscara "Cara de Furia".

dutch.name: Jump! Jump! Jump!
dutch.description: Finish a heist without it ever going more than 4 seconds between you jumping. Unlocks the "Dawg" mask.

english.name: Jump! Jump! Jump!
english.description: Finish a heist without it ever going more than 4 seconds between you jumping. Unlocks the "Dawg" mask.

french.name: Boing ! Boing ! Boing !
french.description: Terminez un casse sans laisser plus de 4 secondes entre chacun de vos sauts. Débloque le masque "Dawg".

german.name: Spring! Spring! Spring!
german.description: Beende einen Überfall, bei dem du nie mehr als 4 Sekunden zwischen zwei Sprüngen vergehen lässt. Schaltet die "Dawg"-Maske frei.

italian.name: Salta! Salta! Salta!
italian.description: Completa un qualsiasi contratto senza lasciar passare più di 4 secondi tra i tuoi salti. Sblocca la maschera "DAWG".

russian.name: Прыгай! Прыгай! Прыгай!
russian.description: Завершите любой контракт, прыгая с перерывом не более четырёх секунд. Выполнение достижения открывает маску "Пёсель".

schinese.name: 跳！跳！跳！
schinese.description: 完成一次劫案，且你两次跳跃之间的间隔从未超过4秒。解锁“狗哥”面具。

spanish.name: ¡Salta! ¡Salta! ¡Salta!
spanish.description: Completa un golpe saltando constantemente y sin que pasen más de 4 segundos entre cada salto. Desbloquea la máscara "Dawg".

dutch.name: Skill Shot
dutch.description: In the Lab Rats job, secure a bag in the secret area. Unlocks the "Invader" mask.

english.name: Skill Shot
english.description: In the Lab Rats job, secure a bag in the secret area. Unlocks the "Invader" mask.

french.name: Lancer de pro
french.description: Dans le contrat Rats de laboratoire, jetez un sac dans la cachette secrète. Débloque le masque “Envahisseur”.

german.name: Kunstschuss
german.description: Sichere im Laborratten-Überfall eine Tasche im Geheimbereich. Schaltet die "Eindringling"-Maske frei.

italian.name: Colpo da maestro
italian.description: Durante il contratto "TOPI DA LABORATORIO", metti un borsone al sicuro nella zona segreta. Sblocca la maschera "INVASORE".

russian.name: Трикшо
russian.description: Выполняя контракт "Лабораторные крысы", сохраните сумку в секретном месте для сброса добычи. Выполнение достижения открывает маску "Захватчик".

schinese.name: 技巧射击
schinese.description: 在“实验室小白鼠”任务中，于秘密区域收取一袋赃物。解锁“入侵者”面具。

spanish.name: Lanzamiento habilidoso
spanish.description: En el trabajo Ratas de Laboratorio, asegura una bolsa en la zona secreta. Desbloquea la máscara "Invasor".

dutch.name: Trick or Treat!
dutch.description: In the Lab Rats job, complete the Cloaker event on OVERKILL difficulty or above. Unlocks the "Satan" mask.

english.name: Trick or Treat!
english.description: In the Lab Rats job, complete the Cloaker event on OVERKILL difficulty or above. Unlocks the "Satan" mask.

french.name: Des bonbons ou un sort !
french.description: Dans le contrat Rats de laboratoire, survivez au défi du Cloaker en difficulté OVERKILL ou supérieure. Débloque le masque “Satan”.

german.name: Süßes oder Saures!
german.description: Beende das Cloaker-Event im Laborratten-Überfall auf der Schwierigkeit OVERKILL oder höher. Schaltet die "Satan"-Maske frei.

italian.name: Dolcetto o scherzetto!
italian.description: Durante il contratto "TOPI DA LABORATORIO", completa l'evento del Cloaker in difficoltà OVERKILL o superiore. Sblocca la maschera "SATANA".

russian.name: Кошелёк или жизнь!
russian.description: Выполняя контракт "Лабораторные крысы" на уровне сложности "OVERKILL" или выше, завершите дополнительное задание по защите сейфа от клокера. Выполнение достижения открывает маску "Сатана".

schinese.name: 不给糖就捣蛋！
schinese.description: 在“实验室小白鼠”任务中，于OVERKILL或更高难度完成潜伏者事件。解锁“撒旦”面具。

spanish.name: ¡Dulce o truco!
spanish.description: En el trabajo Ratas de Laboratorio, completa el evento del Necrocloaker en la dificultad OVERKILL o más alta. Desbloquea la máscara “Satán”.

dutch.name: Not Scary Enough
dutch.description: Complete the Lab Rats job on the Death Wish difficulty or above.

english.name: Not Scary Enough
english.description: Complete the Lab Rats job on the Death Wish difficulty or above.

french.name: Même pas peur
french.description: Terminez le contrat Rats de laboratoire en difficulté Suicidaire.

german.name: Nicht gruslig genug
german.description: Beende den Laborratten-Überfall auf der Schwierigkeit Todesmut.

italian.name: Poteva essere più spaventoso
italian.description: Completa il contratto "TOPI DA LABORATORIO" in difficoltà Apocalisse.

russian.name: Недостаточно устрашающий
russian.description: Завершите контракт "Лабораторные крысы" на уровне сложности "Жажда смерти".

schinese.name: 不够吓人
schinese.description: 在“死亡之愿”或更高难度完成“实验室小白鼠”任务。

spanish.name: Podría ser más aterrador
spanish.description: Completa el trabajo Ratas de Laboratorio en la dificultad Death Wish.

dutch.name: Hall of the Mountain King
dutch.description: Complete the Beneath the Mountain job on the Death Wish difficulty or above.

english.name: Hall of the Mountain King
english.description: Complete the Beneath the Mountain job on the Death Wish difficulty or above.

french.name: L’antre du roi de la montagne
french.description: Terminez le contrat Sous la montagne en difficulté Suicidaire.

german.name: Halle des Bergkönigs
german.description: Beende den Überfall "Unter dem Berg" auf der Schwierigkeit Todesmut.

italian.name: L'antro del re della montagna
italian.description: Completa il contratto "SOTTO LA MONTAGNA" in difficoltà Apocalisse.

russian.name: Да здравствует король гор
russian.description: Завершите контракт "У подножия горы" на уровне сложности "Жажда смерти".

schinese.name: 山魔王的殿堂
schinese.description: 在“死亡之愿”或更高难度完成“群山之下”任务。

spanish.name: Salón del rey de la montaña
spanish.description: Completa el trabajo Bajo la Montaña en la dificultad Death Wish.

dutch.name: Clean House
dutch.description: In the Beneath the Mountain job, secure all of the loot from the vaults and mountain-top in the escape helicopter. Unlocks the “Tawhiri” mask, “Flow” material and “Sun Avatar” pattern.

english.name: Clean House
english.description: In the Beneath the Mountain job, secure all of the loot from the vaults and mountain-top in the escape helicopter. Unlocks the “Tawhiri” mask, “Flow” material and “Sun Avatar” pattern.

french.name: Ménage de printemps
french.description: Dans le contrat Sous la montagne, récupérez tous les sacs de butin des coffres et du sommet de la montagne, puis mettez-les dans l'hélicoptère. Débloque le masque "Tawhiri", le matériau "Fluctuation" et le motif "Avatar du soleil".

german.name: Leergefegt
german.description: Sichere beim Überfall "Unter dem Berg" sämtliche Beute aus den Tresorräumen und der Bergspitze im Fluchthubschrauber. Schaltet die Maske "Tawhiri", das Material "Fluss" und das Muster "Sonnen-Avatar" frei.

italian.name: Pulizie di primavere
italian.description: Durante il contratto "SOTTO LA MONTAGNA", recupera tutto il bottino dai caveau e dalla cima della montagna e mettilo al sicuro sull'elicottero. Sblocca la maschera "TAWHIRI", il materiale "FLUSSO" e il motivo "AVATAR DEL SOLE".

russian.name: Работа по дому
russian.description: Выполняя контракт "У подножия горы", украдите все ценности из хранилищ и на территории после выхода из комплекса. Выполнение достижения открывает маску "Тафириматеа", материал "Течение" и рисунок "Солнечное божество".

schinese.name: 清场
schinese.description: 在“群山之下”任务中，将金库与山顶的全部赃物装入撤离直升机。解锁“塔维里”面具、“流动”材质和“太阳化身”图案。

spanish.name: Limpieza de domicilio
spanish.description: En el trabajo Bajo la Montaña, asegura todos los objetos valiosos de las bóvedas y de la cima de la montaña. Desbloquea la máscara "Tawhiri", el material "Caudal" y el patrón "Avatar del sol".

dutch.name: Commando Crew
dutch.description: In the Beneath the Mountain job, open the 4 vaults that contain loot within 10 minutes of starting the heist on the OVERKILL difficulty or above.

english.name: Commando Crew
english.description: In the Beneath the Mountain job, open the 4 vaults that contain loot within 10 minutes of starting the heist on the OVERKILL difficulty or above.

french.name: Opération commando
french.description: Dans le contrat Sous la montagne, ouvrez les 4 coffres qui contiennent du butin dans les 10 minutes qui suivent le début du casse, en difficulté OVERKILL ou supérieure.

german.name: Sondereinsatzkommando
german.description: Öffne beim Überfall "Unter dem Berg" auf der Schwierigkeit OVERKILL oder höher die 4 Tresorräume mit Beute innerhalb von 10 Minuten nach Beginn des Überfalls.

italian.name: Commando
italian.description: Durante il contratto "SOTTO LA MONTAGNA", apri i 4 caveau che contengono il bottino entro 10 minuti dall'inizio del colpo in difficoltà OVERKILL o superiore.

russian.name: Слаженная команда
russian.description: Завершите ограбление "У подножия горы" на уровне сложности "OVERKILL" или выше так, чтобы ни один игрок ни разу не упал.

schinese.name: 突击小队
schinese.description: 在“群山之下”任务中，于OVERKILL或更高难度，在行动开始后10分钟内打开4个藏有赃物的金库。

spanish.name: Equipo de Comandos
spanish.description: En el trabajo Bajo la Montaña, abre las 4 bóvedas que contienen objetos valiosos en menos de 10 minutos de empezar el golpe en la dificultad OVERKILL o más alta.

dutch.name: Juggernauts
dutch.description: Complete the Beneath the Mountain job on the OVERKILL difficulty or above without any player going down.

english.name: Juggernauts
english.description: Complete the Beneath the Mountain job on the OVERKILL difficulty or above without any player going down.

french.name: Invincibles
french.description: Terminez le contrat Sous la montagne en difficulté OVERKILL ou supérieure sans qu’un seul joueur ne tombe à terre.

german.name: Unkaputtbar
german.description: Beende den Überfall "Unter dem Berg" auf der Schwierigkeit OVERKILL oder höher, ohne dass ein Spieler zu Boden geht.

italian.name: Invincibili
italian.description: Completa il contratto "SOTTO LA MONTAGNA" in difficoltà OVERKILL o superiore senza che nessun giocatore vada mai a terra.

russian.name: Джаггернауты
russian.description: Завершите ограбление "У подножия горы" на уровне сложности "OVERKILL" или выше так, чтобы ни один игрок ни разу не упал.

schinese.name: 巨无霸
schinese.description: 在OVERKILL或更高难度完成“群山之下”任务，且没有任何玩家倒地。

spanish.name: Juggernauts
spanish.description: Completa el trabajo Bajo la Montaña sin que incapaciten o esposen a ningún jugador en la dificultad OVERKILL o más alta.

dutch.name: No Scope
dutch.description: Kill 10 enemies in a row by shooting them in the head with the Platypus 70 Sniper Rifle while not aiming down the sights. Unlocks the “Tane” mask, “Sancti” material and “Tribal Face” pattern.

english.name: No Scope
english.description: Kill 10 enemies in a row by shooting them in the head with the Platypus 70 Sniper Rifle while not aiming down the sights. Unlocks the “Tane” mask, “Sancti” material and “Tribal Face” pattern.

french.name: No scope
