french.description: Tuez 10 ennemis à la suite en leur tirant dans la tête à l’aide du fusil de précision Platypus 70, sans utiliser le viseur. Débloque le masque "Tane", le matériau "Sanctifié" et le motif "Visage tribal".

german.name: Ohne Zielfernrohr
german.description: Töte ohne anzuvisieren 10 Feinde in Folge mit Kopfschüssen aus dem Platypus-70-Scharfschützengewehr. Schaltet die Maske "Tane", das Material "Sancti" und das Muster "Tribal-Gesicht" frei.

italian.name: Senza mirare
italian.description: Colpisci alla testa 10 nemici di fila con il fucile di precisione Platypus 70 senza usare il mirino. Sblocca la maschera "TANE", il materiale "SANCTI" e il motivo "VISO TRIBALE".

russian.name: No Scope
russian.description: Убейте 10 противников подряд, ведя стрельбу от бедра со снайперской винтовкой Platypus 70. Выполнение достижения открывает маску "Тане", материал "Sancti" и рисунок "Лик племени".

schinese.name: 盲狙
schinese.description: 使用“鸭嘴兽70”狙击步枪不开镜爆头，连续击杀10名敌人。解锁“塔内”面具、“神圣”材质和“部落面孔”图案。

spanish.name: ¡Sin apuntar!
spanish.description: Mata a 10 enemigos con disparos a la cabeza, sin fallar y sin usar la mira con el Fusil de Francotirador Ornitorrinco 70. Desbloquea la máscara "Tane", el patron "Sancti" y el material "Cara tribal".

dutch.name: The Sky Is the Limit
dutch.description: Complete the Birth of Sky job on the Death Wish difficulty or above.

english.name: The Sky Is the Limit
english.description: Complete the Birth of Sky job on the Death Wish difficulty or above.

french.name: Le ciel nous tombe sur la tête
french.description: Terminez le contrat Genèse céleste en difficulté Suicidaire.

german.name: Höhenflug
german.description: Beende den Himmelsgeburt-Überfall auf der Schwierigkeit Todesmut.

italian.name: Al settimo cielo
italian.description: Completa il contratto "GENESI CELESTE" in difficoltà Apocalisse.

russian.name: Единственный предел - небеса
russian.description: Завершите контракт "Рождение небес" на уровне сложности "Жажда смерти".

schinese.name: 天空才是极限
schinese.description: 在“死亡之愿”或更高难度完成“天空之生”任务。

spanish.name: El cielo es el límite
spanish.description: Completa el trabajo Nacimiento en el Cielo en la dificultad Death Wish.

dutch.name: Pinpoint Landing
dutch.description: In the Birth of Sky job, parachute into the diner through a hole in the roof.

english.name: Pinpoint Landing
english.description: In the Birth of Sky job, parachute into the diner through a hole in the roof.

french.name: Atterrissage parfait
french.description: Dans le contrat Genèse céleste, atterrissez dans le diner avec votre parachute en passant par le trou du toit.

german.name: Punktlandung
german.description: Springe beim Himmelsgeburt-Überfall mit dem Fallschirm durch ein Loch im Dach des Diners.

italian.name: Atterraggio perfetto
italian.description: Durante il contratto "GENESI CELESTE", paracaduti all'interno della tavola calda passando attraverso un buco nel soffitto.

russian.name: Мягкая посадка
russian.description: Выполняя контракт "Рождение небес", парашютируйтесь прямиком в закусочную через отверстие на крыше.

schinese.name: 精准着陆
schinese.description: 在“天空之生”任务中，跳伞穿过屋顶的洞口降入餐厅。

spanish.name: Aterrizaje perfecto
spanish.description: En el trabajo Nacimiento en el Cielo, entra en el restaurante por un agujero en la azotea mientras usas el paracaídas.

dutch.name: No Blood on the Carpet
dutch.description: In the Birth of Sky job, release the money without having any player take health damage on the OVERKILL difficulty or above. Unlocks the “Oro” mask, “Glade” material and “Tribal Wave” pattern.

english.name: No Blood on the Carpet
english.description: In the Birth of Sky job, release the money without having any player take health damage on the OVERKILL difficulty or above. Unlocks the “Oro” mask, “Glade” material and “Tribal Wave” pattern.

french.name: Gardez votre sang (froid)
french.description: Dans le contrat Genèse céleste, faites en sorte qu’aucun joueur ne prenne de dégât de santé jusqu'à ce que vous larguiez l’argent, en difficulté OVERKILL ou supérieure. Débloque le masque "Oro", le matériau "Clairière" et le motif "Vagues tribale".

german.name: Klein Blut auf dem Teppich
german.description: Wirf beim Himmelsgeburt-Überfall auf der Schwierigkeit OVERKILL oder höher das Geld aus dem Flugzeug, ohne dass ein Spieler Gesundheitsschaden nimmt. Schaltet die Maske "Oro", das Material "Lichtung" und das Muster "Tribal-Welle" frei.

italian.name: Neanche una goccia di sangue
italian.description: Durante il contratto "GENESI CELESTE", sgancia i bancali dall'aereo senza che nessun componente della squadra perda alcun punto vita. Sblocca la maschera "ORO", il materiale "RADURA" e il motivo "ONDA TRIBALE".

russian.name: Не испачкай ковёр кровью
russian.description: Выполняя контракт "Рождение небес" на уровне сложности "OVERKILL" или выше, сбросьте деньги из самолёта так, чтобы никто из членов команды не потерял здоровье. Выполнение достижения открывает маску "Оро", материал "Равнина" и рисунок "Племенная волна".

schinese.name: 地毯不见血
schinese.description: 在“天空之生”行动中，于OVERKILL或更高难度下，在无任何玩家受到生命值伤害的情况下放出钱款。解锁“奥罗”面具、“林间空地”材质和“部落波纹”图案。

spanish.name: Sin sangre en la alfombra
spanish.description: En el trabajo Nacimiento en el Cielo, suelta los palés de dinero sin que ningún jugador haya recibido daño de salud en la dificultad OVERKILL o más alta. Desbloquea la máscara "Oro", el material "Claro" y el patrón "Onda tribal".

dutch.name: 1... 2... 3... JUMP!
dutch.description: In the Birth of Sky job, have the entire crew jump out of the airplane within 1 minute and 23 seconds on the OVERKILL difficulty or above. Unlocks the “Maui” mask, “Wade” material and “Ornamental Crown” pattern.

english.name: 1... 2... 3... JUMP!
english.description: In the Birth of Sky job, have the entire crew jump out of the airplane within 1 minute and 23 seconds on the OVERKILL difficulty or above. Unlocks the “Maui” mask, “Wade” material and “Ornamental Crown” pattern.

french.name: 1… 2… 3… ON SAUTE !
french.description: Dans le contrat Genèse céleste, faites en sorte que toute l’équipe saute de l’avion dans les 1 minute et 23 secondes qui suivent le début du casse, en difficulté OVERKILL ou supérieure. Débloque le masque "Maui", le matériau "Onde pure" et le motif "Couronne ornementale".

german.name: 1 ... 2 ... 3 ... ABSPRUNG!
german.description: Lass beim Himmelsgeburt-Überfall auf der Schwierigkeit OVERKILL oder höher die ganze Crew innerhalb 1 Minute und 23 Sekunden aus dem Flugzeug springen. Schaltet die Maske "Maui", das Material "Türkis" und das Muster "Zierkrone" frei.

italian.name: 1... 2... 3... SALTA!
italian.description: Durante il contratto "GENESI CELESTE", fai in modo che l'intera squadra si paracaduti dall'aereo entro 1 minuto e 23 secondi dall'inizio del colpo in difficoltà OVERKILL o superiore. Sblocca la maschera "MAUI", il materiale "IMPANTANATO" e il motivo "CORONA ORNAMENTALE".

russian.name: 1... 2... 3... ПРЫГАЙ!
russian.description: Выполняя контракт "Рождение небес" на уровне сложности "OVERKILL" или выше, сделайте так, чтобы все члены команды совершили прыжок с парашютом не более чем за 1 минуту и 23 секунды. Выполнение достижения открывает маску "Мауи", материал "Брод" и рисунок "Декоративная корона".

schinese.name: 1…2…3…跳！
schinese.description: 在“天空之生”行动中，于OVERKILL或更高难度下，让全体队员在1分23秒内跳出飞机。解锁“毛伊”面具、“韦德”材质和“装饰王冠”图案。

spanish.name: 1... 2... 3... ¡SALTEN!
spanish.description: En el trabajo Nacimiento en el Cielo, que todo el equipo salte del avión en menos de 1 minuto y 23 segundos en la dificultad OVERKILL o más alta. Desbloquea la máscara "Maui", el material "Wade" y el patrón "Corona decorativa".

dutch.name: Black Tie Event
dutch.description: Complete the Birth of Sky job, have the entire crew use only pistols and Two Piece Suits on the OVERKILL difficulty or above. You have to have been in the heist from start to receive this achievement.

english.name: Black Tie Event
english.description: Complete the Birth of Sky job, have the entire crew use only pistols and Two Piece Suits on the OVERKILL difficulty or above. You have to have been in the heist from start to receive this achievement.

french.name: Tenue de soirée exigée
french.description: Terminez le contrat Genèse céleste en utilisant uniquement des pistolets et le costume deux pièces, en difficulté OVERKILL ou supérieure. Pour terminer ce défi, vous devrez avoir joué à ce casse depuis le début.

german.name: Feierlicher Anlass
german.description: Beende den Himmelsgeburt-Überfall auf der Schwierigkeit OVERKILL oder höher und benutze mit der ganzen Crew nur Pistolen und den klassischen Anzug. Du musst den Überfall vom Anfang bis zum Ende spielen, um diese Auszeichnung zu erhalten.

italian.name: Giacca e cravatta
italian.description: Completa il contratto "GENESI CELESTE" in difficoltà OVERKILL o superiore facendo in modo che tutti i membri della squadra utilizzino soltanto pistole e indossino l'abito elegante. Devi aver partecipato al colpo fin dall'inizio per sbloccare questo achievement.

russian.name: Джентльмены в костюмах
russian.description: Завершите контракт "Рождение небес" вчетвером на уровне сложности "OVERKILl" или выше так, чтобы все члены команды использовали только пистолеты и костюмы-двойки. Чтобы выполнить достижение, вам нужно быть на ограблении с самого начала.

schinese.name: 黑领结盛会
schinese.description: 完成“天空之生”行动，于OVERKILL或更高难度下让全体队员只使用手枪和两件式西装。你必须从头开始参与此次劫案才能获得该成就。

spanish.name: Evento de corbatas negras
spanish.description: Completa el trabajo Nacimiento en el Cielo mientras todo el equipo lleva pistolas duales, pistolas secundarias y el Traje de Dos piezas/Sin Blindaje en la dificultad OVERKILL o más alta.

dutch.name: On the Seventh Try on Death Wish, My True Bain Gave to Me
dutch.description: Complete the Santa’s Workshop job on the Death Wish difficulty or above.

english.name: On the Seventh Try on Death Wish, My True Bain Gave to Me
english.description: Complete the Santa’s Workshop job on the Death Wish difficulty or above.

french.name: Quand on sera en Suicidaire, avec des essais par milliers, n'oublie pas mon petit succès
french.description: Terminez le contrat L'atelier du père Noël en difficulté Suicidaire.

german.name: Ihr Gangsterlein kommet, o kommet doch all'
german.description: Beende den Santas-Werkstatt-Überfall auf der Schwierigkeit Todesmut.

italian.name: In Apocalisse sono stato buono e da Babbo Bain mi merito un bel dono
italian.description: Completa il contratto "FABBRICA DI BABBO NATALE" in difficoltà Apocalisse.

russian.name: На седьмую попытку Death Wish, послал мне верный Бэйн подмогу
russian.description: Завершите контракт "Мастерская Санты" на уровне сложности "Жажда смерти"

schinese.name: 死亡之愿第七试，真爱贝恩送给我
schinese.description: 在死亡之愿或更高难度下完成“圣诞老人的工坊”行动。

spanish.name: En el séptimo intento en Death Wish, Bain me dio a mí
spanish.description: Completa el trabajo El Taller de Papá Noel en la dificultad Death Wish.

dutch.name: Santa Slays Slackers
dutch.description: In the Santa’s Workshop job, keep all the elves alive for 30 minutes after the first assault starts on the OVERKILL difficulty or above.

english.name: Santa Slays Slackers
english.description: In the Santa’s Workshop job, keep all the elves alive for 30 minutes after the first assault starts on the OVERKILL difficulty or above.

french.name: Le père Noël est une ordure
french.description: Dans le contrat L'atelier du père Noël, protégez les lutins pendant 30 minutes après le début du premier assaut en difficulté OVERKILL ou supérieure.

german.name: Santas Sklaven
german.description: Halte beim Überfall "Santas Werkstatt" auf der Schwierigkeit OVERKILL oder höher nach Beginn des ersten Polizeieinsatzes alle Elfen 30 Minuten lang am Leben.

italian.name: I piccoli assassini di Babbo Natale
italian.description: Durante il contratto "FABBRICA DI BABBO NATALE", mantieni gli elfi in vita per 30 minuti dopo l'inizio del primo assalto in difficoltà OVERKILL o superiore.

russian.name: Санта убивает бездельников
russian.description: Выполняя контракт "Мастерская Санты" на уровне сложности "OVERKILL" или выше, не дайте полицейским убить ни одного эльфа в течение 30 минут после начала первого полицейского штурма.

schinese.name: 圣诞老人痛宰懒鬼
schinese.description: 在“圣诞老人的工坊”行动中，于OVERKILL或更高难度下，自首次突击开始后让所有精灵存活30分钟。

spanish.name: Papá Noel mata a los holgazanes
spanish.description: En el trabajo El Taller de Papá Noel, mantén a los elfos con vida durante 30 minutos a partir del primer asalto policial en la dificultad OVERKILL o más alta.

dutch.name: Euro Bag Simulator
dutch.description: Complete the Santa’s Workshop job after having secured at least 100 bags in the chimney on the OVERKILL difficulty or above. Unlocks the “Rudolph” mask.

english.name: Euro Bag Simulator
english.description: Complete the Santa’s Workshop job after having secured at least 100 bags in the chimney on the OVERKILL difficulty or above. Unlocks the “Rudolph” mask.

french.name: Euro Sac Simulator
french.description: Terminez le contrat L'atelier du père Noël en ayant balancé au moins 100 sacs dans la cheminée, en difficulté OVERKILL ou supérieure. Débloque le masque "Caributor".

german.name: Euro Bag Simulator
german.description: Beende den Überfall "Santas Werkstatt" auf der Schwierigkeit OVERKILL oder höher, nachdem du mindestens 100 Taschen im Kamin gesichert hast. Schaltet die "Rudolph"-Maske frei.

italian.name: Simulatore di lancio di borsoni
italian.description: Completa il contratto "LABORATORIO DI BABBO NATALE" mettendo al sicuro almeno 100 borsoni nel camino in difficoltà OVERKILL o superiore. Sblocca la maschera "RUDOLPH".

russian.name: Euro Bag Simulator
russian.description: Завершите контракт "Мастерская Санты" на уровне сложности "OVERKILL" или выше, унеся с собой как минимум 100 сумок с добычей. Выполнение достижения открывает маску "Рудольф".

schinese.name: 欧元袋模拟器
schinese.description: 在OVERKILL或更高难度下，从烟囱回收至少100袋战利品后完成“圣诞老人的工坊”行动。解锁“鲁道夫”面具。

spanish.name: Simulador de bolsas europeo
spanish.description: Completa el trabajo El Taller de Papá Noel habiendo asegurado al menos 100 bolsas en la dificultad OVERKILL o más alta. Desbloquea la máscara “Rudelf”.

dutch.name: Pumped Up and Jolly
dutch.description: Complete the Santa’s Workshop job having all players in the crew only use shotguns. Unlocks the “Christmas Cap” mask.

english.name: Pumped Up and Jolly
english.description: Complete the Santa’s Workshop job having all players in the crew only use shotguns. Unlocks the “Christmas Cap” mask.

french.name: Réveillon à toute pompe
french.description: Terminez le contrat L'atelier du père Noël alors que chaque membre de votre équipe utilise uniquement des fusils à pompe. Débloque le masque "Lutin cupide".

german.name: Schneeflöckchen, Schrotröckchen
german.description: Beende den Überfall "Santas Werkstatt" wenn alle Spieler nur Schrotflinten benutzen. Schaltet die Maske "Weihnachtsmütze" frei.

italian.name: I festeggiamenti della vigilia
italian.description: Completa il contratto "FABBRICA DI BABBO NATALE" facendo in modo che tutti i membri della squadra usino soltanto fucili a pompa. Sblocca la maschera "L'ELFO AVIDO".

russian.name: С дробью и хорошим настроением
russian.description: Завершите контракт "Мастерская Санты" так, чтобы все члены команды использовали только дробовики. Выполнение достижения открывает маску "Эльф Жадина".

schinese.name: 火力全开乐呵呵
schinese.description: 完成“圣诞老人的工坊”行动，且队伍中所有玩家只使用霰弹枪。解锁“圣诞帽”面具。

spanish.name: Alegre y energético
spanish.description: Completa el trabajo El Taller de Papá Noel mientras que todo el equipo lleva escopetas secundarias y principales. Desbloquea la máscara "Greedy, el Elfo".

dutch.name: Only Santa Brings Gifts
dutch.description: In the Santa’s Workshop job, secure 10 bags of loot without using any player equipment or assets.

english.name: Only Santa Brings Gifts
english.description: In the Santa’s Workshop job, secure 10 bags of loot without using any player equipment or assets.

french.name: Les cadeaux, c'est le père Noël qui les apporte
french.description: Dans le contrat L'atelier du père Noël, récupérez 10 sacs de butin sans que personne ne déploie d'équipement ou n'utilise les sacs atouts.

german.name: Nur Santa bringt Geschenke
german.description: Sichere beim Überfall "Santas Werkstatt" 10 Taschen mit Beute, ohne Spielerausrüstung und Vorteile zu nutzen.

italian.name: È arrivato Babbo Natale
italian.description: Durante il contratto "LABORATORIO DI BABBO NATALE", metti al sicuro 10 borsoni senza usare l'equipaggiamento dei giocatori o le risorse acquistabili.

russian.name: Только Санта дарит подарки
russian.description: Выполняя контракт "Мастерская Санты", украдите 10 сумок с ценностями, не используя активы и снаряжение (аптечки, патроны, турели и т.д.).

schinese.name: 只有圣诞老人才能送礼
schinese.description: 在“圣诞老人的工坊”行动中，在不使用任何玩家装备或资产的情况下回收10袋战利品。

spanish.name: Solo Papá Noel entrega regalos
spanish.description: En el trabajo El Taller de Papá Noel, asegura 10 bolsas sin usar recursos o equipamiento llevado por jugadores.

dutch.name: We Do It Live!
dutch.description: Complete the Framing Frame job on the OVERKILL difficulty or above with each crew member using no skills, wearing suits, wielding Platypus 70 sniper rifles and Judge shotguns.

english.name: We Do It Live!
english.description: Complete the Framing Frame job on the OVERKILL difficulty or above with each crew member using no skills, wearing suits, wielding Platypus 70 sniper rifles and Judge shotguns.

french.name: Nous sommes en direct live !
french.description: Terminez le contrat Collectionneur en difficulté OVERKILL ou supérieure. Chaque membre de votre équipe ne doit utiliser aucune compétence, porter un costume deux pièces, utiliser le fusil de précision Platypus 70 et le fusil à pompe Judge.

german.name: Wir tun es live!
german.description: Beende den Kunstgriff-Überfall auf der Schwierigkeit OVERKILL oder höher, wobei alle Crewmitglieder keine Fertigkeiten benutzen, den klassischen Anzug tragen und das Platypus-70-Scharfschützengewehr und die Judge-Schrotflinten einsetzen.

italian.name: Tutto dal vivo!
italian.description: Completa il contratto "CORNICE A INCASTRO" in difficoltà OVERKILL o superiore facendo in modo che tutti i membri della squadra non abbiano abilità, indossino l'abito elegante e abbiano equipaggiato il fucile di precisione Platypus 70 e il fucile a pompa Judge.

russian.name: Мы в прямом эфире!
russian.description: "Завершите контракт "Подстава с картинами" на уровне сложности "OVERKILL" или выше, чтобы каждый член команды был одет в костюм-двойку, не использовал навыков и был вооружён снайперской винтовкой Platypus 70 и дробовиком Judge.

schinese.name: 我们就现场来！
schinese.description: 在OVERKILL或更高难度下完成“栽赃嫁祸”行动，每名队员不使用任何技能、身穿西装、手持鸭嘴兽70狙击步枪和法官霰弹枪。

spanish.name: ¡Lo hacemos en vivo!
spanish.description: Completa el trabajo Arte y Maña en la dificultad OVERKILL o más alta mientras todo el equipo lleva el Fusil de Francotirador Ornitorrinco 70, la Escopeta The Judge, el Traje de Dos Piezas/Sin Blindaje y ninguna habilidad equipada.

dutch.name: Coffee Stain
dutch.description: Complete the Goat Simulator job on the Death Wish difficulty or above.

english.name: Coffee Stain
english.description: Complete the Goat Simulator job on the Death Wish difficulty or above.

french.name: Tache de café
french.description: Terminez le contrat Goat Simulator en difficulté Suicidaire.

german.name: Coffee Stain
german.description: Beende den Goat-Simulator-Überfall auf der Schwierigkeit Todesmut.

italian.name: Macchia di caffè
italian.description: Completa il contratto "GOAT SIMULATOR" in difficoltà Apocalisse.

russian.name: Coffee Stain
russian.description: Завершите контракт "Goat Simulator" на уровне сложности "Жажда смерти".

schinese.name: 咖啡渍
schinese.description: 在死亡之愿或更高难度下完成“模拟山羊”行动。

spanish.name: Coffee Stain
spanish.description: Completa el trabajo Goat Simulator en la dificultad Death Wish.

dutch.name: Goat In 60 Seconds
dutch.description: In the first day of the Goat Simulator heist, secure 6 goats in the escape truck within 1 minute of it arriving. Unlocks the "Scout Goat" mask, "Goat Eye" material and "Giraffe" pattern.

english.name: Goat In 60 Seconds
english.description: In the first day of the Goat Simulator heist, secure 6 goats in the escape truck within 1 minute of it arriving. Unlocks the "Scout Goat" mask, "Goat Eye" material and "Giraffe" pattern.

french.name: 60 secondes chevreau
french.description: Au 1er jour du contrat Goat Simulator, balancez 6 chèvres dans le camion dans la minute qui suit son arrivée. Débloque le masque "Chèvre éclaireuse".

german.name: Ziege In 60 Sekunden
german.description: Sichere am ersten Tag des Goat-Simulator-Überfalls innerhalb 1 Minute nach Eintreffen des Fluchttransporters 6 Ziegen in ihm. Schaltet die "Späher-Ziege"-Maske frei.

italian.name: Capra in 60 secondi
italian.description: Durante il primo giorno del contratto "GOAT SIMULATOR", metti al sicuro 6 capre nel camion entro 1 minuto dal suo arrivo. Sblocca la maschera "CAPRA ESPLORATRICE".

russian.name: Коза за 60 секунд
russian.description: На первом дне контракта "Goat Simulator", доставьте 6 коз в клетку грузовика за одну минуту после его прибытия. Выполнение достижения открывает маску "Коза-разведчик", материал "Козий глаз" и рисунок "Жираф".

schinese.name: 极速60秒山羊
schinese.description: 在山羊模拟器劫案第一天，逃脱卡车到达后1分钟内将6只山羊装车保全。解锁“侦察山羊”面具、“山羊眼”材质和“长颈鹿”图案。

spanish.name: Desacabrecidas en 1 minuto
spanish.description: In the first day of the Goat Simulator heist, secure 6 goats in the escape truck within 1 minute of it arriving. Unlocks the \Scout Goat\

dutch.name: Hazzard County
dutch.description: Complete the second day of the Goat Simulator heist within 4 minutes from when the escape car is available. Unlocks the "Goat Goat" mask, "Flamingo Eye" material and "Illumigoati" pattern.

english.name: Hazzard County
english.description: Complete the second day of the Goat Simulator heist within 4 minutes from when the escape car is available. Unlocks the "Goat Goat" mask, "Flamingo Eye" material and "Illumigoati" pattern.

french.name: Chèvrif fais-moi peur
french.description: Terminez le 2ème jour du contrat Goat Simulator en moins de 4 minutes à partir du moment où vous pouvez utiliser la voiture pour vous enfuir. Débloque le masque "Chèvre chèvre".

german.name: Hazzard County
german.description: Beende den zweiten Tag des Goat-Simulator-Überfalls 1 Minute nachdem das Fluchtfahrzeug verfügbar ist. Schaltet die "Ziege-Ziege"-Maske frei.

italian.name: Contea del pericolo
italian.description: Completa il secondo giorno del contratto "GOAT SIMULATOR" entro 4 minuti dal momento in cui è possibile usare l'auto per raggiungere il punto di estrazione. Sblocca la maschera "CAPRA CAPRA".

russian.name: Придурки из Хаззарда
russian.description: Завершите второй день контракта "Goat Simulator" за 4 или менее минут, после активации побега на автомобиле. Выполнение достижения открывает маску "Коза-коза", материал "Глаз фламинго" и рисунок "Иллюмикозы".

schinese.name: 哈泽德县
schinese.description: 在逃脱车辆可用后4分钟内完成山羊模拟器劫案第二天。解锁“山羊山羊”面具、“火烈鸟眼”材质和“光明山羊会”图案。

spanish.name: Condado del peligro
spanish.description: En el día 2 del trabajo Goat Simulator, una vez aseguradas todas las cabras, huye en menos de 4 minutos. Desbloquea la máscara "Cabra Cabra", el material "Ojo de flamenco" y el patrón "Illumicabri".

dutch.name: BAAaa...*BANG*...aaAAH
dutch.description: In the Goat Simulator heist, throw a goat in the air, kill one enemy and catch the goat before it lands. Unlocks the "Wet Goat" mask, "Hay" material and "Goat Face" pattern.

english.name: BAAaa...*BANG*...aaAAH
english.description: In the Goat Simulator heist, throw a goat in the air, kill one enemy and catch the goat before it lands. Unlocks the "Wet Goat" mask, "Hay" material and "Goat Face" pattern.

french.name: BÊÊêê... *PAN* ...êêÊÊÊ
french.description: Dans le contrat Goat Simulator, jetez une chèvre en l'air, tuez un ennemi et rattrapez la chèvre au vol. Débloque le masque "Chèvre intelligente".

german.name: MÄÄää...*PENG*...ääÄÄH
german.description: Wirf beim Goat-Simulator-Überfall eine Ziege in die Luft, töte einen Feind und fang die Ziege wieder in der Luft auf. Schaltet die "Drahtzieher-Ziege"-Maske frei.

italian.name: Beee...*BANG*...eeEE
italian.description: Durante il contratto "GOAT SIMULATOR", lancia una capra in aria, uccidi un nemico e riprendi la capra prima che tocchi terra. Sblocca la maschera "CAPRA PRODIGIO".

russian.name: БЭЭээ...*БУМ*...эээххХХ!
russian.description: Во время выполнения контракта "Goat Simulator", подбросьте в воздух козу, убейте противника и поймайте её до приземления. Выполнение достижения открывает маску "Коза манипулятор", материал "Сено" и рисунок "Козья морда"

schinese.name: 咩…*砰*…啊啊啊
schinese.description: 在山羊模拟器劫案中，把一只山羊抛向空中，击杀一名敌人，并在山羊落地前将其接住。解锁“湿山羊”面具、“干草”材质和“山羊脸”图案。

spanish.name: BEEee...*PUM*...eeEEH
spanish.description: En el trabajo Goat Simulator o Pirómano, lanza a una cabra por los aires, mata a un enemigo y atrapa a la cabra antes de que toque el suelo. Desbloquea la máscara "Cabra Mente Maestra", el material "Heno" y el patrón "Cara de cabra".

dutch.name: Farmer Miserable
dutch.description: In the second day of the Goat Simulator heist, send all goats in separate cages on the OVERKILL difficulty or above. Unlocks the "Slick Goat" mask, "Tongue" material and "Fur" pattern.

english.name: Farmer Miserable
english.description: In the second day of the Goat Simulator heist, send all goats in separate cages on the OVERKILL difficulty or above. Unlocks the "Slick Goat" mask, "Tongue" material and "Fur" pattern.

french.name: Fermier misérable
french.description: Au 2ème jour du contrat Goat Simulator, expédiez chaque chèvre dans des cages séparées, en difficulté OVERKILL ou supérieure. Débloque le masque "Chèvre élégante".

german.name: Farmer Miserable
german.description: Schicke am zweiten Tag des Goat-Simulator-Überfalls auf der Schwierigkeit OVERKILL oder höher jede Ziege in einen eigenen Käfig. Schaltet die "Coole Ziege"-Maske frei.

italian.name: La dura vita dell'allevatore
italian.description: Durante il secondo giorno del contratto "GOAT SIMULATOR", fai in modo che ogni singola capra venga spedita in una gabbia diversa in difficoltà OVERKILL o superiore. Sblocca la maschera "CAPRA ELEGANTE".

russian.name: Несчастный фермер
russian.description: На втором дне контракта "Goat Simulator", переправьте всех коз в отдельных клетках на уровне сложности "OVERKILL" или выше. Выполнение достижения открывает маску "Коза ловкач", материал "Язык" и рисунок "Шерсть".

schinese.name: 农场悲惨世界
schinese.description: 在山羊模拟器劫案第二天，于OVERKILL或更高难度下将所有山羊分别关进单独的笼子。解锁“油头山羊”面具、“舌头”材质和“毛皮”图案。

spanish.name: Granjero Miserable
spanish.description: En el día 2 del trabajo Goat Simulator, asegura a todas las cabras una por una en jaulas diferentes en la dificultad OVERKILL o más alta. Desbloquea la máscara "Cabra Mojada", el material "Lengua" y el patrón "Pelaje".

dutch.name: You Can Run, but Not Hide
dutch.description: Find and secure the goat in the Firestarter heist on the OVERKILL difficulty or above.

english.name: You Can Run, but Not Hide
english.description: Find and secure the goat in the Firestarter heist on the OVERKILL difficulty or above.

french.name: Tu peux te cacher mais tu ne m'échapperas pas
french.description: Trouvez et récupérez la chèvre cachée dans le contrat Pyromane en difficulté OVERKILL ou supérieure.

german.name: Du entwischt mir nicht
german.description: Finde und sichere die Ziege im Brandstifter-Überfall auf der Schwierigkeit OVERKILL oder höher.

italian.name: Puoi correre, ma non puoi nasconderti
italian.description: Trova e metti al sicuro la capra durante il contratto "PIROMANI" in difficoltà OVERKILL o superiore.

russian.name: Ты можешь бежать, но не сможешь скрыться
russian.description: Найдите и спасите козу выполняя контракт "Поджигатель" на уровне сложности "OVERKILL" или выше.

schinese.name: 你可以跑，但躲不掉
schinese.description: 在OVERKILL或更高难度下的纵火者劫案中，找到并保全山羊。

spanish.name: Puedes correr, pero no te puedes esconder
spanish.description: Encuentra y asegura a la cabra del trabajo Pirómano en la dificultad OVERKILL o más alta.

dutch.name: Under Pressure
dutch.description: Complete the Counterfeit job on the Death Wish difficulty or above.

english.name: Under Pressure
english.description: Complete the Counterfeit job on the Death Wish difficulty or above.

french.name: Sous pression
french.description: Terminez le contrat Contrefaçon en difficulté Suicidaire.

german.name: Unter Druck
german.description: Beende den Falschgeld-Überfall auf der Schwierigkeit Todesmut.

italian.name: Sotto pressione
italian.description: Completa il contratto "FALSARIO" in difficoltà Apocalisse.

russian.name: Под давлением
russian.description: Завершите контракт "Подделка" на уровне сложности "Жажда смерти".

schinese.name: 压力之下
schinese.description: 在死亡之愿或更高难度下完成伪钞任务。

spanish.name: Bajo presión
spanish.description: Completa el trabajo Counterfeit en la dificultad Death Wish.

dutch.name: Dr. Evil
dutch.description: Print and secure $1,000,000 worth of counterfeit money in the Helicopter on the Counterfeit job. Unlocks the "Viking" mask, "Houndstooth" material and "Fenris" pattern.

english.name: Dr. Evil
english.description: Print and secure $1,000,000 worth of counterfeit money in the Helicopter on the Counterfeit job. Unlocks the "Viking" mask, "Houndstooth" material and "Fenris" pattern.

french.name: Dr. Denfer
french.description: Dans le contrat Contrefaçon, imprimez et récupérez 1 000 000$ en faux billets. Débloque le masque "Le Viking".

german.name: Dr. Evil
german.description: Drucke beim Falschgeld-Überfall 1.000.000 $ Falschgeld und sichere sie im Hubschrauber. Schaltet die "Wikinger"-Maske frei

italian.name: Dottor Male
italian.description: Durante il contratto "FALSARIO", stampa e carica sull'elicottero una quantità di banconote false del valore di 1.000.000 di dollari. Sblocca la maschera "IL VICHINGO".

russian.name: Доктор Зло
russian.description: Напечатайте и унесите $1,000,000 поддельных денег с помощью вертолёта на контракте "Подделка". Открывает маску "Викинг".

schinese.name: 邪恶博士
schinese.description: 在伪钞任务中，印制价值1,000,000美元的伪钞并装入直升机保全。解锁“维京人”面具、“犬牙纹”材质和“芬里尔”图案。

spanish.name: Doctor Malito
spanish.description: En el trabajo Counterfeit, imprime y asegura $1.000.000 en dinero falsificado. Desbloquea la máscara "El Vikingo", el material "Pata de gallo" y el patrón "Fenris".

dutch.name: Cutting the Red Wire
dutch.description: Disarm the C4 on the Counterfeit job on the OVERKILL difficulty or above. Unlocks the "Dragon Head" mask, "Days" material and "Kurbits" pattern.

english.name: Cutting the Red Wire
english.description: Disarm the C4 on the Counterfeit job on the OVERKILL difficulty or above. Unlocks the "Dragon Head" mask, "Days" material and "Kurbits" pattern.

french.name: Couper le fil rouge
french.description: Dans le contrat Contrefaçon, désamorcez le C4 en difficulté OVERKILL ou supérieure. Débloque le masque "La Tête de dragon".

german.name: Den roten Draht durchschneiden
german.description: Entschärfe beim Falschgeld-Überfall auf der Schwierigkeit OVERKILL oder höher das C4. Schaltet die "Drachenkopf"-Maske frei.

italian.name: Taglia il filo rosso
italian.description: Disinnesca il C4 durante il contratto "FALSARIO" in difficoltà OVERKILL o superiore. Sblocca la maschera "LA TESTA DI DRAGO".

russian.name: Перерезать красный провод
russian.description: Выполняя контракт "Подделка", обезвредьте все заряды C4 на уровне сложности "OVERKILL" или выше. Выполнение достижения открывает маску "Голова дракона", материал "Дни" и рисунок "Узоры".

schinese.name: 剪断红线
schinese.description: 在OVERKILL或更高难度下的伪钞任务中拆除C4。解锁“龙首”面具、“日子”材质和“库尔比茨”图案。

spanish.name: Cortando el cable rojo
spanish.description: En el trabajo Counterfeit, desactiva el C4 que puede haber en el sótano. Desbloquea la máscara "La Cabeza de Dragón", el material "Días" y el patrón "Kurbits".

dutch.name: Basement Dwellers
dutch.description: Don't let the cops enter the printing room on the Counterfeit job until the safe is opened on OVERKILL difficulty or above.

english.name: Basement Dwellers
english.description: Don't let the cops enter the printing room on the Counterfeit job until the safe is opened on OVERKILL difficulty or above.

french.name: Les monstres du sous-sol
french.description: Dans le contrat Contrefaçon, empêchez les flics de pénétrer dans la salle de l'imprimante jusqu'à ce que le coffre soit ouvert, en difficulté OVERKILL ou supérieure.

german.name: Kellerkinder
german.description: Lass beim Falschgeld-Überfall auf der Schwierigkeit OVERKILL oder höher die Bullen nicht den Druckerraum betreten, bis der Tresor geöffnet wurde.

italian.name: I mostri del seminterrato
italian.description: Durante il contratto "FALSARIO", impedisci agli sbirri di entrare nella stanza della stampante fino all'apertura della cassaforte in difficoltà OVERKILL o superiore.

russian.name: Подвальные жители
russian.description: Во время выполнения контракта "Подделка", не дайте полицейским войти в подвал до открытия сейфа на уровне сложности "OVERKILL" или выше.

schinese.name: 地窖住户
schinese.description: 在OVERKILL或更高难度下的伪钞任务中，在保险箱被打开前不让警察进入印钞室。

spanish.name: Merodeadores de sótanos
spanish.description: En el trabajo Counterfeit, no dejes que ningún policía entre en el sótano hasta que se abra la caja fuerte en la dificultad OVERKILL o más alta.

dutch.name: Crowd Control
dutch.description: On the Counterfeit job, have all civilians as hostages until the safe is opened.

english.name: Crowd Control
english.description: On the Counterfeit job, have all civilians as hostages until the safe is opened.

french.name: Contrôle de foule
french.description: Dans le contrat Contrefaçon, retenez tous les civils en otage jusqu'à ce que le coffre soit ouvert.

german.name: Volle Kontrolle
german.description: Nimm beim Falschgeld-Überfall alle Zivilisten als Geiseln, bis der Tresor geöffnet wurde.

italian.name: Controllo della folla
italian.description: Durante il contratto "FALSARIO", fai in modo di tenere tutti i civili in ostaggio fino all'apertura della cassaforte.

russian.name: Контроль толпы
russian.description: Во время выполнения контракта "Подделка", удерживайте всех гражданских в качестве заложников до открытия сейфа.

schinese.name: 人群控制
schinese.description: 在伪钞任务中，让所有平民都成为人质，直至保险箱被打开。

spanish.name: Control de multitud
spanish.description: En el trabajo Counterfeit, ata a todos los civiles y asegúrate de que estén atados hasta que se abra la caja fuerte.

dutch.name: In for a dime, in for a Dollar
dutch.description: Complete the Undercover job on the Death Wish difficulty or above.

english.name: In for a dime, in for a Dollar
english.description: Complete the Undercover job on the Death Wish difficulty or above.

french.name: Boire le calice jusqu'à la limousine
french.description: Terminez le contrat En sous-marin en difficulté Suicidaire.

german.name: Lizenz zum Gelddrucken
german.description: Beende den Undercover-Überfall auf der Schwierigkeit Todesmut.

italian.name: Quando si è in ballo, bisogna ballare
italian.description: Completa il contratto "SOTTO COPERTURA" in difficoltà Apocalisse.

russian.name: Кто не рискует, тот не выигрывает
russian.description: Завершите контракт "Под прикрытием" на уровне сложности "Жажда смерти

schinese.name: 一不做二不休
schinese.description: 在“死亡愿望”或更高难度下完成“卧底”任务。

spanish.name: Un centavo, un dólar, no hay diferencia
spanish.description: Completa el trabajo Undercover en la dificultad Death Wish.

dutch.name: Not Even Once
dutch.description: Complete the Undercover job on OVERKILL difficulty or above without anyone in your crew getting downed or cuffed.

english.name: Not Even Once
english.description: Complete the Undercover job on OVERKILL difficulty or above without anyone in your crew getting downed or cuffed.

french.name: Pas même une seule fois
french.description: Terminez le contrat En sous-marin en difficulté OVERKILL ou supérieure sans qu'un seul joueur ne tombe à terre ou se fasse menotter.

german.name: Kein einziges Mal
german.description: Beende den Undercover-Überfall auf der Schwierigkeit OVERKILL oder höher, ohne dass jemand aus deiner Crew zu Boden geht oder hin Handschellen gelegt wird.

italian.name: Nemmeno una volta
italian.description: Completa il contratto "SOTTO COPERTURA" senza che nessun componente della tua squadra venga atterrato o ammanettato.

russian.name: Даже ни разу
russian.description: Завершите контракт "Под прикрытием" на уровне сложности "OVERKILL" или выше, без падений в команде.

schinese.name: 一次都不行
schinese.description: 在OVERKILL或更高难度下完成“卧底”任务，且队伍中无人被击倒或被铐住。

spanish.name: Ni una vez
spanish.description: Completa el trabajo Undercover sin que incapaciten o esposen a ningún jugador en la dificultad OVERKILL o más alta.

dutch.name: Keep Clear of the Windows
dutch.description: Complete the Undercover job without killing any Snipers. Unlocks the "Hans" mask, "Red Black" material and "Luse" pattern.

english.name: Keep Clear of the Windows
english.description: Complete the Undercover job without killing any Snipers. Unlocks the "Hans" mask, "Red Black" material and "Luse" pattern.

french.name: Éloignez-vous des fenêtres
french.description: Terminez le contrat En sous-marin sans tuer un seul Sniper. Débloque le masque "Hans".

german.name: Haltet euch von den Fenstern fern
german.description: Beende den Undercover-Überfall, ohne einen Scharfschützen zu töten. Schaltet die "Hans"-Maske frei

italian.name: Lontani dalle finestre
italian.description: Completa il contratto "SOTTO COPERTURA" senza uccidere alcun cecchino. Sblocca la maschera "HANS".

russian.name: Держись подальше от окон
russian.description: Завершите контракт "Под прикрытием" без убийства снайперов. Выполнение достижения откроет маску "Ганс", материал "Красный-чёрный" и рисунок "Кружева".

schinese.name: 离窗户远点
schinese.description: 完成“卧底”任务，且不击杀任何狙击手。解锁“汉斯”面具、“红黑”材质和“卢泽”图案。

spanish.name: ¡No se acerquen a las ventanas!
spanish.description: Completa el trabajo Undercover sin que nadie mate Snipers. Desbloquea la máscara "Hans", el material "Negro rojizo" y el patrón "Luse".

dutch.name: The Saviour
dutch.description: On the Undercover job, place 10 planks on windows, vents or fences. Unlocks the "Trickster Demon" mask, "Mushroom Cloud" material and "Split" pattern.

english.name: The Saviour
english.description: On the Undercover job, place 10 planks on windows, vents or fences. Unlocks the "Trickster Demon" mask, "Mushroom Cloud" material and "Split" pattern.

french.name: Un vrai héros
french.description: Dans le contrat En sous-marin, barricadez 10 fenêtres, conduits ou barrières. Débloque le masque "Démon blagueur".

german.name: Der Retter
german.description: Bringe beim Undercover-Überfall 10 Planken an Fenstern, Lüftungsschächten oder Zäunen an. Schaltet die "Trickdämon"-Maske frei.

italian.name: Il salvatore
italian.description: Durante il contratto "SOTTO COPERTURA", fai in modo di posizionare 10 assi di legno su finestre, condotti di ventilazione o recinzioni. Sblocca la maschera "IL DEMONE INGANNATORE".

russian.name: Спаситель
russian.description: On the Undercover job, place 10 planks on windows, vents or fences. Unlocks the \Trickster Demon\","Во время контракта "Под прикрытием", установите 10 досок на окна, вентиляцию или ограждения. Выполнение достижения откроет маску "Обманчивый демон", материал "Грибное облако" и рисунок "Разрез"

schinese.name: 救世主
schinese.description: 在“卧底”任务中，将10块木板钉在窗户、通风口或围栏上。解锁“诡计恶魔”面具、“蘑菇云”材质和“分裂”图案。

spanish.name: Maestros carpinteros
spanish.description: En el trabajo Undercover, usa 10 tablones para bloquear ventanas, ventilaciones o verjas. Desbloquea la máscara "Demonio Bromista", el material "Nube de hongo nuclear" y el patrón "A la mitad".

dutch.name: Blow-Out
dutch.description: Complete the Undercover job on OVERKILL difficulty or above, using only a grenade launcher or rocket launcher.

english.name: Blow-Out
english.description: Complete the Undercover job on OVERKILL difficulty or above, using only a grenade launcher or rocket launcher.

french.name: Feu d'artifice
french.description: Terminez le contrat En sous-marin en difficulté OVERKILL ou supérieure en utilisant uniquement un lance-grenades ou un lance-roquettes.

german.name: Feuerwerk
german.description: Beende den Undercover-Überfall auf der Schwierigkeit OVERKILL oder höher, wobei du nur einen Granat- oder Raketenwerfer benutzt.

italian.name: Fuochi d'artificio
italian.description: Completa il contratto "SOTTO COPERTURA" in difficoltà OVERKILL o superiore usando soltanto un lanciagranate o un lanciarazzi.

russian.name: Взрывоопасная личность
russian.description: Завершите контракт "Под прикрытием" на уровне сложности "OVERKILL" или выше, используя только гранатомёты и рпг.

schinese.name: 炸翻天
schinese.description: 在OVERKILL或更高难度下，仅使用榴弹发射器或火箭发射器完成“卧底”任务。

spanish.name: Personalidad explosiva
spanish.description: Completa el trabajo Undercover en la dificultad OVERKILL o más alta usando solo lanzagranadas o lanzacohetes.

dutch.name: Blackout
dutch.description: Complete the Murky Station job on the Death Wish difficulty or above.

english.name: Blackout
english.description: Complete the Murky Station job on the Death Wish difficulty or above.

french.name: Plongés dans le noir
french.description: Terminez le contrat Gare de pillage en difficulté Suicidaire.

german.name: Blackout
german.description: Beende den Überfall "Murky Station" auf der Schwierigkeit Todesmut.

italian.name: Immersi nell'oscurità
italian.description: Completa il contratto "STAZIONE DELLA MURKYWATER" in difficoltà Apocalisse.

russian.name: Под покровом темноты
russian.description: Завершите контракт "Станция Murkywater" на уровне сложности "Жажда смерти".

schinese.name: 熄灯
schinese.description: 在“死亡愿望”或更高难度下完成“阴暗车站”任务。

spanish.name: Apagón
spanish.description: Completa el trabajo Estación Murky en la dificultad Death Wish.

dutch.name: Ghost Run
dutch.description: Complete the Murky Station job within 7 minutes of starting it. Unlocks the "Cloaker-san" mask, "Rusty" material and "Rebel" pattern.

english.name: Ghost Run
english.description: Complete the Murky Station job within 7 minutes of starting it. Unlocks the "Cloaker-san" mask, "Rusty" material and "Rebel" pattern.

french.name: Passage en coup de vent
french.description: Terminez le contrat Gare de pillage en moins de 7 minutes. Débloque le masque "Cloaker-san", le matériau "Rouillé" et le motif "Rebelle".

german.name: Geisterhaft
german.description: Beende den Überfall "Murky Station" innerhalb 7 Minuten nach Auftragsbeginn. Schaltet die Maske "Cloaker-san", das Material "Rost" und das Muster "Rebell" frei.

italian.name: Operazione Spettro
italian.description: Completa il contratto "STAZIONE DELLA MURKYWATER" entro 7 minuti dall'inizio del colpo. Sblocca la maschera "CLOAKER-SAN", il materiale "ARRUGGINITO" e il motivo "RIBELLE".

russian.name: Призрачный забег
russian.description: Завершите контракт "Станция Murkywater" за 7 или менее минут после начала ограбления. Выполнение достижения открывает маску "Клокер-сан", материал "Ржавчина" и рисунок "Повстанец".

schinese.name: 幽灵潜行
schinese.description: 在开始后7分钟内完成“阴暗车站”任务。解锁“潜伏者桑”面具、“锈迹”材质和“叛逆”图案。

spanish.name: Fantasma veloz
spanish.description: Completa el trabajo Estación Murky en menos de 7 minutos. Desbloquea la máscara "Cloaker-san", el material "Oxidado" y el patrón "Rebelde".

dutch.name: The Pacifist
dutch.description: Complete the Murky Station job without anyone in the crew killing anyone. Unlocks the "Augmentation" mask, "Spaceship" material and "Squares" pattern.

english.name: The Pacifist
english.description: Complete the Murky Station job without anyone in the crew killing anyone. Unlocks the "Augmentation" mask, "Spaceship" material and "Squares" pattern.

french.name: Pacifiste
french.description: Terminez le contrat Gare de pillage sans que personne ne tue qui que ce soit. Débloque le masque "Augmentation", le matériau "Vaisseau spatial" et le motif "Carrés".

german.name: Der Pazifist
german.description: Beende den Überfall "Murky Station", ohne dass ein Crewmitglied jemanden tötet. Schaltet die Maske "Augmentierung", das Material "Raumschiff" und das Muster "Quadrate" frei.

italian.name: Il pacifista
italian.description: Completa il contratto "STAZIONE DELLA MURKYWATER" facendo in modo che nessun componente della tua squadra non uccida nessuno. Sblocca la maschera "AUMENTO", il materiale "NAVE SPAZIALE" e il motivo "QUADRATI".

russian.name: Пацифист
russian.description: Завершите контракт "Станция Murkywater" не совершая убийств. Выполнение достижения открывает маску "Аугментация", материал "Космический корабль" и рисунок "Квадраты"

schinese.name: 和平主义者
schinese.description: 完成“阴暗车站”任务，且队伍中无人击杀任何人。解锁“强化改造”面具、“宇宙飞船”材质和“方格”图案。

spanish.name: Los pacifistas
spanish.description: Completa el trabajo Estación Murky sin que nadie mate a nadie. Desbloquea la máscara "Aumento", el material "Nave espacial" y el patrón "Cuadrados".

dutch.name: No Witnesses
dutch.description: Complete the Murky Station job by killing all guards and not using any ECM jammers on the OVERKILL difficulty or above.

english.name: No Witnesses
english.description: Complete the Murky Station job by killing all guards and not using any ECM jammers on the OVERKILL difficulty or above.

french.name: Pas si fiste que ça
french.description: Terminez le contrat Gare de pillage en ayant tué tous les gardes et sans utiliser de brouilleur CME, en difficulté OVERKILL ou supérieure.

german.name: Keine Zeugen
german.description: Beende den Überfall "Murky Station" auf der Schwierigkeit OVERKILL oder höher, indem du alle Wachen tötest und ohne ECM-Störsender einzusetzen.

italian.name: Nessun testimone
italian.description: Completa il contratto "STAZIONE DELLA MURKYWATER" in difficoltà OVERKILL o superiore senza uccidere nessuna guardia e senza usare nessun jammer.

russian.name: Без свидетелей
russian.description: Завершите контракт "Станция Murkywater" после убийства всех охранников на уровне сложности "OVERKILL" или выше, без использования генератора помех.

schinese.name: 不留活口
schinese.description: 在OVERKILL或更高难度下完成“阴暗车站”任务，击杀所有守卫且不使用任何ECM干扰器。

spanish.name: Sin testigos
spanish.description: Completa el trabajo Estación Murky habiendo matado a todos los guardias y sin haber usado Inhibidores ECM en la dificultad OVERKILL o más alta.

dutch.name: Janitor
dutch.description: Complete the Murky Station job after hiding one body bag in each dumpster.

english.name: Janitor
english.description: Complete the Murky Station job after hiding one body bag in each dumpster.

french.name: Ramassage des ordures
french.description: Terminez le contrat Gare de pillage en ayant jeté un sac mortuaire dans chaque poubelle.

german.name: Hausmeister
german.description: Beende den Überfall "Murky Station", nachdem du in jedem Müllcontainer einen Leichensack platziert hast.

italian.name: Addetto alle pulizie
italian.description: Completa il contratto "STAZIONE DELLA MURKYWATER" dopo aver nascosto un sacco per cadaveri in ogni cassonetto della spazzatura.

russian.name: Уборщик
russian.description: Завершите контракт "Станция Murkywater" после того, как вы спрячите по мешку с трупом в каждый мусорный бак.

schinese.name: 清洁工
schinese.description: 在每个垃圾箱中各藏一袋尸体后，完成“阴暗车站”任务。

spanish.name: Conserje
spanish.description: Completa el trabajo Estación Murky habiendo escondido una bolsa de cadáveres en cada contenedor de basura.

dutch.name: Red Snow
dutch.description: Complete the Boiling Point job on the Death Wish difficulty or above.

english.name: Red Snow
english.description: Complete the Boiling Point job on the Death Wish difficulty or above.

french.name: Du sang sur la neige
french.description: Terminez le contrat De l'orage dans l'air en difficulté Suicidaire.

german.name: Roter Schnee
german.description: Beende den Siedepunkt-Überfall auf der Schwierigkeit Todesmut.

italian.name: Neve rossa
italian.description: Completa il contratto "PUNTO DI EBOLLIZIONE" in difficoltà Apocalisse.

russian.name: Красный снег
russian.description: Завершите контракт "Точка кипения" на уровне сложности "Жажда смерти"

schinese.name: 红雪
schinese.description: 在“沸点”任务中，于死亡之愿或以上难度下完成任务。

spanish.name: Rojas nieves
spanish.description: Completa el trabajo Punto de Ebullición en la dificultad Death Wish.

dutch.name: The Ground Is Too Cold
dutch.description: In the Boiling Point job, have no crew members get downed on the OVERKILL difficulty or above. Unlocks the "Zero 68" mask, "Nebula" material and "Hexagons" pattern.

english.name: The Ground Is Too Cold
english.description: In the Boiling Point job, have no crew members get downed on the OVERKILL difficulty or above. Unlocks the "Zero 68" mask, "Nebula" material and "Hexagons" pattern.

french.name: Il fait trop froid par terre
french.description: Dans le contrat De l'orage dans l'air, faites en sorte de ne jamais tomber à terre, en difficulté OVERKILL ou supérieure. Débloque le masque "Zero 68", le matériau "Nébuleuse" et le motif "Hexagones".

german.name: Der Boden ist zu kalt
german.description: Werde beim Siedepunkt-Überfall auf der Schwierigkeit OVERKILL oder höher nie außer Gefecht gesetzt. Schaltet die Maske "Zero 68", das Material "Sternennebel" und das Muster "Sechsecke" frei.

italian.name: Il suolo è troppo freddo
italian.description: Completa il contratto "PUNTO DI EBOLLIZIONE" in difficoltà OVERKILL o superiore senza mai essere atterrato. Sblocca la maschera "ZERO 68", il materiale "NEBULOSO" e il motivo "ESAGONI".

russian.name: Земля слишком холодна
russian.description: Завершите контракт "Точка кипения" без падений на уровне сложности "OVERKILL" или выше. Выполение достижения открывает маску "Зеро-68", материал "Дымка" и рисунок "Шестигранники"

schinese.name: 地面太冷
schinese.description: 在“沸点”任务中，于OVERKILL或以上难度下无任何队员倒地。解锁“零式68”面具、“星云”材质和“六边形”图案。

spanish.name: El suelo está muy frío
spanish.description: Completa el trabajo Punto de Ebullición sin que incapaciten o esposen a ningún jugador en la dificultad OVERKILL o más alta. Desbloquea la máscara "Zero 68", el material "Nebulosa" y el patrón "Hexágonos".

dutch.name: Crazy Ivan
dutch.description: Complete the Boiling Point job having everyone only using melee weapons without electricity or poison to kill enemies on the Very Hard difficulty or above. Unlocks the "Safety First" mask, "Planet" material and "Phoenix" pattern.

english.name: Crazy Ivan
english.description: Complete the Boiling Point job having everyone only using melee weapons without electricity or poison to kill enemies on the Very Hard difficulty or above. Unlocks the "Safety First" mask, "Planet" material and "Phoenix" pattern.

french.name: Castagnes russes
french.description: Terminez le contrat De l'orage dans l'air en difficulté Très difficile ou supérieure. Chaque membre de l'équipe doit uniquement utiliser son arme de mêlée pour tuer les ennemis. L'arme ne doit pas être électrique ou empoisonnée. Débloque le masque "Protection fiable", le matériau "Planète" et le motif "Phénix".

german.name: Irrer Ivan
german.description: Beende den Siedepunkt-Überfall auf der Schwierigkeit Sehr Schwer oder höher, wobei Spieler Feinde nur mit Nahkampfwaffen töten dürfen. Schaltet die Maske "Sicher ist sicher", das Material "Planet" und das Muster "Phönix" frei.

italian.name: Teppisti russi
italian.description: Completa il contratto "PUNTO DI EBOLLIZIONE" in difficoltà Molto difficile o superiore facendo in modo che tutti i componenti della squadra utilizzino soltanto armi da mischia per uccidere i nemici. Sblocca la maschera "LA SICUREZZA PRIMA DI TUTTO", il materiale "PIANETA" e il motivo "FENICE".

russian.name: Сумасшедший Иван
russian.description: Завершите контракт "Точка кипения" так, чтобы все члены вашей команды, включая вас, использовали для убийства противников оружие ближнего боя на уровне сложности "Очень тяжело" или выше. Выполнение достижения откроет маску "Безопасность - превыше всего, материал "Планета" и рисунок "Феникс".

schinese.name: 疯狂伊万
schinese.description: 在“沸点”任务中，全员只使用近战武器（不使用电击或毒药）击杀敌人，于非常困难或以上难度下完成任务。解锁“安全第一”面具、“行星”材质和“凤凰”图案。

spanish.name: Loco Iván
spanish.description: Completa el trabajo Punto de Ebullición en la dificultad Muy Difícil o más alta mientras que todo el equipo haya usado solo armas cuerpo a cuerpo (sin electricidad o veneno) para matar enemigos. Desbloquea la máscara "Primero la Seguridad", el material "Planeta" y el patrón "Fénix".

dutch.name: When in Russia... Do as the Russians Do
dutch.description: Complete the Boiling Point job while having your crew wear the "Russian Hat" mask and "Golden AK.762" assault rifle on the OVERKILL difficulty or above.

english.name: When in Russia... Do as the Russians Do
english.description: Complete the Boiling Point job while having your crew wear the "Russian Hat" mask and "Golden AK.762" assault rifle on the OVERKILL difficulty or above.

french.name: Le déguisement parfait
french.description: Terminez le contrat De l'orage dans l'air en difficulté OVERKILL ou supérieure. Chaque membre de votre équipe doit porter le masque "Chapeau russe" et utiliser le fusil d'assaut "AK.762 en or".

german.name: Für Mütterchen Russland
german.description: Beende den Siedepunkt-Überfall auf der Schwierigkeit OVERKILL oder höher, wobei deine Crew die Maske "Russische Mütze" und das "Goldene AK.762"-Sturmgewehr tragen.

italian.name: La grande madre Russia
italian.description: Completa il contratto "PUNTO DI EBOLLIZIONE" in difficoltà OVERKILL o superiore facendo in modo che tutti i membri della squadra indossino la maschera "CAPPELLO RUSSO" e abbiano equipaggiato il fucile dorato AK.762.

russian.name: Когда ты в России... Веди себя как русский
russian.description: Завершите контракт "Точка кипения" так, чтобы вся ваша команда, включая вас, была экипирована "Золотым АК.762" и маской "Русская шапка" на уровне сложности "OVERKILL" или выше.

schinese.name: 入俄随俄
schinese.description: 在“沸点”任务中，全队佩戴“俄罗斯帽”面具并装备“黄金AK.762”突击步枪，于OVERKILL或以上难度下完成任务。

spanish.name: Al estar en Rusia... haz lo que hacen los rusos
spanish.description: Completa el trabajo Punto de Ebullición en la dificultad OVERKILL o más alta mientras todo el equipo lleva el Fusil AK 7,62 Dorado y el "Gorro Ruso".

dutch.name: Megalo-Mania
dutch.description: Have all four players using a fully unlocked Maniac perk deck and have an average of 65% or more of the white Maniac bar filled.

english.name: Megalo-Mania
english.description: Have all four players using a fully unlocked Maniac perk deck and have an average of 65% or more of the white Maniac bar filled.

french.name: La folie des grandeurs
french.description: Faites en sorte que les 4 membres de votre équipe utilisent la pioche d'atouts Forcené entièrement débloquée, puis accumulez des Points d'hystérie pour remplir vos barres blanches à plus de 65% au total.

german.name: Größenwahn
german.description: Alle vier Spieler müssen ein vollständig freigeschaltetes Wahnsinniger-Perk-Deck und durchschnittlich mindestens 65% der weißen Wahnsinniger-Leiste gefüllt haben.

italian.name: Manie di grandezza
italian.description: Fai in modo che tutti i membri della squadra abbiano equipaggiato la specializzazione del Maniaco (completamente sbloccata) e ottieni abbastanza cariche d'isteria per riempire più del 65% della barra bianca.

russian.name: Мегаломания
russian.description: Сделайте так, чтобы вы и ваша команда использовали полностью разблокированный перк "Маньяк" и поддерживали заряд белой шкалы на 65% уровне одновременно.

schinese.name: 自大狂
schinese.description: 四名玩家均使用已完全解锁的“狂人”天赋组，且白色狂人量表平均填满65%或以上。

spanish.name: Megalo-manía
spanish.description: Haz que tú y tu equipo de cuatro jugadores usen los talentos (completos) de Maníaco y que la barra de Histeria de todos pase del 65%.

dutch.name: Saint Francis
dutch.description: Complete the Bank Heist job after finding the 2 punks in the parking lot and bringing them next to the van, without letting them get away or die on the OVERKILL difficulty or above.

english.name: Saint Francis
english.description: Complete the Bank Heist job after finding the 2 punks in the parking lot and bringing them next to the van, without letting them get away or die on the OVERKILL difficulty or above.

french.name: Saint François d'Assise
french.description: Dans le contrat Braquage, trouvez les deux voyous dans le parking et amenez-les jusqu'au fourgon, puis terminez le contrat sans les laisser s'échapper ou mourir, en difficulté OVERKILL ou supérieure.

german.name: Heiliger Franziskus
german.description: Beende auf der Schwierigkeit OVERKILL oder höher den Auftrag "Bankraub", nachdem du die 2 Dreckskerle auf dem Parkplatz fesselst und zum Transporter bringst, ohne dass sie sterben.

italian.name: San Francesco
italian.description: Durante il contratto "COLPO IN BANCA", trova i 2 delinquenti nel parcheggio e portali vicino al furgone, dopodiché completa la missione senza farli morire o scappare in difficoltà OVERKILL o superiore.

russian.name: Святой Франциск
russian.description: Завершите "Ограбление Банка" после того, как вы сопроводите двух бандитов до вашего фургона, не дав им умереть или сбежать на уровне сложности "OVERKILL" или выше.

schinese.name: 圣方济各
schinese.description: 在“银行劫案”任务中，找到停车场里的2个小混混并将他们带到面包车旁，不让他们逃跑或死亡，于OVERKILL或以上难度下完成任务。

spanish.name: San Francisco
spanish.description: En el trabajo Golpe al Banco encuentra a los 2 vándalos en el aparcamiento, átalos, déjalos junto a la furgoneta de huida y completa el golpe sin que huyan o mueran en la dificultad OVERKILL o más alta.

dutch.name: High Times
dutch.description: In The Bomb: Dockyard job, cook 2 bags of meth and secure them.

english.name: High Times
english.description: In The Bomb: Dockyard job, cook 2 bags of meth and secure them.

french.name: Bad trip
french.description: Dans le contrat La Bombe : Chantier naval, préparez et récupérez 2 sacs de méthamphétamine.

german.name: High Times
german.description: Koche im Job "Die Bombe: Schiffswerft" 2 Beutel Meth und bringt sie in Sicherheit.

italian.name: Fatti e rifatti
italian.description: Durante il contratto "LA BOMBA - ZONA PORTUALE", prepara e metti al sicuro 2 borsoni di metanfetamina.

russian.name: Тяжёлые времена
russian.description: Выполняя контракт "Бомба: Доки", приготовьте две сумки с метом и унесите их с собой.

schinese.name: 嗨翻天
schinese.description: 在“炸弹：船坞”任务中，制作2包冰毒并将其存放。

spanish.name: Tiempos que vuelan
spanish.description: En el trabajo La Bomba: Astillero, cocina y asegura 2 lotes de metanfetamina.

dutch.name: Looting in the Dark
dutch.description: Complete the Murky Station job by finding and securing all loot without killing anyone on the OVERKILL difficulty or above.

english.name: Looting in the Dark
english.description: Complete the Murky Station job by finding and securing all loot without killing anyone on the OVERKILL difficulty or above.

french.name: Gentleman cambrioleur
french.description: Terminez le contrat Gare de pillage en difficulté OVERKILL ou supérieure après avoir récupéré absolument tous les sacs possibles, et sans tuer personne.

german.name: Plündern in der Finsternis
german.description: Beende den Auftrag "Murky Station" auf der Schwierigkeit OVERKILL oder höher, indem du sämtliche Beute sicherst und niemanden tötest.

italian.name: Predoni dell'oscurità
italian.description: Completa il contratto "STAZIONE DELLA MURKYWATER" dopo aver trovato e messo al sicuro tutto il bottino senza uccidere nessuno in difficoltà OVERKILL o superiore.

russian.name: Ночное ограбление
russian.description: Завершите контракт "Станция Murkywater", собрав всю дополнительную добычу без убийств на уровне сложности "OVERKILL" или выше.

schinese.name: 摸黑劫掠
schinese.description: 在“阴暗车站”任务中，找到并存放所有战利品且不杀害任何人，于OVERKILL或以上难度下完成任务。

spanish.name: Robando en la oscuridad
spanish.description: Completa el trabajo Estación Murky en la dificultad OVERKILL o más alta habiendo asegurado todas las armas y sin matar a nadie.

dutch.name: Mellon
dutch.description: In the Birth of Sky job, find all 9 rings.

english.name: Mellon
english.description: In the Birth of Sky job, find all 9 rings.

french.name: Mellon
french.description: Dans le contrat Genèse Céleste, trouvez les 9 anneaux.

german.name: Mellon
german.description: Finde während des Auftrags "Himmelsgeburt" alle 9 Ringe.

italian.name: Mellon
italian.description: Trova tutti i 9 anelli durante il contratto "GENESI CELESTE".

russian.name: Друг
russian.description: Выполняя контракт "Рождение небес", найдите 9 спрятанных колец.

schinese.name: 梅隆
schinese.description: 在“天空诞生”任务中，找到全部9枚戒指。

spanish.name: Mellon
spanish.description: En el trabajo Nacimiento en el Cielo, encuentra los 9 anillos.

dutch.name: Kiss the Chef
dutch.description: In the Cook Off job, cook 25 bags of meth on the OVERKILL difficulty or above.

english.name: Kiss the Chef
english.description: In the Cook Off job, cook 25 bags of meth on the OVERKILL difficulty or above.

french.name: Mes compliments au chef
french.description: Terminez le contrat Amphet' à gogo, en difficulté OVERKILL ou supérieure, après avoir préparé 25 sacs de méthamphétamine.

german.name: Küss den Koch
german.description: Koche während des Auftrags "Kochwettbewerb" auf der Schwierigkeit OVERKILL oder höher 25 Beutel Meth.

italian.name: Complimenti allo chef
italian.description: Durante il contratto "LADRI IN CUCINA", prepara 25 borsoni di metanfetamina in difficoltà OVERKILL o superiore.

russian.name: Чмокни повара
russian.description: Выполняя контракт "Варка мета", приготовьте 25 сумок с метом на уровне сложности "OVERKILL" или выше.

schinese.name: 亲吻厨师
schinese.description: 在“烹饪大赛”任务中，于OVERKILL或以上难度下制作25包冰毒。

spanish.name: Felicita al chef
spanish.description: En el trabajo Cocineros, cocina 25 lotes de metanfetamina en la dificultad OVERKILL o más alta.

dutch.name: You Got Your Patch!
dutch.description: Complete The Biker Heist job on the Death Wish difficulty or above.

english.name: You Got Your Patch!
english.description: Complete The Biker Heist job on the Death Wish difficulty or above.

french.name: Voilà ton écusson !
french.description: Terminez le contrat À pleins gaz en difficulté Suicidaire.

german.name: Aufnäher verdient!
german.description: Beende den Bikerraub-Überfall auf der Schwierigkeit Todesmut.

italian.name: Uno dei nostri!
italian.description: Completa il contratto "A TUTTO GAS" in difficoltà Apocalisse.

russian.name: Ты заслужил нашивку!
russian.description: Завершите про-версию контракта "Разборки на поезде", на уровне сложности "Жажда смерти".

schinese.name: 你拿到你的徽章了！
schinese.description: 在“死亡愿望”或更高难度下完成“飞车党劫案”任务。

spanish.name: ¡Te has ganado el parche!
spanish.description: Completa el trabajo Enfrentamiento Motociclista en la dificultad Death Wish.

dutch.name: Let the Man Work
dutch.description: In the first day of The Biker Heist job, let Mike the mechanic finish the bike without any interruptions on the OVERKILL difficulty or above. Unlocks "The Classic mask", "Hotrod" material and "Engine" Pattern.

english.name: Let the Man Work
english.description: In the first day of The Biker Heist job, let Mike the mechanic finish the bike without any interruptions on the OVERKILL difficulty or above. Unlocks "The Classic mask", "Hotrod" material and "Engine" Pattern.

french.name: Mais laissez-moi bosser
french.description: Au 1er jour du contrat À pleins gaz, faites en sorte que Mike le mécano termine la moto sans être interrompu, en difficulté OVERKILL ou supérieure. Débloque le masque "La Référence", le matériau "Hot rod" et le motif "Moteur".

german.name: Lass den Mann arbeiten
german.description: Lass am ersten Tag des Bikerraub-Überfalls auf der Schwierigkeit OVERKILL oder höher Mike den Mechaniker das Motorrad ohne Unterbrechung fertigstellen. Schaltet die Maske "Der Klassiker", das Material "Hotrod" und das Muster "Motor" frei.

italian.name: Lascialo lavorare
italian.description: Durante il primo giorno del contratto "A TUTTO GAS", fai in modo che Mike il meccanico finisca di assemblare la moto senza mai essere interrotto in difficoltà OVERKILL o superiore. Sblocca la maschera "IL CLASSICO", il materiale "HOT ROD" e il motivo "MOTORE".

russian.name: Дело мастера боится
russian.description: Выполняя первый день контракта "Разборки на поезде", не дайте полицейским прервать сборку мотоцикла Майком, на уровне сложности "OVERKILL" или выше. Выполнение достижения открывает маску "Классика", материал "хотрод" и рисунок "двигатель";

schinese.name: 让专家干活
schinese.description: 在“飞车党劫案”任务的第一天，于 OVERKILL 或更高难度下让机械师迈克不受任何干扰地完成摩托车。解锁“经典”面具、“改装车”材质与“引擎”图案。

spanish.name: Dejen que haga su trabajo
spanish.description: En el día 1 del trabajo Enfrentamiento Motociclista, protege a Mike, el mecánico, para que trabaje en la moto sin ni una interrupción en la dificultad OVERKILL o más alta. Desbloquea la máscara "El Clásico", el material "Hotrod" y el patrón "Motor".

dutch.name: Scavenger
dutch.description: In the first day of The Biker Heist job, find the secret item. Unlocks the "Flaming Skull" mask, "Shiny and Chrome" material and "Fire Tire" pattern.

english.name: Scavenger
english.description: In the first day of The Biker Heist job, find the secret item. Unlocks the "Flaming Skull" mask, "Shiny and Chrome" material and "Fire Tire" pattern.

french.name: Fouineur
french.description: Au 1er jour du contrat À pleins gaz, trouvez l'objet caché. Débloque le masque "Tête brûlée", le matériau "Étincelant et chromé" et le motif "Gomme brûlée".

german.name: Spürnase
german.description: Finde am ersten Tag des Bikerraub-Überfalls den geheimen Gegenstand. Schaltet die Maske "Flammenschädel", das Material "Chromglanz" und das Muster "Feuerreifen" frei.

italian.name: Esploratore
italian.description: Trova l'oggetto segreto durante il primo giorno del contratto "A TUTTO GAS". Sblocca la maschera "TESCHIO INFUOCATO", il materiale "CROMATO BRILLANTE" e il motivo "GOMMA BRUCIATA".

russian.name: Мусорщик
russian.description: Выполняя первый день контракта "Разборки на поезде", найдите секретный предмет. Выполнение достижения открывает маску "Огненный череп", материал "блестящий хром" и рисунок "огненный след".

schinese.name: 拾荒者
schinese.description: 在“飞车党劫案”任务的第一天，找到秘密物品。解锁“烈焰骷髅”面具、“闪亮镀铬”材质与“燃烧轮胎”图案。

spanish.name: Cazatesoros
spanish.description: En el dia 1 del trabajo Enfrentamiento Motociclista, encuentra el objeto secreto. Desbloquea la máscara "Cráneo Llameante", el material "Brillante y cromado" y el patrón "Neumático llameante".

dutch.name: Full Throttle
dutch.description: Complete the second day of The Biker Heist job within 120 seconds on the OVERKILL difficulty or above. Unlocks the "Speed Devil" mask, "Devil Eye" material and "Skull Wing" pattern.

english.name: Full Throttle
english.description: Complete the second day of The Biker Heist job within 120 seconds on the OVERKILL difficulty or above. Unlocks the "Speed Devil" mask, "Devil Eye" material and "Skull Wing" pattern.

french.name: Essorage de poignée
french.description: Terminez le 2ème jour du contrat À pleins gaz en moins de 120 secondes, en difficulté OVERKILL ou supérieure. Débloque le masque "Le Diable au corps", le matériau "Oeil démoniaque" et le motif "Tête de mort ailée".

german.name: Vollgas
german.description: Beende den zweiten Tag des Bikerraub-Überfalls auf der Schwierigkeit OVERKILL oder höher innerhalb 120 Sekunden. Schaltet die Maske "Teufelskerl", das Material "Teufelsauge" und das Muster "Schädelflügel" frei.

italian.name: A tutto gas
italian.description: Completa il secondo giorno del contratto "A TUTTO GAS" in meno di 120 secondi in difficoltà OVERKILL o superiore. Sblocca la maschera "IL DIAVOLO DELLA VELOCITÀ", il materiale "OCCHIO DEMONIACO" e il motivo "TESCHIO ALATO".

russian.name: Full Throttle
russian.description: Завершите второй день контракта "Разборки на поезде" менее чем за 120 секунд, на уровне сложности "OVERKILL" или выше. Выполнение достижения открывает маску "Дьявол скорости", материал "глаз дьявола" и рисунок "череп и крылья".

schinese.name: 油门全开
schinese.description: 在 OVERKILL 或更高难度下，于120秒内完成“飞车党劫案”任务的第二天。解锁“极速恶魔”面具、“恶魔之眼”材质与“骷髅之翼”图案。

spanish.name: Acelerado al máximo
spanish.description: Completa el día 2 del trabajo Enfrentamiento Motociclista en menos de 120 segundos en la dificultad OVERKILL o más alta. Desbloquea la máscara "Demonio de la Velocidad", el material "Ojo de demonio" y el patrón "Cráneo con alas".

dutch.name: Eye for an Eye
dutch.description: In the second day of The Biker Heist job, destroy the helicopter turret. Unlocks the "Road Rage" mask, "Chromey" material and "Biker Face" pattern.

english.name: Eye for an Eye
english.description: In the second day of The Biker Heist job, destroy the helicopter turret. Unlocks the "Road Rage" mask, "Chromey" material and "Biker Face" pattern.

french.name: Oeil pour oeil

german.name: Auge um Auge
german.description: Zerstöre am zweiten Tag des Bikerraub-Überfalls das Hubschraubergeschütz. Schaltet die Maske "Zorn der Straße", das Material "Chromig" und das Muster "Bikergesicht" frei.

italian.name: Occhio per occhio

russian.name: Глаз за глаз

schinese.name: 以眼还眼
